*Leader:* Indeed, none can glorify You, / no living creature, including myself, Your servant.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/21)

*Cong:* And I am a despicable man, forsaken by men, / spurned in my own eyes and lowly among men.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/22)

*Leader:* And Your servant has nothing with which to honor You, / to repay You for Your kindnesses;


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/23)

*Cong:* For You have heaped good upon me, / and Your kindness to me has been great.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/24)

*Leader:* And many a debt have I incurred toward You, / for You have done good with me;


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/25)


*קהל:* וְלֹא חֻיַּֽבְתָּ לִי גְּמוּלֶֽיךָ / כָּל טוֹבָתִי בַּל עָלֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* Yet You do not ask me my debt to You, / all Your goodness to me is due to Your benevolence alone.
for

*Leader:* I have not sufficiently worshiped You for all of this good; / I have not repaid You even one part of ten thousand.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/27)

*Cong:* If I tried to count the good You have done, / I would not know how to learn its number.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/28)

*Leader:* And what shall I give back to You? All is Yours! / The heavens are Yours as well as the earth.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/29)

*Cong:* The seas and all that is within are in Your hands; / all receive nourishment from Your hand.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/30)

*Leader:* And we are Your nation, Your flock, / who desire to perform Your will!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/31)


*קהל:* וְאֵיךְ נַעֲבֹד וְאֵין לְאֵל יָדֵֽנוּ / וְלִשְׂרֵפַת אֵשׁ, בֵּית קָדְשֵֽׁנוּ.


*Cong:* And how shall we worship when we lack strength, / and our holy Temple has been consumed by fire?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/32)


*ש״ץ:* וְאֵיךְ נַעֲבֹד, וְאֵין זֶֽבַח וּמִנְחָה / כִּי לֹא בָֽאנוּ אֶל הַמְּנוּחָה.


*Leader:* And how shall we worship now that peace-offerings and meal-offerings are no more – / for we have not yet come to that restful place [Jerusalem].


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/33)

*Cong:* And there is no water to wash away impurity; / and we are situated in an impure land.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/34)


*ש״ץ:* שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִי עַל אֲמָרֶֽיךָ / וַאֲנִי בָֽאתִי בִּדְבָרֶֽיךָ.


*Leader:* Your words render me joyous; / I have now come before You to follow Your utterances.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/35)


*קהל:* כִּי כָתוּב, לֹא עַל זְבָחֶֽיךָ / וְעוֹלֹתֶֽיךָ אוֹכִיחֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* For it is said: Not concerning your peace-offerings / and burnt-offerings will I rebuke you.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/36)

*Leader:* Concerning peace-offerings and burnt-offerings, / I did not command your ancestors.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/37)


*קהל:* מַה שָּׁאַֽלְתִּי וּמַה דָּרַֽשְׁתִּי / מִמְּךָ, כִּי אִם לְיִרְאָה אוֹתִי.


*Cong:* What have I asked and what have I required / of you? – only to fear Me!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/38)


*ש״ץ:* לַעֲבוֹד בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְלֵבָב טוֹב / הִנֵּה שְׁמֹֽעַ מִזֶּֽבַח טוֹב:


*Leader:* To worship Me with joy and a glad heart – / “For heeding Me is better than a choice sacrifice.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/39)


*קהל:* וְלֵב נִשְׁבָּר, מִמִּנְחָה טְהוֹרָה / זִבְחֵי אֱלֹהִים רֽוּחַ נִשְׁבָּרָה:


*Cong:* And a broken heart is better than a pure meal-offering; / a broken spirit is equivalent to a sacrifice to God.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/40)


*ש״ץ:* זֶֽבַח וּמִנְחָה לֹא־חָפַֽצְתָּ: / חַטָּאת וְעוֹלָה לֹא שָׁאָֽלְתָּ.


*Leader:* You do not desire peace-offerings and meal-offerings, / You did not request sin-offerings or burnt-offerings.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/41)


*קהל:* מִזְבֵּֽחַ אֶבְנֶה בְּשִׁבְרוֹן לִבִּי / וַאֲשַׁבְּרָה אַף רוּחִי בְּקִרְבִּי.


*Cong:* I shall build an altar out of my shattered heart, / and I shall break and humble my spirit within me.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/42)


*ש״ץ:* רוּם לֵב אַשְׁפִּיל, וְאֶת רוּם עֵינַי / וְאֶקְרַע לְבָבִי לְמַֽעַן אֲדֹנָי.


*Leader:* I shall bring low my haughty heart and lower my haughty eyes; / I shall rend my heart for the sake of my Lord.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/43)


*קהל:* שִׁבְרֵי רוּחִי הֵם זְבָחֶֽיךָ / יַעֲלוּ לְרָצוֹן עַל מִזְבְּחֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* The fragments of my spirit shall be Your offerings; / may they rise up to You upon Your altar and be willingly accepted.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 44

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/44](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/44)


*ש״ץ:* וְאַשְׁמִֽיעַ בְּקוֹל הוֹדָיוֹתֶֽיךָ / וַאֲסַפְּרָה כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ.


*Leader:* And I shall loudly sound out Your praise, / and recount of all Your wonders.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 45

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/45](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/45)


*קהל:* אֲשֶׁר יָדְעָה נַפְשִׁי אַחְבִּֽירָה / אֲמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹת וַאֲדַבֵּֽרָה.


*Cong:* For that which my soul has known – I shall compose words, / I shall speak profusely of Your mighty deeds.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/46)


*ש״ץ:* וּמָה אֶעֱרוֹךְ, וְלֹא יָדַֽעְתִּי מָה / הֲיָכֹל אוּכַל דַּבֵּר מְאֽוּמָה:


*Leader:* And what shall I formulate when I do not know what to say? / Indeed, is there anything I can say?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 47

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/47](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/47)


*קהל:* כִּי אֵין חֵֽקֶר לִגְדֻלָּתוֹ / וְגַם אֵין מִסְפָּר לִתְבוּנָתוֹ.


*Cong:* For His greatness , / His insight .
is unsearchable
innumerable


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/48)


*ש״ץ:* חֲכַם לֵבָב הוּא, מִי כָמֽוֹהוּ / שַׂגִּיא כֹֽחַ, לֹא מְצָאנֻֽהוּ.


*Leader:* He is wise of heart – who is like Him? / We shall never fully perceive the greatness of His strength.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 49

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/49](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/49)


*קהל:* עוֹשֶׂה גְדוֹלוֹת וְרַב נוֹרָאוֹת / גָּדוֹל אַתָּה וְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת:


*Cong:* The doer of great works; chief of awesome acts – / You are great, and You work wonders.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 50

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/50](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/50)


*ש״ץ:* עַד אֵין מִסְפָּר וְעַד אֵין חֵֽקֶר / וְלֹא נוֹדַע כִּי לֹא יֵחָקֵר.


*Leader:* Innumerable, – / their number shall never be known, for none shall succeed to discover their scope.
unsearchable


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 51

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/51)


*קהל:* אֵיזוֹ עַֽיִן אֲשֶׁר תְּעִידֶֽךָ / וְאֵיזֶה פֶּה אֲשֶׁר יַגִּידֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* What eye can witness having seen You; / what mouth might tell of You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 52

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/52](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/52)


*ש״ץ:* חַי לֹא רָאֲךָ וְלֵב לֹא יְדָעֲךָ / וְאֵיזֶה שֶֽׁבַח אֲשֶׁר יַגִּיעֲךָ.


*Leader:* No living being has seen You, nor has their heart known You; / what praise shall suffice for You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 53

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/53](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/53)


*קהל:* גַּם מְשָׁרְתֶֽיךָ לֹא רָאֽוּךָ / וְכָל חַכְמֵי לֵב לֹא מְצָאֽוּךָ.


*Cong:* Even Your servants have not seen You, / nor have the wise of heart discovered You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 54

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/54](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/54)


*ש״ץ:* אַתָּה לְבַדְּךָ מַכִּיר שִׁבְחֲךָ / וְאֵין זוּלָתְךָ יוֹדֵֽעַ כֹּחֲךָ.


*Leader:* You alone know Your praise; / no one but You knows Your true strength.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 55

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/55](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/55)


*קהל:* וְאֵין יוֹדֵֽעַ בִּלְעָדֶֽיךָ / שְׁבָחוֹת רְאוּיוֹת לִכְבוֹדֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* And no one but You knows / which praises befit Your glory.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 56

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/56](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/56)


*ש״ץ:* עַל כֵּן תְּבֹרָךְ כָּרָאוּי לָךְ / כְּפִי קָדְשֶֽׁךָ, כְּבוֹדְךָ וְגָדְלָךְ.


*Leader:* Therefore, may You be blessed as befits You, / according to Your holiness, glory and greatness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 57

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/57](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/57)


*קהל:* וּמִפִּי הַכֹּל, בְּכָל אֱיָלוּתָם / כְּפִי מַדָּע אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה חֲנַנְתָּם.


*Cong:* And so all shall bless You with their fullest strength, / according to the knowledge You have granted them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 58

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/58](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/58)


*ש״ץ:* יוֹדוּ פִלְאֲךָ הַשָּׁמַֽיִם / וִיאַדְּרֽוּךָ קוֹלוֹת מָֽיִם.


*Leader:* The heavens shall laud Your wonders, / and the sounds of water shall exalt You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 59

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/59](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/59)


*קהל:* וְיָרִֽיעוּ לְךָ כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ / יוֹדֽוּךָ כָּל מַלְכֵי אָֽרֶץ.


*Cong:* And all the earth’s inhabitants shall shout out to You, / all earthly kings shall laud You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 60

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/60](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/60)


*ש״ץ:* אַף יוֹדֽוּךָ כָּל הָעַמִּים / וִישַׁבְּחֽוּךָ כָּל הָאֻמִּים.


*Leader:* All nations shall give thanks to You, / and all peoples shall praise You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 61

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/61](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/61)


*קהל:* כָּל זֶֽרַע יַעֲקֹב עֲבָדֶֽיךָ / כִּי עֲלֵיהֶם גָּבְרוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* As will all of the descendants of Jacob, Your servant, / for Your kindnesses have overwhelmed them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 62

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/62](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/62)


*ש״ץ:* אֶת שֵׁם יהוה יְהַלְלוּ כֻלָּם / אֵל אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת, וּמֶֽלֶךְ עוֹלָם.


*Leader:* The name of the Lord shall be praised by them all: / The true Lord God and King of the Universe.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 63

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/63](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/63)


*קהל:* בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יָחִיד וּמְיֻחָד / יהוה אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:


*Cong:* Blessed are You, unique and singular One – / “The Lord is One and His name is One”!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 65

*Cong:* You bring babies to breach and give life, but You were not born; / You crush and heal but You have never been afflicted.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 120

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/120](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/120)


*ש״ץ:* מָֽוֶת וּמַדְוֶה אֵין לְפָנֶֽיךָ / תְּנוּמָה וְשֵׁנָה אֵין לְעֵינֶֽיךָ.


*Leader:* You know no death or pain; / Your eyes know not sleep or slumber.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 121

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/121](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/121)


*קהל:* הֲלֹא מִקֶּֽדֶם, אֵל חַי אַתָּה / מֵאֲשֶׁר בְּךָ לֹא נִשְׁתַּנֵּֽיתָ.


*Cong:* For from the earliest days, You have been a living God; / You have not changed from what You have always been.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 122

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/122](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/122)


*ש״ץ:* וְעַד הָעוֹלָם לֹא תִשְׁתַּנֶּה / מֵאֱלָהוּתְךָ לֹא תִתְגַּנֶּה.


*Leader:* And You shall never change; / You shall never be degraded from Your divinity.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 123

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/123](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/123)


*קהל:* חָדָשׁ וְנוֹשָׁן לֹא נִמְצֵֽאתָ / חִדַּֽשְׁתָּ כֹּל וְלֹא חֻדָּֽשְׁתָּ.


*Cong:* The terms “new” and “old” do not apply to You; / You initiated all but You were not initiated.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 124

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/124](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/124)


*ש״ץ:* לֹא יָחֽוּלוּ זִקְנָה וּבַחֲרוּת / עָלֶֽיךָ, גַּם שֵׂיבָה וְשַׁחֲרוּת.


*Leader:* Old age and youth cannot be ascribed / to You; neither can hoariness or childhood.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 125

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/125](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/125)


*קהל:* וְלֹא חָֽלוּ בְךָ שִׂמְחָה וְעֶֽצֶב / וְדִמְיוֹן נוֹצָר, וְכָל דְּבַר קֶֽצֶב.


*Cong:* Joy and sadness cannot be ascribed to You; / nor can the form of any creature or finite being.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 126

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/126](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/126)


*ש״ץ:* כִּי לֹא יְסוֹבֵב אוֹתְךָ גֹּֽשֶׁם / אַף לֹא תִדְמֶה אֶל כָּל נֹֽשֶׁם.


*Leader:* For no material matter affects You; / You are unlike any creature or soul.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 127

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/127](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/127)


*קהל:* כָּל הַיְצוּרִים גְּבוּל סִבַּבְתָּם / אֶל רֵאשִׁיתָם וּלְאַחֲרִיתָם.


*Cong:* You surrounded each of Your creatures with boundaries; / their beginnings and ends are defined.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 128

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/128](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/128)


*ש״ץ:* כִּי הַבְּרוּאִים בִּגְבוּל שַׂמְתָּם / וְלִימֵי צְבָאָם, גְּבוּל הִקַּפְתָּם.


*Leader:* For You have placed boundaries for Your creatures; / You have surrounded the cycle of their lives with limits.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 129

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/129](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/129)


*קהל:* וּלְךָ אֵין גְּבוּל וּלְיָמֶֽיךָ / וְלִשְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ וּלְעָצְמֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* But You have no boundaries; neither do Your days, / Your years or Your great power.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 130

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/130](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/130)


*ש״ץ:* עַל כֵּן אֵינְךָ צָרִיךְ לַכֹּל / לְיָדְךָ וּלְחַסְדְּךָ צְרִיכִים הַכֹּל.


*Leader:* Therefore, You need no one; / yet all beings need Your hand and Your kindness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 131

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/131](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/131)


*קהל:* הַכֹּל צְרִיכִים לְצִדְקוֹתֶֽיךָ / וְאֵינְךָ צָרִיךְ לִבְרִיּוֹתֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* All require Your acts of righteousness, / yet You do not require Your creatures.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 132

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/132](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/132)


*ש״ץ:* כִּי טֶֽרֶם כָּל יְצִיר הָיִֽיתָ / לְבַדְּךָ, מְאֽוּמָה לֹא נִצְרָֽכְתָּ.


*Leader:* For before any creature, You existed / alone; You were in need of nothing.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 133

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/133](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/133)


*קהל:* רֵאשִׁית וְאַחֲרִית, בְּיָדְךָ עֲרוּכִים / אַתָּה בָּם, וְהֵם בְּרוּחֲךָ שְׂרוּכִים.


*Cong:* All their beginnings and ends are arranged by Your hand; / You are within them and they are bound up with You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 134

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/134](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/134)


*ש״ץ:* כֹּל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בָרִאשׁוֹנָה / וַאֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בָּאַחֲרוֹנָה.


*Leader:* All that was at the beginning, / and all that will be in later years;


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 135

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/135](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/135)


*קהל:* כָּל הַיְצוּרִים וְכָל מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם / וְכָל דִּבְרֵיהֶם וּמַחְשְׁבוֹתֵיהֶם.


*Cong:* All creatures and all their deeds, / their speech and all their thoughts;


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 136

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/136](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/136)


*ש״ץ:* מֵרֹאשׁ וְעַד סוֹף תֵּדַע כֻּלָּם / וְלֹא תִשְׁכַּח, כִּי אַתָּה אֶצְלָם.


*Leader:* From beginning to end You know all / and shall never forget; for You are near them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 137

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/137](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/137)


*קהל:* אַתָּה בְרָאתָם וְלִבְּךָ עֲרָכָם / לְבַדְּךָ תֵּדַע מְקוֹמָם וְדַרְכָּם.


*Cong:* You created them and Your heart arranged them; / You alone know their place and their path.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 138

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/138](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/138)


*ש״ץ:* הֵן אֵין דָּבָר מִמְּךָ נֶעְלָם / כִּי לְפָנֶֽיךָ נְכוֹנִים כֻּלָּם.


*Leader:* For nothing is concealed from You; / for all of them stand before You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 139

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/139](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/139)


*קהל:* אֵין חֹֽשֶׁךְ וְאֵין מָנוֹס וְסֵֽתֶר / לָנוּס שָׁמָּה וּלְהִסָּתֵר.


*Cong:* There is no darkness or refuge or concealed place / to which one can flee and hide.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 140

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/140](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/140)


*ש״ץ:* אֵת אֲשֶׁר תְּבַקֵּשׁ אַתָּה מוֹצֵא / בְּלִי נְטוֹת אֲלֵיהֶם בְּעֵת שֶׁתִּרְצֶה.


*Leader:* You shall find what You seek / without inclining toward them whenever You so desire.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 141

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/141](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/141)


*קהל:* כִּי אֶת הַכֹּל כְּאַחַת תִּרְאֶה / לְבַדְּךָ תַעֲשֶׂה וְאֵינְךָ נִלְאֶה.


*Cong:* For You see all in one sweeping glance; / You act alone and do not become weary.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 142

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/142](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/142)


*ש״ץ:* כִּי עַל גּוֹי וְעַל אָדָם יַֽחַד / עַל כֹּל תְּדַבֵּר בְּרֶֽגַע אֶחָד.


*Leader:* For ofconcerning an entire nation or all humankind, / to all You can speak in a single moment.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 143

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/143](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/143)


*קהל:* תִּשְׁמַע בְּרֶֽגַע כָּל הַקּוֹלוֹת / זַֽעַק וְלַֽחַשׁ וְכָל הַתְּפִלּוֹת.


*Cong:* You can hear all voices at the very same moment, / cries, whispers, and all prayers.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 144

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/144](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/144)


*ש״ץ:* אַף תָּבִין אֶל כָּל מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם / בְּרֶֽגַע תַּחְקוֹר כָּל לְבָבֵיהֶם.


*Leader:* You also discern all of their deeds; / You seek out the inner workings of their hearts in an instant.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 145

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/145](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/145)


*קהל:* וְלֹא תַאֲרִיךְ עַל מַחְשְׁבוֹתֶֽיךָ / וְלֹא תִתְמַהְמַהּ עַל עֲצָתֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* You do not prolong Your thoughts; / You do not hesitate upon Your counsel.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 146

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/146](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/146)


*ש״ץ:* אֵֽצֶל עֲצָתְךָ גְּזֵרָתֶֽךָ / לְקֵץ וּלְמוֹעֵד קְרִיאָתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* Your counsel and decrees are one and the same; / they shall be carried out at the time You determine.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 147
