*קהל:* בּוֹרֵא כֹל, וְיִשְׂרָאֵל גּוֹאֵל / בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:


*Cong:* The Creator of all and Redeemer of Israel; / blessed be God, the God of Israel.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 203

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/203](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/203)


*ש״ץ:* בּוֹרֵא רֽוּחַ, הָרִים יוֹצֵר / מִמְּךָ מְזִמָּה לֹא יִבָּצֵר.


*Leader:* Maker of wind, Creator of mountains; / no device can be hidden from You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 204

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/204](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/204)


*קהל:* גֵּאֶה, מֵשִׁיב גְּמוּל עַל גֵּאִים / עַל הָרָמִים וְעַל הַנִּשָּׂאִים.


*Cong:* Majestic One, You repay the haughty, / the lofty and the proud.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 205

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/205](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/205)


*ש״ץ:* גִּבּוֹר בְּקוּמוֹ לַעֲרוֹץ בְּעֶבְרָה / מֵהֲדַר גְּאוֹנוֹ, מִי לֹא יִירָא.


*Leader:* He is mighty when He rises up in His anger to strike with awe; / who does not fear the splendor of His majesty?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 206

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/206](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/206)


*קהל:* גָּבֽוֹהַּ, כָּל אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתָּיו נוֹשֵׂא / וּגְדָל כֹּֽחַ, גְּדוֹלוֹת עוֹשֶׂה.


*Cong:* Lofty One, He bears all that is below Him; / the powerful One works wonders.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 207

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/207](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/207)


*ש״ץ:* גָּדוֹל הוּא וּשְׁמוֹ בִּגְבוּרָה / אַרְיֵה שָׁאָג, מִי לֹא יִירָא:


*Leader:* He is great and His name bears His strength; / if a lion roars, who shall not be afraid?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 208

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/208](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/208)


*קהל:* דּוֹדִי, דָּגוּל הוּא מֵרְבָבָה / אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־קְדֹשִׁים רַבָּה:


*Cong:* My Beloved is encircled by myriads; / a God revered in the vast counsel of holy angels.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 209

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/209](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/209)


*ש״ץ:* דַּיָּן, יָתִיב כְּעַתִּיק יוֹמִין / וּצְבָאוֹ עַל שְׂמֹאל וְעַל יָמִין.


*Leader:* He sits in judgment as One who has always existed; / His hosts stand on His left and right.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 210

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/210](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/210)


*קהל:* הֲדָרוֹ וְהוֹדוֹ עַל בְּנֵי עֲבָדָיו / הָדוּר, הָדָר הוּא לְכָל חֲסִידָיו.


*Cong:* His splendor and glory rest upon the descendants of His servants, our ancestors; / He is glorified as the glory of all His devoted ones.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 211

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/211](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/211)


*ש״ץ:* הוּא אֵל אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת לְכָל / בָּשָׂר, שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלָּה מִכֹּל.


*Leader:* He is the Lord, the God whose spirit dwells in all / flesh; He hears the prayers of all.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 212

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/212](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/212)


*קהל:* וַדַּאי, וָתִיק, יוֹדֵֽעַ וָעֵד / יהוה יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד:


*Cong:* He is affirmed, diligent, knowing, a witness; / The Lord shall reign forever and ever.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 213

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/213](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/213)


*ש״ץ:* וַאֲשֶׁר חֶֽרֶב גַּאֲוָתֵֽנוּ / עֶזְרֵֽנוּ וּמָגִנֵּֽנוּ.


*Leader:* He is the Sword of our pride, / our Helper and Protector.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 214

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/214](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/214)


*קהל:* זוֹכֵר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִית רִאשׁוֹנִים / כְּיוֹם אֶתְמוֹל לוֹ, אֶֽלֶף שָׁנִים.


*Cong:* He recalls the covenant with the early ones forever; / to Him, a thousand years seem as recent as yesterday.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 215

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/215](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/215)


*ש״ץ:* זֶה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וְלוֹ קִוִּֽינוּ / וְזִמְרָת יָהּ, הוּא יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ.


*Leader:* This is our God; we await Him eagerly, / and the song of the Lord shall be our salvation.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 216

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/216](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/216)


*קהל:* חֵֽלֶק יַעֲקֹב, יוֹצֵר הַכֹּל / חַנּוּן יהוה וְחָסִיד בַּכֹּל.


*Cong:* He is the inheritance of Jacob, the Creator of all; / the Lord is gracious and kind in all He does.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 217

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/217](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/217)


*ש״ץ:* חֵי הָעוֹלָם יהוה חֶלְקִי / חֲכַם הָרָזִים יהוה חִזְקִי.


*Leader:* The Lord who lives forever shall be my lot; / the Lord who knows all secrets is my strength.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 218

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/218](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/218)


*קהל:* טוֹב וּמֵטִיב, הַמְלַמֵּד דֵּעָה / טְהוֹר עֵינַֽיִם מֵרְאוֹת בְּרָעָה.


*Cong:* He is good and does good, He teaches knowledge; / too pure of eye to behold evil.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 219

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/219](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/219)


*ש״ץ:* יָשָׁר יהוה וְיָשָׁר דְּבָרוֹ / יְדִידֵי יְדִידוּת, מִשְׁכְּנוֹת דְּבִירוֹ.


*Leader:* The Lord is upright and His words upright; / He favors His close ones, the angels, who dwell in His Temple.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 220

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/220](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/220)


*קהל:* יוֹעֵץ וְגוֹזֵר, מִי יְפִירֶֽנָּה / וְיַחְתֹּף וְיִפְעַל, מִי יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה.


*Cong:* He designs and decrees – who can annul His decision? / He strikes and acts – who can hinder Him?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 221

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/221](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/221)


*ש״ץ:* יָפֶה דּוֹדִי, יָפְיוֹ וְטוּבוֹ / יִרְאוּ, וְיֶחֱזוּ צִיּוֹן בְּשׁוּבוֹ.


*Leader:* My Beloved is beautiful, both His beauty and goodness / are evident. All shall witness His return to Zion.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 222

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/222](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/222)


*קהל:* כַּגִּבּוֹר יֵצֵא כְּאִישׁ מִלְחָמוֹת / יָעִיר קִנְאָה לַעֲשׂוֹת נְקָמוֹת.


*Cong:* Like a hero He shall go forth like a man of war; / His jealousy shall be aroused to perform vengeance.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 223

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/223](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/223)


*ש״ץ:* כְּנֶֽשֶׁר, עַל כַּנְפֵי נְשָׁרִים / נָשָׂא עֲבָדָיו, וְיִשֵּׁר הֲדוּרִים.


*Leader:* Like an eagle upon eagles’ wings, / He has carried His servants and straightened crooked paths.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 224

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/224](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/224)


*קהל:* כְּדֹב שַׁכּוּל וּכְנָמֵר שַֽׁחַל / כְּרָקָב וּכְעָשׁ, וְרוּחוֹ כַּנָּֽחַל.


*Cong:* Like a bereaved bear and a mighty leopard, / He shall reduce them to rottenness and moths; His spirit shall engulf them like an overflowing stream.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 225

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/225](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/225)


*ש״ץ:* כְּדֹב שַׁכּוּל וּכְנָמֵר שׁוֹקֵד / דְּבָרוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּמַקֵּל שָׁקֵד.


*Leader:* He is like a bereaved bear and a diligent leopard, / carrying out His word like an almond branch quick to blossom.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 226

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/226](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/226)


*קהל:* כַּבִּיר כֹּֽחַ, לֵב כְּמוֹ שָֽׁחַל / כְּלָבִיא וְכַאֲרִי, וְרוּחוֹ כְּנָֽחַל.


*Cong:* Mighty of heart like a lion, / like a lion and a lioness, His spirit shall engulf them like an overflowing stream.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 227

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/227](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/227)


*ש״ץ:* כְּאֶֽרֶז בָּחוּר בִּגְדֻלָּתוֹ / כִּבְרוֹשׁ רַעֲנָן עַנְוְתָנוּתוֹ.


*Leader:* His greatness is as robust as a cedar tree; / His humility is likened to a flourishing cypress.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 228

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/228](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/228)


*קהל:* כְּתַפּֽוּחַ בְּרֵיחוֹ, עֹז אַהֲבָתוֹ / עַל עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּאֲוָתוֹ.


*Cong:* The boldness of His love is like a fragrant apple tree; / His glory is upon His people, Israel.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 229

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/229](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/229)


*ש״ץ:* כְּתַפּֽוּחַ בַּעֲצֵי הַיַּֽעַר / כֵּן דּוֹדִי עִם יוֹשְׁבֵי שָֽׁעַר.


*Leader:* As an apple tree among the trees of the forest, / so is my Beloved among the judges who sit at their gates.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 230

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/230](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/230)


*קהל:* כַּבִּיר כֹּֽחַ, לְמַרְגִּיזֵי אֵל / נוֹקֵם, וְכַטַּל הוּא לְיִשְׂרָאֵל.


*Cong:* Might and strength are displayed to those who anger the God / of vengeance; while He is as gentle as dew to His people, Israel.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 231

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/231](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/231)


*ש״ץ:* כּוֹסִי, מְנָת חֶלְקִי וְגוֹרָלִי / אֲנִי לְדוֹדִי נַחֲלָה וְדוֹדִי לִי.


*Leader:* He is my cup of blessing, the portion of my inheritance, my lot; / I am my Beloved’s inheritance and He is mine.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 232

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/232](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/232)


*קהל:* כְּבוֹדִי יהוה לֹא אֲמִירֶֽנּוּ / הֶאֱמַרְנֽוּהוּ וְהֶאֱמִירָֽנוּ.


*Cong:* Lord, I shall never relinquish my honor; / we have avowed ourselves to Him and He to us.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 233

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/233](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/233)


*ש״ץ:* כְּאַרְיֵה יִשְׁאַג וְכַכְּפִיר יִנְהַם / אַל יִהְיֶה כְּגֵר, וּכְאִישׁ נִדְהָם.


*Leader:* He shall roar and growl like a lion; / He will not be as a stranger, or a man astounded.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 234

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/234](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/234)


*קהל:* כְּרוֹעֶה גִּבּוֹר, אֲשֶׁר לֹא יוּכַל / צֹאנוֹ לְהַצִּיל, וְהָיָה לְמַאֲכָל.


*Cong:* He is not like a valiant shepherd unable / to rescue His flock, leaving it to be consumed.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 235

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/235](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/235)


*ש״ץ:* כְּגִבּוֹר אֵין אֱיָל, וּכְאוֹרֵֽחַ / נָס וּבוֹרֵֽחַ, מַר צוֹרֵֽחַ.


*Leader:* Not like a powerless man of valor or a passing wayfarer, / who flees and runs while screaming bitterly.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 236

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/236](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/236)


*קהל:* כְּאַרְיֵה מַשְׁחִית וְכַכְּפִיר לְעֹזְבָיו / כָּרָקָב גַּם כָּעָשׁ לְאוֹיְבָיו.


*Cong:* He is like a destructive young lion to those who forsake Him; / reducing His enemies to rottenness and moths.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 237

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/237](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/237)


*ש״ץ:* כַּבִּיר כֹּֽחַ כְּשָׁמִיר וָשַֽׁיִת / וְלֹא יַשְׁאִיר כְּנֹֽקֶף זַֽיִת.


*Leader:* Of mighty power, He will reduce them to thorns on thorn bushes; / not a single shake of an olive tree shall remain of them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 238

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/238](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/238)


*קהל:* כְּשָׁמִיר וָשַֽׁיִת, צָרִים יְמַגֵּן / כְּצִפֳּרִים עָפוֹת לְעִירוֹ יָגֵן.


*Cong:* Like thorns on thorn bushes He shall deliver His foes to destruction; / He shall protect His city like birds hovering above.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 239

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/239](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/239)


*ש״ץ:* כְּגִשְׁמֵי נְדָבָה לָֽנוּ יָבֹא / כְּמַלְקוֹשׁ וְכַטַּל לַדְּבֵקִים בּוֹ.


*Leader:* He shall appear to us like generous rains; / He will be like the spring rain and the dew to those who cleave to Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 240

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/240](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/240)


*קהל:* כְּנֶֽשֶׁר יְרַחֵף עַל גּוֹזָלָיו / וּבְצֵל כְּנָפָיו יֶחֱסוּ מְיַחֲלָיו.


*Cong:* He shall hover above His young like an eagle; / those who await Him shall seek refuge beneath the shadow of His wings.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 241

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/241](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/241)


*ש״ץ:* כְּצִפֳּרִים, עַל עִירוֹ יָגֵן / וּבְצֵל כְּנָפָיו רְנָנוֹת נְנַגֵּן.


*Leader:* He shall protect His city like birds hovering above, / and in the shadow of His wings we shall play joyful songs.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 242

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/242](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/242)


*קהל:* לְבַדּוֹ הוּא, וְנִפְלָאוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת / עוֹשֶׂה אֵל נוֹרָא עֲלִילוֹת.


*Cong:* He is One alone and great wonders / He performs – God of awesome works.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 243

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/243](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/243)


*ש״ץ:* לִצְבִי וְעֹֽפֶר דּוֹמֶה דּוֹדִי / כִּי יְקַדְּמֵֽנִי אֱלֹהֵי חַסְדִּי.


*Leader:* My Beloved is like a gazelle and young hart; / My God of kindness hastens to receive me.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 244

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/244](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/244)


*קהל:* לִפְנֵי עַמּוֹ יְיַשֵּׁר הֲדוּרִים / וִינַשְּׂאֵם עַל כַּנְפֵי נְשָׁרִים.


*Cong:* He shall straighten crooked paths for His people, / and will lift them up upon eagles’ wings.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 245

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/245](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/245)


*ש״ץ:* לְעוֹלָם חֶלְקִי הוּא, וְצוּר לְבָבִי / כָּלָה שְׁאֵרִי לְךָ וּלְבָבִי.


*Leader:* He shall always be my lot, the rock of my heart; / my heart and flesh long for You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 246

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/246](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/246)


*קהל:* לְבַדּוֹ יהוה הוּא, וְנִפְלָאוֹת / גְּדוֹלוֹת עוֹשֶׂה, וְרַב נוֹרָאוֹת.


*Cong:* Our Lord is alone; / He works great wonders and does many awesome things.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 247

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/247](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/247)


*ש״ץ:* מָקוֹם וּמָעוֹן לְעוֹלָמֶֽךָ / וְאֵין יוֹדֵֽעַ אֶת מְקוֹמֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* Your world has a place and dwelling, / yet no one knows Your dwelling place.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 248

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/248](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/248)


*קהל:* מוֹרָאִי, אֵל רוֹעִי וְיוֹצְרִי / צוּר יְלָדַֽנִי, מְחוֹלְלִי וְצוּרִי.


*Cong:* My Awesome One – God my Shepherd, my Creator, / the Rock who birthed me, my Creator and my Rock.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 249

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/249](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/249)


*ש״ץ:* מָרוֹם וּמָעוֹז הוּא לִי, וּמַחְסִי / מִגְדַּל עֹז שֵׁם יהוה, מְנוּסִי.


*Leader:* He is my exalted One, my Fortress and Shelter; / the name of the Lord, my Redeemer, is a tower of strength.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 250

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/250](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/250)


*קהל:* מֶֽלֶךְ יַעֲקֹב, מִשְׂגָּב לָֽנוּ / הוּא מְחוֹקְקֵֽנוּ וּמוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ.


*Cong:* The King of Jacob is our Stronghold; / He is the Prescriber of our laws and our Savior.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 251

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/251](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/251)


*ש״ץ:* מִגְדּוֹל יְשׁוּעוֹת, מִשְׁעָן יְהִי לִי / מִבְטָח, אֱלֹהִים יהוה חֵילִי.


*Leader:* The tower of salvation shall be my support and confidence; / the Lord God, is my strength.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 252

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/252](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/252)


*קהל:* מוֹשֵׁל עוֹלָם מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ / בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדֹר מֶמְשַׁלְתֶּֽךָ.


*Cong:* Ruler of the world, Your kingdom / and reign are for all generations.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 253

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/253](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/253)


*ש״ץ:* מִי יִתֶּנְךָ כְּאָח לִי, לְצָרָה / הוֹשַׁע, כִּי יָדְךָ לֹא קָצְרָה.


*Leader:* O that You were my brother in times of distress; / save me, for Your hand lacks no strength.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 254

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/254](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/254)


*קהל:* מְקוֹר חַיִּים, מִקְוֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל / לֹא אֶעֱזוֹב כִּי מָעֻזִּי אֵל.


*Cong:* The Source of life, the Hope of Israel; / I shall not leave Him for God is my Fortress.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 255

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/255](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/255)


*ש״ץ:* מָגֵן יִשְׁעִי, וְחֶֽרֶב גַּאֲוָה / לְשִׁמְךָ וּלְזִכְרְךָ נֶֽפֶשׁ תַּאֲוָה.


*Leader:* The shield of my salvation, sword of pride; / our souls desire Your name and memory.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 256

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/256](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/256)


*קהל:* מָגֵן הוּא לְכֹל הַחוֹסִים בּוֹ: / אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם אֲשֶׁר עוֹז לוֹ בּוֹ.


*Cong:* He is a shield for all who take shelter in Him; / happy is the man who takes strength in Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 257

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/257](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/257)


*ש״ץ:* נָבָר וְנָעִים, נָאוֹר וְנוֹרָא / נֶאְדָּר וְנֶאְזָר שְׁמוֹ בִּגְבוּרָה.


*Leader:* Clear, pleasant, enveloped in light, awesome; / His name is glorious and girded with might.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 258

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/258](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/258)


*קהל:* נֶאֱמָן, נֵֽצַח יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגוֹאֲלוֹ / לֹא יְשַׁקֵּר, אַשְׁרֵי כָּל־חֽוֹכֵי לוֹ:


*Cong:* The Everlasting One of Israel and its Redeemer is faithful, / He never speaks falsehood; happy are those who await Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 259

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/259](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/259)


*ש״ץ:* נֵֽצַח יְשֻׁרוּן, הָאֵל הַנֶּאֱמָן / מֵאֱלֹהָיו יְהוּדָה לֹא אַלְמָן.


*Leader:* The Everlasting God of Yeshurun, the faithful God; / Judah has not been forsaken by its God.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 260

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/260](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/260)


*קהל:* נִפְלָא עַל כָּל הַנִּפְלָאִים / וּמִתְנַשֵּׂא לְכָל הַנִּשָּׂאִים.


*Cong:* More wondrous than all wonders; / loftier than all lofty beings.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 261

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/261](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/261)


*ש״ץ:* נִקְדָּשׁ וְנַעֲרָץ, אֱלֹהַי קְדוֹשִׁי / נָכוֹן וְנִשְׂגָּב, יהוה נִסִּי.


*Leader:* Sanctified and revered is my Holy One; / firmly established and exalted is my Lord, my Standard.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 262

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/262](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/262)


*קהל:* נוֹקֵם וְנוֹטֵר וּבַֽעַל חֵמָה / לְצָרָיו, לְאוֹיְבָיו אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה.


*Cong:* God of vengeance, He maintains His anger / toward His foes; He treats His enemies like a warrior.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 263

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/263](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/263)


*ש״ץ:* נֵרִי יהוה, בְּהִלּוֹ נֵרוֹ / עֲלֵי רֹאשִׁי, וְנֵר לְרַגְלִי דְּבָרוֹ.


*Leader:* The Lord is my lamp when He illuminates His lamp / above my head; His word serves as a candle for my path.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 264

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/264](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/264)


*קהל:* סוֹמֵךְ וְסוֹעֵד, יהוה סַלְעִי / סוֹבֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ וְנוֹשֵׂא פִשְׁעִי.


*Cong:* My Lord, my Rock, supports and sustains; / He is patient and forgiving, He bears my sins.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 265

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/265](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/265)


*ש״ץ:* סַהֲדִי יהוה, סַלְעִי וְסִתְרִי / סוֹלֵֽחַ וְסוֹבֵל, סַעֲדִי וְסִבְרִי.


*Leader:* God is my Witness, my Rock and my Shelter; / He forgives and bears; He sustains me; He is my Hope.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 266

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/266](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/266)


*קהל:* סַלְעֵֽנוּ וּמְצוּדָתֵֽנוּ / עֶזְרָתֵֽנוּ וּמְפַלְּטֵֽנוּ.


*Cong:* Our Rock and our Fortress; / our Succor and Rescuer.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 267

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/267](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/267)


*ש״ץ:* עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר, עֻזִּי וְעֶזְרִי / עֶלְיוֹן, עֹז לִי, אַל יְהִי עָרִי.


*Leader:* He is mighty and strong, my Strength and my Help; / the One On High is my strength; may He not be my enemy.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 268

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/268](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/268)


*קהל:* עִיר וְקַדִּישׁ שָׁת סְבִיבָיו סֵֽתֶר / אָכֵן אַתָּה אֵל מִסְתַּתֵּר:


*Cong:* He placed angels around His concealed presence; / indeed, You are a concealed God.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 269

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/269](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/269)


*ש״ץ:* עֵד מְמַהֵר לְשַׁלֵּם גְּמוּל לְאוֹיְבָיו / שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וָחֶֽסֶד לְאֹהֲבָיו.


*Leader:* He is a swift witness when visiting punishment upon His enemies; / He safeguards His covenant and kindness for His beloved.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 270

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/270](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/270)


*קהל:* פָּדָה אֶת אַבְרָהָם יְדִידוֹ / הוּא יִפְדֶּה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹ.


*Cong:* He redeemed His beloved Abraham; / He shall redeem Israel His servant.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 271

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/271](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/271)


*ש״ץ:* פַּֽחַד יִצְחָק יִתֵּן פַּחְדּוֹ / עַל צָרֵי בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב עַבְדּוֹ.


*Leader:* The One feared by Isaac shall cast His fear / upon the foes of the children of His servant Jacob.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 272

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/272](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/272)


*קהל:* פּוֹעֲלִי חוֹקֵר וְדוֹרֵשׁ וּבוֹדֵק / כָּל לְבָבוֹת, לוֹ אֶתֵּן צֶֽדֶק.


*Cong:* My Creator seeks out and examines / all hearts; I shall show Him righteousness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 273

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/273](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/273)


*ש״ץ:* צְרוֹר הַמֹּר, אֶשְׁכּוֹל הַכֹּֽפֶר / נוֹתֵן לְעַמּוֹ צָרָיו כֹּֽפֶר.


*Leader:* He is like a parcel of myrrh, a cluster of henna; / He offers His nation redemption from sin.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 274

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/274](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/274)


*קהל:* צַח וְאָדוֹם, דּוֹד בִּצְבָאָיו אוֹת / עַל כֵּן נִקְרָא יהוה צְבָאוֹת.


*Cong:* The Beloved One is bright and ruddy; He is the Master of His hosts; / therefore He is called the Lord of hosts.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 275

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/275](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/275)


*ש״ץ:* צַדִּיק יהוה הַצּוּר תָּמִים / אֶבְטַח עֲדֵי עַד בְּצוּר עוֹלָמִים.


*Leader:* The Lord is righteous, the perfect Rock; / I shall eternally trust the Rock of worlds.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 276

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/276](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/276)


*קהל:* צְבָא הַשָּׁמַֽיִם מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לוֹ / שְׂרָפִים עֹמְדִים מִמַּֽעַל לוֹ:


*Cong:* The hosts of heaven bow to Him; / Seraphim stand beside Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 277

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/277](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/277)


*ש״ץ:* קָדוֹשׁ הוּא בְּכָל מִינֵי קְדֻשּׁוֹת / כִּתּוֹת שָׁלֹשׁ, קָדוֹשׁ מְשַׁלְּשׁוֹת.


*Leader:* He is sanctified by a variety of holy declarations; / three bands of angels recite the threefold Kedusha.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 278

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/278](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/278)


*קהל:* קַיָּם לְעָלְמִין אֱלָהָא חַיָּא / מָרֵא דִי אַרְעָא וְדִי שְׁמַיָּא.


*Cong:* The living God exists forever; / the Master of the earth and the heavens.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 279

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/279](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/279)


*ש״ץ:* קוֹנִי מְרַחֵם, מְקַנֵּא לְשׂוֹנְאָיו / קֶֽרֶן יִשְׁעִי, קָרוֹב לְקוֹרְאָיו.


*Leader:* My Creator is merciful yet He is zealous toward His foes; / my Deliverer is close to those who call out to Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 280

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/280](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/280)


*קהל:* רָחוֹק מִכֹּל, וְאֶת כֹּל רוֹאֶה / כִּי רָם יהוה וְשָׁפָל יִרְאֶה.


*Cong:* He is distant from all, yet He sees all; / the Lord is lofty, yet He sees the lowly.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 281

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/281](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/281)


*ש״ץ:* רוֹעִי יהוה, לֹא אֶחְסַר כֹּל / וְרַב כֹּֽחַ וְרַב חֶֽסֶד לַכֹּל.


*Leader:* The Lord is my Shepherd, I shall not want; / He possesses great strength and does much kindness with all.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 282

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/282](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/282)


*קהל:* רַחוּם יהוה, רוֹפֵא וּמְחַבֵּשׁ / לִשְׁבוּרֵי לֵב, וְעָוֹן כּוֹבֵשׁ.


*Cong:* The Lord is merciful: He heals and binds up the wounds / of the brokenhearted and suppresses sin.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 283

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/283](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/283)


*ש״ץ:* רֵעִי כֻּלּוֹ הוּא מַחֲמַדִּים / מִשְׁפָּטָיו אֱמֶת, מְתוּקִים וַחֲמוּדִים.


*Leader:* My Friend is wholly desirable; / His laws are true, sweet and precious.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 284

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/284](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/284)


*קהל:* רִאשׁוֹן וְאַחֲרוֹן, מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד / עוֹלָם, אַתָּה אֵל שׁוֹכֵן עַד.


*Cong:* The first and the last from now until / eternity, You are God who abides forever.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 285

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/285](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/285)


*ש״ץ:* שַׁלִּיט, מֶֽלֶךְ שְׁמַיָּא, בְּכָל דָּר וְדָר / לֵהּ אֲנָא מְשַׁבַּח, מְרוֹמֵם וּמְהַדַּר.


*Leader:* The King of the heavens shall reign for all generations; / it is He that I praise, exalt and glorify.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 286

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/286](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/286)


*קהל:* שֶֽׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן יהוה אֱלֹהִים: / שׁוֹפֵט צֶֽדֶק וּמַשְׁפִּיל גְּבוֹהִים.


*Cong:* A Sun and a Shield is our Lord God; / a righteous Judge who lays the haughty low.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 287

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/287](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/287)


*ש״ץ:* שַׂגִּיא כֹֽחַ, לֹא מְצָאנֻֽהוּ / יַשְׂגִּיב בְּכֹחוֹ, וּמִי כָמֽוֹהוּ.


*Leader:* A Stronghold of strength – we cannot reveal Him; / He is exalted in His might – who is like Him?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 288

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/288](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/288)


*קהל:* שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁמוֹ, כִּי שֶׁלּוֹ שָׁלוֹם / כִּי יְדַבֵּר אֶל חֲסִידָיו שָׁלוֹם.


*Cong:* His name is Solomon for peace (Shalom) is His alone; / He shall speak peace unto His devoted ones.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 289

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/289](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/289)


*ש״ץ:* שֵׁם יהוה אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה / כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ, כַּכְּפִיר וּכְאַרְיֵה.


*Leader:* The name of the Lord is “I will be what I shall be”; / He is like the lofty horns of the wild ox to His people; He is like a lion.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 290

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/290](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/290)


*קהל:* שַׁדַּי מְאוֹרִי, מַלְכִּי וְאֵלִי / הַלְלוּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ נַפְשִׁי הַלְלִי.


*Cong:* The Almighty, my Light, my King and God; / Halleluya! My soul shall praise His name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 291

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/291](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/291)


*ש״ץ:* תִּתַּמַּם עִם יוֹשְׁבֵי נְטָעִים / הַשָּׂרִיגִים שְׁלֹֽשֶׁת הָרוֹעִים.


*Leader:* You act uprightly with the righteous who dwell among Your plantations; / the tendrils are the three shepherds [our forefathers].


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 292

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/292](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/292)


*קהל:* תִּתְחַסַּד, תִּתָּבַר עִמָּם / וְעִם עִקְּשִׁים תִּתַּפַּל לְהֻמָּם.


*Cong:* You act kindly, purely, with their descendants; / while the twisted are dealt with tortuously until they are overwhelmed.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 293

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/293](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/293)


*ש״ץ:* תָּמִים דַּרְכְּךָ, תַּקִּיף מִכֹּל / תּוּכַל לְבַדְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כֹּל.


*Leader:* Your path is perfect, O mightiest One; / You alone are capable of doing everything.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 294

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/294](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/294)


*קהל:* תּוֹחַלְתִּי וְסִבְרִי וְתִקְוָתִי / תַּאֲוַת נַפְשִׁי וּתְשׁוּקָתִי.


*Cong:* You are my Expectation, my Promise, my Hope; / subject of my soul’s desire and longing.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 295

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/295](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/295)


*ש״ץ:* תְּהִלָּתִי וְתִפְאַרְתִּי וְעֻזִּי / מִמְּעֵי אִמִּי גּוֹחִי וְגוֹזִי.


*Leader:* My Praise, my Glory, my Strength; the One who my mother’s womb.
extracted me from


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 296

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/296](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/296)


*קהל:* תְּמִים דֵּעִים, אֵל דֵּעוֹת אֶחָד / כָּל הַלְּבָבוֹת דּוֹרֵשׁ יָֽחַד.


*Cong:* His knowledge is perfect; the knowing God is One; / He seeks out all hearts as one.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 298

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/298](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/298)


*ש״ץ:* מִי כָמֽוֹךָ, דֵּעָה מוֹרֶה / נִיב שְׂפָתַֽיִם אַתָּה בוֹרֵא.


*Leader:* Who is like You, O Teacher of knowledge? / You create the speech of all lips.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 299

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/299](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/299)


*קהל:* מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ עָמְקוּ וְרָֽמוּ / וּשְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ לֹא יִתָּֽמּוּ:


*Cong:* Your thoughts are deep and lofty, / Your years of existence shall never end.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 300

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/300](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/300)


*ש״ץ:* לֹא לִמְּדֽוּךָ חָכְמָתֶֽךָ / וְלֹא הֱבִינֽוּךָ תְּבוּנָתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* No one taught You Your wisdom, / and no one granted You Your insight.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 301

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/301](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/301)


*קהל:* לֹא קִבַּֽלְתָּ מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ / וְלֹא יָרַֽשְׁתָּ מֶמְשַׁלְתֶּֽךָ.


*Cong:* You did not receive Your reign from others, / and did not inherit Your dominion.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 302

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/302](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/302)


*ש״ץ:* לְעוֹלָם יְהִי לְךָ לְבַדֶּֽךָ / וְלֹא לַאֲחֵרִים, כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* Forever Yours alone / and never shared by others, shall be Your majestic glory.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 303

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/303](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/303)


*קהל:* וְלֹא תִתֵּן לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים / תְּהִלָּתְךָ, לַפְּסִילִים וְזָרִים.


*Cong:* And You will never grant to foreign gods / Your glory, nor to idols or strange deities.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 304

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/304](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/304)


*ש״ץ:* וְכָבוֹד וְגַם כָּל יְקָר מֵאִתָּךְ / וּכְבוֹדְךָ לֹא לְזָרִים אִתָּךְ.


*Leader:* All glory and honor is from You; / Your honor shall never belong to strange gods.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 305

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/305](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/305)


*קהל:* אַתָּה תָּעִיד בְּיִחוּדֶֽךָ / וְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ וַעֲבָדֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* You shall testify to Your own Oneness, / and so shall Your Torah and Your servants.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 306

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/306](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/306)


*ש״ץ:* אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, עַל יִחוּדֶֽךָ / אַתָּה עֵד אֱמֶת, וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ עֲבָדֶֽיךָ.


*Leader:* Our God, to Your Oneness / You are true witness, and we are Your servants.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 307

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/307](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/307)


*קהל:* לְפָנֶֽיךָ, לֹא אֵל הִקְדִּימָךְ / וּבִמְלַאכְתְּךָ אֵין זָר עִמָּךְ.


*Cong:* No god preceded You, / and in Your creation, no stranger collaborated with You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 308

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/308](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/308)


*ש״ץ:* לֹא נוֹעַֽצְתָּ וְלֹא לֻמַּֽדְתָּ / בְּחַדֶּשְׁךָ בְּרִיּוֹת, כִּי נְבִינֽוֹתָ.


*Leader:* You did not receive counsel and were not instructed / when, in Your own great insight, You invented creatures.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 309

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/309](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/309)


*קהל:* מִמַּעֲמַקֵּי מַחְשְׁבוֹתֶֽיךָ / וּמִלִּבְּךָ, כָּל פְּעֻלּוֹתֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* From within the depths of Your thoughts / and heart, came all Your actions.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 310

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/310](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/310)

*Leader:* some of Your ways; / we have recognized You through some of Your deeds.
Indeed, we are familiar


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 311

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/311](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/311)
