*Cong:* For You are the God who created all / alone, yet nothing was diminished from Your greatness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 312

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/312](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/312)


*ש״ץ:* לַעֲשׂוֹת מְלַאכְתְּךָ, לֹא לֻחַֽצְתָּ / וְגַם לְעֵֽזֶר לֹא נִצְרָֽכְתָּ.


*Leader:* You were not pressed to perform Your work; / neither did You require the help of others.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 313

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/313](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/313)


*קהל:* כִּי הָיִֽיתָ לִפְנֵי הַכֹּל / וְאָז בְּאֵין כֹּל, לֹא נִצְרַֽכְתָּ כֹּל.


*Cong:* For You existed before all, / and even then You needed nothing.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 314

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/314](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/314)


*ש״ץ:* כִּי מֵאַהֲבָתְךָ עֲבָדֶֽיךָ / כֹּל בָּרָֽאתָ לִכְבוֹדֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* For out of love for Your servants, / You created all for Your glory.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 315

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/315](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/315)


*קהל:* וְלֹא נוֹדַע אֵל זוּלָתֶֽךָ / וְאֵין כָּמֽוֹךָ וְאֵין בִּלְתֶּֽךָ.


*Cong:* And no God but You exists; / none is like You and there is none but You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 316

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/316](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/316)


*ש״ץ:* וְלֹא נִשְׁמַע מִן אָז וָהָֽלְאָה / וְלֹא קָם וְלֹא נִהְיָה וְלֹא נִרְאָה.


*Leader:* No other has been heard of from that time onwards; none has risen or existed nor been seen.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 317

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/317](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/317)


*קהל:* וְגַם אַחֲרֶֽיךָ לֹא יִהְיֶה אֵל / רִאשׁוֹן וְאַחֲרוֹן, אֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל.


*Cong:* And after You, there will be no other god – / the God of Israel is both first and last!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 318

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/318](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/318)


*ש״ץ:* בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה, יָחִיד וּמְיֻחָד / יהוה אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:


*Leader:* Blessed are You, unique and singular One; / The Lord is One and His name is One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 319

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/319](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/319)


*קהל:* אֲשֶׁר מִי יַעֲשֶׂה כִּמְלַאכְתֶּֽךָ / כְּמַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ וְכִגְבוּרֹתֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* For who can perform works, / deeds and mighty miracles such as Yours?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 320

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/320](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/320)


*ש״ץ:* אֵין יְצִיר זוּלַת יְצִירָתֶֽךָ / וְאֵין בְּרִיאָה כִּי אִם בְּרִיאָתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* No creation exists but Yours, / and no work exists but Yours alone.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 321

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/321](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/321)


*קהל:* כָּל אֲשֶׁר תַּחְפּוֹץ, תַּעֲשֶׂה בַכֹּל / כִּי אַתָּה נַעֲלֵֽיתָ עַל כֹּל.


*Cong:* You do whatever You desire with regard to all, / for You are exalted above all.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 322

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/322](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/322)


*ש״ץ:* אֵין כָּמֽוֹךָ וְאֵין בִּלְתֶּֽךָ / כִּי אֵין אֱלֹהִים זוּלָתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* There is none like You and none other than You, / for there is no God but You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 323

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/323](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/323)


*קהל:* אַתָּה הָאֵל עֹֽשֵׂה פֶֽלֶא: / וְדָבָר מִמְּךָ לֹא יִפָּלֵא.


*Cong:* You, God, work wonders; / nothing is beyond You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 324

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/324](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/324)


*ש״ץ:* מִי כָמֽוֹךָ נוֹרָא תְהִלּוֹת / אֱלֹהִים לְבַדְּךָ עוֹשֶׂה גְדוֹלוֹת.


*Leader:* Who is like You, awesome in praises? / You alone, God, perform great miracles.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 325

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/325](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/325)


*קהל:* אֵין אוֹתוֹת כְּמוֹ אוֹתוֹתֶֽיךָ / אַף אֵין מוֹפֵת כְּמוֹ מוֹפְתֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* There are no miracles like Your miracles, / no wonders like Your wonders.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 326

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/326](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/326)


*ש״ץ:* אֵין תְּבוּנָה כִּתְבוּנָתֶֽךָ / אֵין גְּדֻלָּה כִּגְדֻלָּתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* There is no insight like Your insight, / no greatness like Your greatness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 327

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/327](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/327)


*קהל:* כִּי מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבוֹתֶֽיךָ / וְגָבְהוּ דַּרְכֵי אָרְחוֹתֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* For Your thoughts are very deep; / the ways of Your conduct are lofty.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 328

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/328](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/328)


*ש״ץ:* אֵין גַּאֲוָה כְּמוֹ גַּאֲוָתֶֽךָ / אַף אֵין עֲנָוָה כְּעַנְוָתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* There is no majesty like Your majesty, / no humility like Your humility.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 329

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/329](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/329)


*קהל:* אֵין קְדֻשָּׁה כִּקְדֻשָּׁתֶֽךָ / אֵין קְרֵבוּת כְּמוֹ קְרֵבוּתֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* There is no holiness like Your holiness, / no nearness like Your nearness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 330

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/330](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/330)


*ש״ץ:* אֵין צְדָקָה כְּמוֹ צִדְקָתֶֽךָ / אֵין תְּשׁוּעָה כִּתְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* There is no righteousness like Your righteousness, / no salvation like Your salvation.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 331

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/331](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/331)


*קהל:* אֵין זְרֽוֹעַ כִּזְרוֹעוֹתֶֽיךָ / אֵין קוֹל כְּרַֽעַם גְּבוּרוֹתֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* There is no strong arm like Your strong arm, / no sound as loud as Your mighty thunder.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 332

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/332](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/332)


*ש״ץ:* אֵין רַחֲמִים כְּרַחֲמָנוּתֶֽךָ / אֵין חֲנִינוּת כַּחֲנִינוּתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* There is no mercy like Your mercy, / no compassion like Your compassion.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 333

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/333](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/333)


*קהל:* אֵין אֱלָהוּת כֵּאלָהוּתֶֽךָ / וְאֵין מַפְלִיא כְּשֵׁם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ.


*Cong:* There is no divinity like Your divinity; / none can do wonders as can Your glorious name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 334

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/334](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/334)


*ש״ץ:* כִּי שְׁמוֹתֶֽיךָ אֵלִים מְרוּצִים / בְּזָכְרְךָ לְחוּצִים, לְהַפְלִיא נְחוּצִים.


*Leader:* For in Your name the angels make haste, / to work wonders for Your oppressed people when You remember them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 335

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/335](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/335)


*קהל:* וְאַשָּׁף וְחַרְטֹם לֹא יְלַחֲצֽוּךָ / וְכָל שֵׁם וְלַֽהַט לֹא יְנַצְּחֽוּךָ.


*Cong:* Enchanters and sorcerers do not press You; / no spell or enchantment can defeat You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 336

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/336](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/336)


*ש״ץ:* לֹא יְנַצְּחֽוּךָ כָּל הַחֲכָמִים / כָּל הַקּוֹסְמִים וְהַחַרְטֻמִּים.


*Leader:* Even all shrewd men could never defeat You, / nor magicians and sorcerers.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 337

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/337](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/337)


*קהל:* אַתָּה מֵשִׁיב לְאָחוֹר חֲכָמִים / לֹא יוּכְלוּ לְךָ עֲרוּמִים וְקוֹסְמִים.


*Cong:* You leave wise men dumbfounded; / crafty men and magicians could never overpower You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 338

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/338](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/338)


*ש״ץ:* לְהָשִׁיב לְאָחוֹר מְזִמּוֹתֶֽיךָ / לְהָפֵר עֲצַת סוֹד גְּזֵרָתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* None could reverse Your plans / or void the counsel of Your concealed decrees.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 339

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/339](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/339)


*קהל:* מֵרְצוֹנְךָ לֹא יַעֲבִירֽוּךָ / לֹא יְמַהֲרֽוּךָ וְלֹא יְאַחֲרֽוּךָ.


*Cong:* You shall never be swayed from Your will; / none can cause You to hasten or delay it.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 340

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/340](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/340)


*ש״ץ:* עֲצָתְךָ תָּפֵר עֲצַת כָּל יוֹעֲצִים / וְעֻזְּךָ מַחֲלִישׁ לֵב אַמִּיצִים.


*Leader:* Your counsel shall void the counsel of all advisrs; / Your might weakens the hearts of brave men.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 341

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/341](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/341)


*קהל:* אַתָּה מְצַוֶּה, וּפַחְדְּךָ מַשְׁוֶה / וְאֵין עָלֶֽיךָ פָּקִיד וּמְצַוֶּה.


*Cong:* You alone command all; Your dread straightens the paths of men; / no one gives You orders or commands You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 342

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/342](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/342)


*ש״ץ:* אַתָּה מִקְוֶה וְאֵינְךָ מְקַוֶּה / לְךָ כָּל מְקַוֶּה נֶֽפֶשׁ תִּרְוֶה.


*Leader:* You are the hope of all – but You do not hope; / You satiate all souls who await You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 343

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/343](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/343)


*קהל:* וְכָל הַיְצוּרִים וְכָל עִנְיָנָם / וְכָל יְקָר אֲשֶׁר בְּךָ, אֵין דִּמְיוֹנָם.


*Cong:* And all creatures and all that is theirs – / Your honor cannot be fathomed.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 344

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/344](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/344)


*ש״ץ:* לֹא מַחְשְׁבוֹתָם מַחְשְׁבוֹתֶֽיךָ / כִּי אֵין בּוֹרֵא זוּלָתֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* Your thoughts are not like their thoughts, / for there is no creator but You alone.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 345

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/345](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/345)


*קהל:* לְאֵין דִּמְיוֹן, נִפְלָא אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ / לְאֵין חֵֽקֶר, נִשְׂגָּב אֲדוֹנֵֽנוּ.


*Cong:* Our God is extraordinary and cannot be compared; / no one can grasp our Master’s loftiness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 346

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/346](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/346)


*ש״ץ:* סָתוּר מִכָּל סָתוּר, וְעָמוּס / מִכָּל עָמוּס, וּמִכָּל כָּמוּס.


*Leader:* He is the most hidden of all hidden, concealed / of all concealed, and of all enshrouded.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 347

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/347](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/347)


*קהל:* דַּק מִכָּל דַּק, וְצָפוּן מִכָּל / צָפוּן, וְיָכוֹל מִכָּל יָכוֹל.


*Cong:* More veiled than anything veiled; more deeply encrypted than anything encrypted; more powerful than any powerful being.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 348

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/348](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/348)


*ש״ץ:* נִשְׂגָּב מִכָּל נִשְׂגָּב, וְנֶעְלָם / מִכָּל נֶעְלָם, וּשְׁמוֹ לְעוֹלָם.


*Leader:* Exalted above all that is exalted; more mysterious / than any mysterious thing; His name is everlasting.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 349

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/349](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/349)


*קהל:* גָּבֽוֹהַּ מִכָּל גָּבֽוֹהַּ, וְעֶלְיוֹן / מִכָּל עֶלְיוֹן וּמִכָּל חֶבְיוֹן.


*Cong:* Higher than the highest being, loftier / than all lofty and all unknowable.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 350

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/350](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/350)


*ש״ץ:* חָבוּי וְעָמוּק מִכָּל עָמוּק / לֵב כָּל דַּֽעַת עָלָיו חָמוּק.


*Leader:* Concealed, deeper than the deepest; / His knowledge shall evade the heart of he who attempts to know Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 351

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/351](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/351)


*קהל:* שֶׁאֵין שֵֽׂכֶל וּמַדָּע וְחָכְמָה / יְכוֹלִים לְהַשְׁוֹת לוֹ כָּל מְאֽוּמָה.


*Cong:* For intellect, knowledge and wisdom / lack the power to attribute anything to Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 352

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/352](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/352)


*ש״ץ:* לֹא מַשִּׂיגִים לוֹ אֵיךְ וְכַמֶּה / לֹא מוֹצְאִים לוֹ דָּבָר דּוֹמֶה.


*Leader:* They are incapable of grasping His quality and quantity; / they cannot find any semblance of Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 353

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/353](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/353)


*קהל:* מִקְרֶה וְעַרְעַר וְשִׁנּוּי וְטָפֵל / וְחֶֽבֶר וּמִסְמַךְ, אוֹר וְגַם אֹֽפֶל.


*Cong:* Nor can they attribute to Him chance or temporality; change or subordinacy, / attachment to another or dependence, physical light or darkness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 354

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/354](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/354)


*ש״ץ:* וְלֹא מוֹצְאִים לוֹ מַרְאֶה וְצֶֽבַע / וְלֹא כָל טֶֽבַע אֲשֶׁר שֵׁשׁ וָשֶֽׁבַע.


*Leader:* They cannot attach to Him an appearance or color; nor any natural thing that is six [like the movements] or seven [like the physical quantities].


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 355

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/355](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/355)


*קהל:* לָכֵן נְבוּכוֹת כָּל עֶשְׁתּוֹנוֹת / וְנִבְהָלוֹת כָּל הַחֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹת.


*Cong:* Therefore, all human thought is confused, / all calculations disturbed.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 356

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/356](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/356)


*ש״ץ:* וְכָל שַׂרְעַפִּים וְכָל הַרְהוֹרִים / נִלְאִים לָשׂוּם בּוֹ שִׁעוּרִים.


*Leader:* All thoughts and reflections / are powerless to apply measurements to Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 357

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/357](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/357)


*קהל:* מִלְּשַׁעֲרֵֽהוּ וּמִלְּהַגְבִּילֵֽהוּ / מִלְּתָאֳרֵֽהוּ וּמִלְּפַרְסְמֵֽהוּ.


*Cong:* And cannot assess or apply limits to Him, / nor describe Him or expose Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 358

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/358](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/358)


*ש״ץ:* בְּכָל שִׂכְלֵֽנוּ חִפַּשְׂנֽוּהוּ / בְּמַדָּעֵֽנוּ, לִמְצוֹא מַה הוּא.


*Leader:* With all our intellect we have searched for Him, / trying with our knowledge to discover what He is.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 359

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/359](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/359)


*קהל:* לֹא מְצָאנֽוּהוּ וְלֹא יְדַעְנֽוּהוּ / אַךְ מִמַּעֲשָׂיו הִכַּרְנֽוּהוּ.


*Cong:* We have not discovered His nature nor have we become familiar with Him, / but we have recognized Him from His deeds.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 360

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/360](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/360)


*ש״ץ:* שֶׁהוּא לְבַדּוֹ יוֹצֵר אֶחָד / חַי וְכֹל יוּכַל וְחָכָם מְיֻחָד.


*Leader:* For He alone is the sole Creator, / a living, omnipotent Being, uniquely wise.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 361

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/361](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/361)


*קהל:* כִּי הוּא הָיָה לַכֹּל קֹֽדֶם / עַל כֵּן נִקְרָא אֱלֹהֵי קֶֽדֶם.


*Cong:* For He existed before all, / therefore He is called the ancient God.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 362

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/362](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/362)


*ש״ץ:* בַּעֲשׂוֹתוֹ בְּלִי כֹל אֶת הַכֹּל / יָדַֽעְנוּ כִּי הוּא כֹּל יָכוֹל.


*Leader:* He created all from nothingness; / we know that He is omnipotent.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 363

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/363](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/363)


*קהל:* בַּאֲשֶׁר מַעֲשָׂיו, בְּחָכְמָה כֻּלָּם / יָדַֽעְנוּ כִּי בְּבִינָה פְעָלָם.


*Cong:* All His works are performed with wisdom; / we know they are a result of insight.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 364

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/364](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/364)


*ש״ץ:* בְּכָל יוֹם וָיוֹם, בְּחַדְּשׁוֹ כֻלָּם / יָדַֽעְנוּ כִּי הוּא אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם.


*Leader:* When He renews creation each and every day, / we know that He is the God of the universe.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 365

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/365](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/365)


*קהל:* בַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה קֹֽדֶם לְכֻלָּם / יָדַֽעְנוּ כִּי הוּא חַי לְעוֹלָם.


*Cong:* Since He preceded all, / we know that He is everlasting.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 366

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/366](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/366)


*ש״ץ:* וְאֵין לְהַרְהֵר אַחַר יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ / בְּלִבֵּֽנוּ, וְלֹא בְּסִפּוּרֵֽנוּ.


*Leader:* One must not have doubts about our Creator, / neither in our hearts nor in our words.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 367

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/367](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/367)


*קהל:* לְמֶֽמֶשׁ וְגֹֽדֶשׁ לֹא נְשַׁעֲרֵֽהוּ / לְטָפֵל וְתֹֽאַר לֹא נְדַמֵּֽהוּ.


*Cong:* We shall not attribute physicality to Him; / we shall not ascribe to Him subordinacy or form.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 368

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/368](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/368)


*ש״ץ:* וְלֹא נְחַשְּׁבֵֽהוּ לְעִקָּר וְנִצָּב / וְלֹא לְמִין וְכָל אוֹן, וּלְכָל נִקְצָב.


*Leader:* We shall not consider Him to be in a sitting or standing position, / nor a natural species or defined power or limited being.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 369

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/369](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/369)


*קהל:* כָּל הַנִּרְאִים וְהַנִּשְׂכָּלִים / וְהַמַּדָּעִים בְּעֶֽשֶׂר כְּלוּלִים.


*Cong:* He is not like any of the visible beings who were granted intellect / and knowledge in the ten statements of creation.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 370

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/370](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/370)


*ש״ץ:* וְשֶֽׁבַע כַּמָּיוֹת וְשֵֽׁשֶׁת נִדּוֹת / וְשָׁלֹשׁ גְּזֵרוֹת וְעִתּוֹת וּמִדּוֹת.


*Leader:* Nor can He be defined within the seven physical quantities or six movements, / nor the three decreed characteristics, nor the times or measurements.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 371

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/371](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/371)


*קהל:* הֵן בַּבּוֹרֵא אֵין גַּם אֶחָד / כִּי הוּא בְּרָאָם כֻּלָּם יָֽחַד.


*Cong:* For the Creator has none of these, / since He created them all as one.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 372

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/372](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/372)


*ש״ץ:* כֻּלָּם יִבְלוּ, אַף יַחֲלֽוֹפוּ / הֵם יֹאבֵֽדוּ וְאַף יָסֽוּפוּ.


*Leader:* All will shrivel and pass; / they shall perish and come to an end.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 373

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/373](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/373)


*קהל:* וְאַתָּה תַעֲמֹד וּתְבַלֶּה כֻּלָּם / כִּי חַי וְקַיָּם אַתָּה לְעוֹלָם.


*Cong:* But You shall rise up and waste them away, / for You are forever alive and shall endure.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 375

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/375](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/375)


*ש״ץ:* אַתָּה לְבַדְּךָ, יוֹצֵר כֹּל הוּא / וְלֹא יִדְמֶה מַעֲשֶׂה לְעוֹשֵֽׂהוּ.


*Leader:* You alone are the Creator of all things; / Your works cannot be like their Maker.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 376

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/376](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/376)


*קהל:* כָּל הָאֲרָצוֹת לֹא יְכִילֽוּךָ / וְאַף שָׁמַֽיִם לֹא יְכַלְכְּלֽוּךָ.


*Cong:* All lands cannot contain You, / nor can the heavens sustain You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 377

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/377](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/377)


*ש״ץ:* אָז יָחִֽילוּ מַֽיִם חַיִּים / מִפָּנֶֽיךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים.


*Leader:* The living waters then whirled about / in fear of You, O living God.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 378

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/378](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/378)


*קהל:* רָעֲשָׁה אֶֽרֶץ, וְנָֽסוּ מַֽיִם / וְנָטְפוּ מַֽיִם אַף שָׁמָֽיִם.


*Cong:* The earth quaked and the waters took flight; / even the sky dropped water from above.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 379

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/379](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/379)


*ש״ץ:* נוֹטֶה לְבַדְּךָ הַשָּׁמַֽיִם / רֹקַע הָאָֽרֶץ עַל־הַמָּֽיִם:


*Leader:* You alone spread out the heavens, / extended the earth above the waters.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 380

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/380](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/380)


*קהל:* עָשִֽׂיתָ כָל חֶפְצְךָ לְבַדְּךָ / וְלֹא נִצְרַֽכְתָּ עֵֽזֶר כְּנֶגְדְּךָ.


*Cong:* You created all You desired alone; / You did not need a helpmate.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 381

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/381](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/381)


*ש״ץ:* סוֹעֵד, אֵין מִי יִסְעָדֶֽךָ / הַכֹּל מִמְּךָ וּמִיָּדֶֽךָ.


*Leader:* Provider, no one can provide for You; / all is from You, and from Your own hand.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 382

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/382](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/382)


*קהל:* כְּכֹחֲךָ אָז כֵּן עַתָּה, וְדַעְתָּךְ / וּלְעוֹלָם כָּל כְּבוֹדְךָ אִתָּךְ.


*Cong:* Your strength and knowledge now is the same as it was then; / Your glory is always with You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 383

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/383](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/383)


*ש״ץ:* וְלֹא יָעַֽפְתָּ וְלֹא יָגַֽעְתָּ / כִּי בִמְלַאכְתְּךָ לֹא עָמָֽלְתָּ.


*Leader:* And You were never tired or weary, / for You did not toil in Your work.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 384

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/384](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/384)


*קהל:* כִּי בִדְבָרְךָ כָּל יְצוּרֶֽיךָ / וּמַעֲשֵׂה חֶפְצְךָ בְּמַאֲמָרֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* For all creatures were formed by Your speech; / all You desired was made by Your word.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 385

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/385](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/385)


*ש״ץ:* וְלֹא אִחַרְתּוֹ וְלֹא מִהַרְתּוֹ / הַכֹּל עֲשִׂיתוֹ יָפֶה בְעִתּוֹ.


*Leader:* And You did not delay nor hasten a thing; / You created everything beautifully in its proper time.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 386

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/386](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/386)


*קהל:* מִבְּלִי מְאֽוּמָה כֹּל חִדַּֽשְׁתָּ / וְאֶת הַכֹּל בְּלִי כְלִי פָּעָֽלְתָּ.


*Cong:* Without anything You renewed all; / You formed everything without tools.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 387

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/387](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/387)


*ש״ץ:* וְעַל לֹא יְסוֹד, הַכֹּל יָסַֽדְתָּ / בִּרְצוֹן רוּחֲךָ כֹּל תָּלִֽיתָ.


*Leader:* You established everything without foundations; / You suspended everything with the will of Your spirit.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 388

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/388](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/388)


*קהל:* זְרוֹעוֹת עוֹלָם אֶת כֹּל נוֹשְׂאוֹת / מֵרֹאשׁ וְעַד סוֹף וְאֵינָם נִלְאוֹת.


*Cong:* Your arms carry the entire universe / from beginning to end; they never tire.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 389

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/389](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/389)


*ש״ץ:* בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ לֹא דָבָר הֻקְשָׁה / רְצוֹנְךָ כָּל דְּבַר, רוּחֲךָ עוֹשָׂה.


*Leader:* In Your eyes, nothing is too difficult; / anything You desire, Your spirit .
does


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 390

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/390](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/390)


*קהל:* לִפְעֻלָּתְךָ לֹא דָמִֽיתָ / אֶל כָּל תֹּֽאַר לֹא שָׁוִֽיתָ.


*Cong:* You are unlike Your creation; / You cannot be compared to any kind of form.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 391

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/391](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/391)


*ש״ץ:* וְלֹא קָדְמָה לִמְלַאכְתְּךָ מְלָאכָה / חָכְמָתְךָ הִיא הַכֹּל עָרְכָה.


*Leader:* No work preceded Yours; / Your wisdom arranged it all.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 392

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/392](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/392)

*Cong:* Nothing was before or after Your will; / nothing was added to or omitted from what You desired.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 393

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/393](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/393)

*Leader:* Of all You desired, You forgot nothing; / You did not omit a single thing.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 394

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/394](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/394)

*Cong:* You ; / You did not create anything useless.
did not omit or exceed


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 395

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/395](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/395)

*Leader:* You praised Your creations Yourself – who shall degrade them? / No inadequacy can be found among them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 396

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/396](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/396)

*Cong:* You began to make them with wisdom; / You completed them with insight and knowledge.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 397

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/397](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/397)


*ש״ץ:* מֵרֵאשִׁית וְעַד אַחֲרִית עֲשׂוּיִים / בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְיֹֽשֶׁר, וְטוֹב רְאוּיִים.


*Leader:* They are completely formed from beginning to end, / created with befitting truth, uprightness and goodness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 398

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/398](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/398)


*קהל:* הִקְדַּֽמְתָּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶֽיךָ / רֹב רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וַחֲסָדֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* You preceded Your handiwork / with great compassion and kindness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 399

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/399](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/399)


*ש״ץ:* כִּי רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וַחֲסָדֶֽיךָ / הֲלֹא מֵעוֹלָם עַל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ.


*Leader:* For Your compassion and kindness / have always been upon Your servants.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 400

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/400](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/400)


*קהל:* וְעַד לֹא כָּל חַי הוּכַן לְכַלְכֵּל / לִפְנֵי אוֹכֵל תִּתֵּן אֹֽכֶל.


*Cong:* And before You even created living beings, You created their sustenance; / before there was one who consumes, You provided nourishment.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 401

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/401](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/401)


*ש״ץ:* וּמָזוֹן וּמָכוֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּפִי כֹל / צָרְכֵי הַכֹּל, כַּאֲשֶׁר לַכֹּל.


*Leader:* You prepare food for all mouths; / You satisfy the needs of everything according to each being.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 402

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/402](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/402)

*Cong:* During the first three days of creation / You prepared all the needs of those who were to be created.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 403

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/403](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/403)


*ש״ץ:* אָז עָטִֽיתָ אוֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָה / אֵֽדֶר מְאוֹרוֹת מִמּוּל שַׂלְמָה.


*Leader:* You then robed Yourself in light like a garment, / the splendor of the luminaries opposite Your garment.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 404

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/404](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/404)


*קהל:* בְּטֶֽרֶם כָּל יְצוּר, מְאֹד גָּדַֽלְתָּ / וְאַחַר כֹּל, מְאֹד נִתְגַּדָּֽלְתָּ.


*Cong:* You were very great before any creature existed; / and after creation You became greater still.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 405

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/405](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/405)

*Leader:* Before garments existed, He donned splendor and honor; / before weavers came to be, He donned majesty.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 406

*Cong:* Like a robe or a cloak He dons light; / He spreads out the skies like a tent.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 407

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/407](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/407)

*Leader:* You created pathways for the luminaries, / and they move back and forth pleasantly.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 408

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/408](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/408)

*Cong:* You separated water from water / when You stretched out the firmament of the sky.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 409

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/409](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/409)

*Leader:* You created both nourishment and habitat for the swarming creatures of the water, / and birds that fly in the sky.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 410

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/410](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/410)


*קהל:* עֵֽשֶׂב וְחָצִיר לָבְשָׁה אֲדָמָה / מַאֲכָל לְחַיָּה וּלְכָל בְּהֵמָה.


*Cong:* The earth became clothed herbage and grass; / nourishment for wild animals and cattle.
with

*Leader:* You planted a garden in a lush corner / for the man You created.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 412

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/412](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/412)

*Cong:* You made for him a helpmate, / thus fulfilling all that he lacked.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 413

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/413](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/413)

*Leader:* You handed him domination over all Your creatures; / You placed him above all of them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 414

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/414](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/414)


*קהל:* לְהַעֲלוֹת מֵהֶם בָּקָר וָצֹאן / עַל מִזְבַּחֲךָ יַעֲלוּ לְרָצוֹן.


*Cong:* From them to offer up cattle and sheep / which were to be accepted by You on Your altar.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 415

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/415](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/415)


*ש״ץ:* עָשִֽׂיתָ לוֹ כְּתֹֽנֶת לְשָׁרֵת / לְהַדְרַת קֹֽדֶשׁ וּלְתִפְאָֽרֶת.


*Leader:* You made a cloak [of light] to serve You; / thereby granting him holy glory and majesty.
for him

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/416](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/416)

*Cong:* You placed the wisdom of God inside him, / for You created him for Yourself in the image of God.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 417

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/417](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/417)


*ש״ץ:* לֹא מָנַֽעְתָּ עַל פְּנֵי אֲדָמָה / צָרְכֵי אָדָם, וְכֻלָּם בְּחָכְמָה.


*Leader:* You did not omit from the face of the earth any of man’s needs; / all were created with wisdom.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 418

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/418](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/418)


*קהל:* מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ מְאֹד רַבּוּ וְגָדְלוּ / וְשִׁמְךָ יהוה, כֻּלָּם יְהַלְלוּ.


*Cong:* Your works have greatly increased and proliferated; / Your name, Lord, all shall praise.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 419

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/419](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/419)


*ש״ץ:* רַבּוּ וְגָדְלוּ מְאֹד מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ / יוֹדֽוּךָ יהוה כָּל־מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ:


*Leader:* Your works have greatly increased and proliferated; Lord, all Your creatures shall thank You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 420

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/420](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/420)


*קהל:* כֹּל פָּעַֽלְתָּ לַמַּעֲנֶֽךָ / וְלִכְבוֹדְךָ כָּל קִנְיָנֶֽךָ.


*Cong:* You created everything for Your own sake; / all You formed was for Your glory.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 422

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/422](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/422)


*ש״ץ:* אָז בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי נַֽחְתָּ / יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת, עַל כֵּן בֵּרָֽכְתָּ.


*Leader:* Long ago, You rested on the seventh day; / therefore, You blessed the Sabbath day.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 423

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/423](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/423)


*קהל:* וְעַל כָּל פֹּֽעַל תְּהִלָּה עֲרוּכָה / חֲסִידֶֽיךָ בְּכָל עֵת יְבָרְכֽוּכָה.


*Cong:* Praise is set forth for Your creation entire; / Your devoted ones shall bless You at all times.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 424

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/424](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/424)


*ש״ץ:* בָּרוּךְ יהוה יוֹצֵר כֻּלָּם / אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים וּמֶֽלֶךְ עוֹלָם:


*Leader:* Blessed is the Lord, Creator of all, / the living God, eternal King.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 425

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/425](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/425)


*קהל:* כִּי מֵעוֹלָם עַל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ / רֹב רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וַחֲסָדֶֽיךָ.


*Cong:* For always upon Your servants / is Your great compassion and kindness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 426

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/426](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/426)


*ש״ץ:* וּבְמִצְרַֽיִם הַחִלּֽוֹתָ / לְהוֹדִֽיעַ, כִּי מְאֹד נַעֲלֵֽיתָ.


*Leader:* In Egypt You began / to make it known that You are exalted
.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 427

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/427](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/427)


*קהל:* עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִים, בַּעֲשׂוֹת בָּהֶם / שְׁפָטִים גְּדֹלִים, וּבֵאלֹהֵיהֶם.


*Cong:* bove all gods, by working / great acts of judgment upon them and their gods
A
.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 428

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/428](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/428)


*ש״ץ:* בְּבָקְעֲךָ יַם סוּף, עַמְּךָ רָאוּ / הַיָּד הַגְּדוֹלָה, וַיִּירָֽאוּ.


*Leader:* When You split the Sea of Reeds, Your nation saw / Your great hand and they were awed.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 429

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/429](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/429)


*קהל:* נִהַֽגְתָּ עַמְּךָ, לַעֲשׂוֹת לָךְ / שֵׁם תִּפְאֶֽרֶת, לְהַרְאוֹת גָּדְלָךְ.


*Cong:* You led Your nation so as to create for Yourself / a glorious name, displaying Your greatness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 430

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/430](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/430)


*ש״ץ:* וְדִבַּֽרְתָּ עִמָּם מִן הַשָּׁמַֽיִם / וְגַם הֶעָבִים נָטְפוּ מָֽיִם.


*Leader:* And You spoke to them from the heavens [at Mount Sinai]; / the clouds dropped water.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 431

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/431](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/431)


*קהל:* יָדַֽעְתָּ לֶכְתָּם הַמִּדְבָּר / בְּאֶֽרֶץ צִיָּה, אִישׁ לֹא עָבָר.


*Cong:* You knew their wanderings in the desert, / in a parched land not traversed by any man.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 432

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/432](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/432)


*ש״ץ:* תַּֽתָּה לְעַמְּךָ דְּגַן שָׁמַֽיִם / וְכֶעָפָר שְׁאֵר, וּמִצּוּר מָֽיִם.


*Leader:* You gave Your people grain from heaven, / meat as plentiful as dust, and water from the rock.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 433

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/433](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/433)


*קהל:* תְּגָרֵשׁ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים, עַמִּים / יִירְשׁוּ אַרְצָם, וַעֲמַל לְאֻמִּים.


*Cong:* You banished many nations and peoples, / that Israel might inherit their land and the toil of nations.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 434

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/434](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/434)


*ש״ץ:* בַּעֲבוּר יִשְׁמְרוּ חֻקִּים וְתוֹרוֹת / אִמֲרוֹת יהוה אֲמָרוֹת טְהֹרוֹת:


*Leader:* That they might safeguard the laws and teachings; / the Lord’s utterances are all holy.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 435

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/435](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/435)


*קהל:* וַיִּתְעַדְּנוּ בְּמִרְעֶה שָׁמֵן / וּמֵחַלְמִישׁ צוּר פַּלְגֵי שָֽׁמֶן.


*Cong:* They luxuriated in fat pastures, / with streams of oil from flint rock.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 436

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/436](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/436)


*ש״ץ:* בְּנוּחָם בָּנוּ עִיר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ / וַיְפָאֲרוּ בֵּית מִקְדָּשֶֽׁךָ.


*Leader:* When they found rest, they built up Your holy city / and glorified Your holy Temple.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 437

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/437](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/437)


*קהל:* וַתֹּֽאמֶר, פֹּה אֵשֵׁב לְאֹֽרֶךְ / יָמִים, צֵידָהּ בָּרֵךְ אֲבָרֵךְ:


*Cong:* And You said: I shall dwell here for evermore, / I will surely bless its livelihood.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 438

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/438](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/438)


*ש״ץ:* כִּי שָׁם יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי צֶֽדֶק / אַף כֹּהֲנֶֽיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ צֶֽדֶק.


*Leader:* For there, they shall offer up righteous offerings; / Your priests shall also be clothed in righteousness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 439

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/439](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/439)


*קהל:* וּבֵית הַלֵּוִי נְעִימוֹת יְזַמְּרוּ / לְךָ יִתְרוֹעֲעוּ אַף יָשִֽׁירוּ.


*Cong:* And the house of Levi shall chant pleasant songs; / they shall ring out cries of joy and sing to You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 440

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/440](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/440)


*ש״ץ:* בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִרְאֵי יהוה / יְכַבְּדוּ וְיוֹדוּ שִׁמְךָ יהוה.


*Leader:* The house of Israel and those who fear the Lord / shall glorify and offer thanks to Your name, O Lord.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 441

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/441](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/441)


*קהל:* הֱטִיבֽוֹתָ מְאֹד לָרִאשׁוֹנִים / כֵּן תֵּיטִיב גַּם לָאַחֲרוֹנִים.


*Cong:* You dealt very kindly with the ancients of our nation; / deal kindly also with their descendants.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 442

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/442](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/442)


*ש״ץ:* יהוה תָּשִׂישׂ נָא עָלֵֽינוּ / כַּאֲשֶׁר שַֽׂשְׂתָּ עַל אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ.


*Leader:* O Lord, please rejoice over us / just as You rejoiced over our ancestors.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 443

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/443](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/443)


*קהל:* אוֹתָֽנוּ לְהַרְבּוֹת וּלְהֵיטִיב / וְנוֹדֶה לְךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי תֵיטִיב.


*Cong:* Do good for us and let us multiply, / and for this we shall forever thank You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 444

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/444](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/444)


*ש״ץ:* יהוה תִּבְנֶה עִירְךָ מְהֵרָה / כִּי עָלֶֽיהָ שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא.


*Leader:* O Lord, build Your city speedily, / for it carries Your name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 445

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/445](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/445)


*קהל:* וְקֶֽרֶן דָּוִד תַּצְמִֽיחַ בָּהּ / וְתִשְׁכּוֹן לְעוֹלָם יהוה בְּקִרְבָּהּ.


*Cong:* Raise up a ruler from the house of David in Your city; / O Lord, dwell in it forever.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 446

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/446](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/446)


*ש״ץ:* זִבְחֵי צֶֽדֶק שָֽׁמָּה נִזְבְּחָה / וְכִימֵי קֶֽדֶם תֶּעֱרַב מִנְחָה.


*Leader:* There, we shall offer up righteous offerings; / our meal-offerings shall be as pleasing to You as in days of old.

###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaYichud 454

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/454](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaYichud/r/454)


כַּכָּתוּב: בָּרוּךְ יהוה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָעוֹלָם וְעַד־הָעֹלָם, וַיֹּאמְרוּ כָל־הָעָם אָמֵן, וְהַלֵּל לַיהוה: עָנֵה דָנִיֵּאל וְאָמַר: לֶהֱוֵא שְׁמֵהּ דִּי־אֱלָהָא מְבָרַךְ מִן־עָלְמָא וְעַד־עָלְמָא, דִּי חָכְמְתָא וּגְבוּרְתָא דִּי־לֵהּ הִיא: וְנֶאֱמַר: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הַלְוִיִּם, יֵשֽׁוּעַ וְקַדְמִיאֵל בָּנִי חֲשַׁבְנְיָה שֵׁרֵבְיָה הוֹדִיָּה שְׁבַנְיָה פְתַחְיָה, קֽוּמוּ בָּרְכוּ אֶת־יהוה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִן־הָעוֹלָם עַד־הָעוֹלָם, וִיבָרְכוּ שֵׁם כְּבֹדֶֽךָ, וּמְרוֹמַם עַל־כָּל־בְּרָכָה וּתְהִלָּה: וְנֶאֱמַר: בָּרוּךְ יהוה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם, וְאָמַר כָּל־הָעָם אָמֵן, הַלְלוּיָהּ: וְנֶאֱמַר: וַיְבָֽרֶךְ דָּוִיד אֶת־יהוה לְעֵינֵי כָּל־הַקָּהָל, וַיֹּֽאמֶר דָּוִיד, בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִֽינוּ, מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד־עוֹלָם:


As it is written: Blessed is the Lord, God of Israel, from this world to eternity. And let all the people say “Amen” and “Praise the Lord.” Daniel said, “Blessed be the name of the Lord from this world to eternity, for wisdom and might belong to Him.” And it is said: The Levites – Yeshua and Kadmiel, Bani, Ḥashavneya, Sherevia, Hodia, Shevania and Petaḥia – said, “Rise up and bless the Lord your God, from this world to eternity; may they bless Your glorious name, exalted above all blessing and praise.” And it is said, Blessed is the Lord, God of Israel, from this world to eternity. And all the people said, “Amen, Halleluya.” And it is said, David blessed the Lord in front of the entire assembley. David said, “Blessed are You, Lord, God of our father Yisrael, from this world to eternity.”

*אבל:* יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא (*קהל:* אָמֵן)
בְּעָלְמָא דִּי בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ
וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ
בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְּכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל
בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן. (*קהל:* אָמֵן)


*Mourner:* יִתְגַּדַּל Magnified and sanctified
may His great name be,
in the world He created by His will.
May He establish His kingdom
in your lifetime and in your days,
and in the lifetime
of all the house of Israel,
swiftly and soon – and say: Amen.

וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל
שְׁמֵהּ דְּקֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא (*קהל:* בְּרִיךְ הוּא)

דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן. (*קהל:* אָמֵן)

raised and honored, uplifted and lauded

song, praise and consolation
uttered in the world – and say: Amen.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/9)

*Cong:* They depicted You, though not as You are, but as You do: Your acts, Your power.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/10)

*Leader:* They represented You in many visions; through them all You are One without divisions.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/11)

*Cong:* They saw You, now old, then young, Your head with gray, with black hair hung.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/12)

*Leader:* Age on the day of judgment, yet on the day of war, a young warrior with mighty hands they saw.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/13)

*Cong:* Triumph like a helmet He wore on his head; His right hand and holy arm to victory have led.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/14)

*Leader:* His curls are filled with dewdropsof light, His locks with fragments of the night.
-

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/15)

*Cong:* He will glory in me, for He delights in me; My diadem of beauty He shall be.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/16)

*Leader:* His head is like pure beaten gold; Engraved on His brow, His sacred name behold.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/17)

*Cong:* For grace and glory, beauty and renown, His people have adorned Him with a crown.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/18)

*Leader:* Like a youth’s, His hair in locks unfurls; Its black tresses flowing in curls.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/19)


*קהל:* נְוֵה הַצֶּֽדֶק צְבִי תִפְאַרְתּוֹ, יַעֲלֶה נָּא עַל רֹאשׁ שִׂמְחָתוֹ.


*Cong:* Jerusalem, His splendor, is the dwelling place of right; may He prize it as His highest delight.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/20)

*Leader:* Like a crown in His hand may His treasured people be, a turban of beauty and of majesty.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/21)

*Cong:* He bore them, carried them, with a crown He adorned them. They were precious in His sight, and He honored them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/22)

*Leader:* His glory is on me; my glory is on Him. He is near to me when I call to Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 23

*קהל:* צַח וְאָדֹם לִלְבוּשׁוֹ אָדֹם, פּוּרָה בְדָרְכוֹ בְּבוֹאוֹ מֵאֱדוֹם.


*Cong:* He is bright and rosy; red will be His dress, when He comes from Edom, treading the winepress.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/24)

*Leader:* He showed the tefillin-knot to Moses, humble, wise, when the LORD’s likeness was before his eyes.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/25)

*Cong:* He delights in His people; the humble He does raise – He glories in them; He sits enthroned upon their praise.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/26)


*ש״ץ:* רֹאשׁ דְּבָרְךָ אֱמֶת קוֹרֵא מֵרֹאשׁ, דּוֹר וָדוֹר עַם דּוֹרֶשְׁךָ דְּרֹשׁ.


*Leader:* Your first word, Your call to every age, is true: O seek the people who seek You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/27)

*Cong:* My many songs please take and hear and may my hymn of joy to You come near.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Yom Kippur Evening, Shir HaKavod 28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Yom%20Kippur%20Evening,_Shir%20HaKavod/r/28)
