###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Blessings of the Shema 47

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Blessings%20of%20the%20Shema/r/47](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Blessings%20of%20the%20Shema/r/47)


וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יהו֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ, בְּכָל־לְבָֽבְךָ֥ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ׃ וְהָי֞וּ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה, אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָֽנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם, עַל־לְבָבֶֽךָ׃ וְשִׁנַּנְתָּ֣ם לְבָנֶ֔יךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֖ בָּ֑ם, בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ, וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃ וּקְשַׁרְתָּ֥ם לְא֖וֹת עַל־יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהָי֥וּ לְטֹֽטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽיךָ׃ וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזֻז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃


וְאָהַבְתָּ Love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might. These words which I command you today shall be on your heart. Teach them repeatedly to your children, speaking of them when you sit at home and when you travel on the way, when you lie down and when you rise. Bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be an emblem between your eyes. Write them on the doorposts of your house and gates.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Blessings of the Shema 48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Blessings%20of%20the%20Shema/r/48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Blessings%20of%20the%20Shema/r/48)


וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֹתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָֽנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם, לְאַֽהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יהו֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ וּלְעָבְד֔וֹ, בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃ וְנָֽתַתִּ֧י מְטַֽר־אַרְצְכֶ֛ם בְּעִתּ֖וֹ, יוֹרֶ֣ה וּמַלְק֑וֹשׁ, וְאָֽסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔ךָ וְתִירֹֽשְׁךָ֖ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ׃ וְנָֽתַתִּ֛י עֵ֥שֶׂב בְּשָֽׂדְךָ֖ לִבְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ, וְאָֽכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃ הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם פֶּן־יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְכֶ֑ם, וְסַרְתֶּ֗ם וַֽעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃ וְחָרָ֨ה אַף־יהו֜ה בָּכֶ֗ם, וְעָצַ֤ר אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלֹא־יִֽהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר, וְהָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן אֶת־יְבוּלָ֑הּ, וַֽאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יהו֖ה נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃ וְשַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרַ֣י אֵ֔לֶּה עַל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וְעַֽל־נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם, וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤ם לְאוֹת֙ עַל־יֶדְכֶ֔ם, וְהָי֥וּ לְטֽוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵֽינֵיכֶֽם׃ וְלִמַּדְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֛ם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְדַבֵּ֣ר בָּ֑ם, בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ, וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃ וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזוּז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃ לְמַ֨עַן יִרְבּ֤וּ יְמֵיכֶם֙ וִימֵ֣י בְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יהו֛ה לַֽאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם, כִּימֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃


וְהָיָה If you indeed heed My commandments with which I charge you today, to love the LORD your God and worship Him with all your heart and with all your soul, I will give rain in your land in its season, the early and late rain; and you shall gather in your grain, wine and oil. I will give grass in your field for your cattle, and you shall eat and be satisfied. Be careful lest your heart be tempted and you go astray and worship other gods, bowing down to them. Then the LORD’s anger will flare against you and He will close the heavens so that there will be no rain. The land will not yield its crops, and you will perish swiftly from the good land that the LORD is giving you. Therefore, set these, My words, on your heart and soul. Bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be an emblem between your eyes. Teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit at home and when you travel on the way, when you lie down and when you rise. Write them on the doorposts of your house and gates, so that you and your children may live long in the land that the LORD swore to your ancestors to give them, for as long as the heavens are above the earth.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Blessings of the Shema 50

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Blessings%20of%20the%20Shema/r/50](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Blessings%20of%20the%20Shema/r/50)


וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יהו֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם, וְעָשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֥ם °צִיצִ֛ת עַל־כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם לְדֹֽרֹתָ֑ם, וְנָֽתְנ֛וּ °עַל־צִיצִ֥ת הַכָּנָ֖ף פְּתִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃ וְהָיָ֣ה לָכֶם֮ °לְצִיצִת֒, וּרְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹת֗וֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹ֣ת יהו֔ה וַֽעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם, וְלֹ֨א תָת֜וּרוּ אַֽחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַֽחֲרֵ֣י עֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם, אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַֽחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃ לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַֽעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתָ֑י, וִֽהְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵאלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם׃ אֲנִ֞י יהו֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם, אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם, לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים, אֲנִ֖י יהו֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם׃


וַיֹּֽאמֶר The LORD spoke to Moses, saying: Speak to the Israelites and tell them to make °tassels on the corners of their garments for all generations. They shall attach to the °tassel at each corner a thread of blue. This shall be your °tassel, and you shall see it and remember all of the LORD’s commandments and keep them, not straying after your heart and after your eyes, following your own sinful desires. Thus you will be reminded to keep all My commandments, and be holy to your God. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God.
I am the LORD your God.

וְיַצִּיב, וְנָכוֹן וְקַיָּם, וְיָשָׁר וְנֶאֱמָן

וְנוֹרָא וְאַדִּיר, וּמְתֻקָּן וּמְקֻבָּל, וְטוֹב וְיָפֶה

beloved, cherished, delightful, pleasant,
awesome, mighty, perfect, accepted,
good and beautiful
is this faith for us for ever.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Blessings of the Shema 55

וּמַלְכוּתוֹ וֶאֱמוּנָתוֹ לָעַד קַיֶּֽמֶת.

°לָעַד וּלְעוֹלְמֵי עוֹלָמִים
עַל אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ וְעָלֵֽינוּ
עַל בָּנֵֽינוּ וְעַל דּוֹרוֹתֵֽינוּ
וְעַל כָּל דּוֹרוֹת זֶֽרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ.

אֱמֶת שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ

בְּרוּם עוֹלָם מוֹשָׁבֶֽךָ
וּמִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ עַד אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ.

וּמִבֵּית עֲבָדִים פְּדִיתָֽנוּ
כָּל בְּכוֹרֵיהֶם הָרַֽגְתָּ, וּבְכוֹרְךָ גָּאָֽלְתָּ

וִידִידִים הֶעֱבַֽרְתָּ

From Egypt You redeemed us, LORD our God,
and from the slave-house You delivered us.

You brought Your beloved ones across.
The water covered their foes; not one of them was left.

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ

וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ

וְיִירָאֽוּךָ כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים
וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ כָּל הַבְּרוּאִים
וְיֵעָשׂוּ כֻלָּם אֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם
כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַֽעְנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ שֶׁהַשָּׁלְטָן לְפָנֶֽיךָ
עֹז בְּיָדְךָ וּגְבוּרָה בִּימִינֶֽךָ
וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָֽאתָ.


וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ And so place the fear of You, LORD our God,
over all that You have made,
and the terror of You over all You have created,
and all who were made will stand in awe of You,
and all of creation will worship You
and they will be bound all together as one
to carry out Your will with an undivided heart;
for we know, LORD our God,
that all dominion is laid out before You,
strength is in Your palm,
and might in Your right hand,
Your name spreading awe
over all You have created.

בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ.


וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד And so place honor,
LORD, upon Your people,
praise on those who fear You
and hope into those who seek You,
the confidence to speak
into all who long for You,
gladness to Your land and joy to Your city,
the flourishing of pride to David Your servant,
and a lamp laid out for his descendant, Your anointed,
soon, in our days.

וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ, וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ

אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים
אָהַֽבְתָּ אוֹתָֽנוּ וְרָצִֽיתָ בָּֽנוּ וְרוֹמַמְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת
וְקִדַּשְׁתָּֽנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ
וְקֵרַבְתָּֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶֽךָ
וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵֽינוּ קָרָֽאתָ.


אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ You have chosen us from among all peoples.
You have loved and favored us.
You have raised us above all tongues.
You have made us holy through Your commandments.
You have brought us near, our King, to Your service,
and have called us by Your great and holy name.

וַתִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה אֶת
(יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה לִקְדֻשָּׁה וְלִמְנוּחָה, וְאֶת)
יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים הַזֶּה, לִמְחִילָה וְלִסְלִיחָה וּלְכַפָּרָה
וְלִמְחָל בּוֹ אֶת כָּל עֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ
(בְּאַהֲבָה) מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ, זֵֽכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָֽיִם.


וַתִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ And You, LORD our God, have given us in love
(this Sabbath day for holiness and rest, and)
this Day of Atonement
for pardon and forgiveness and atonement,
to pardon all our iniquities,
(with love,) a holy assembly
in memory of the exodus from Egypt.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, The Amida 23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/23)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
יַעֲלֶה וְיָבוֹא וְיַגִּֽיעַ, וְיֵרָאֶה וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע
וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר זִכְרוֹנֵֽנוּ וּפִקְדוֹנֵֽנוּ וְזִכְרוֹן אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
וְזִכְרוֹן מָשִֽׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ
וְזִכְרוֹן יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִיר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, לְפָנֶֽיךָ
לִפְלֵיטָה לְטוֹבָה, לְחֵן וּלְחֶֽסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים, לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם
בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים הַזֶּה
זָכְרֵֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה
וּפָקְדֵֽנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה
וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים.
וּבִדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים חוּס וְחָנֵּֽנוּ
וְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ
כִּי אֵלֶֽיךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ, כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה.


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our ancestors,
may there rise, come, reach, appear, be favored, heard,
regarded and remembered before You,
our recollection and remembrance,
as well as the remembrance of our ancestors,
and of the Messiah, son of David Your servant,
and of Jerusalem Your holy city,
and of all Your people the house of Israel –
for deliverance and well-being,
grace, loving-kindness and compassion,
life and peace, on this Day of Atonement.
On it remember us, LORD our God, for good;
recollect us for blessing, and deliver us for life.
In accord with Your promise
of salvation and compassion,
spare us and be gracious to us;
have compassion on us and deliver us,
for our eyes are turned to You
because You, God, are a gracious and compassionate King.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, The Amida 25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/25)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
מְחַל לַעֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ בְּיוֹם (הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וּבְיוֹם) הַכִּפּוּרִים הַזֶּה
מְחֵה וְהַעֲבֵר פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ
כָּאָמוּר
אָנֹכִי אָנֹכִי הוּא מֹחֶה פְשָׁעֶֽיךָ לְמַעֲנִי
וְחַטֹּאתֶֽיךָ לֹא אֶזְכֹּר׃
וְנֶאֱמַר
מָחִֽיתִי כָעָב פְּשָׁעֶֽיךָ וְכֶעָנָן חַטֹּאותֶֽיךָ
שׁוּבָה אֵלַי כִּי גְאַלְתִּֽיךָ׃
וְנֶאֱמַר
כִּי־בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם
מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם, לִפְנֵי יהוה תִּטְהָֽרוּ:
(אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵֽנוּ)
קַדְּשֵֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
שַׂבְּעֵֽנוּ מִטּוּבֶֽךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵֽנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ
(וְהַנְחִילֵֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
וְיָנֽוּחוּ בוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶֽךָ)
וְטַהֵר לִבֵּֽנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת
כִּי אַתָּה סָלְחָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל
וּמָחֳלָן לְשִׁבְטֵי יְשֻׁרוּן בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר
וּמִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה
מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ לַעֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ
וְלַעֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל
וּמַעֲבִיר אַשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ בְּכָל שָׁנָה וְשָׁנָה
מֶֽלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ, מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ) יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים.


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our ancestors,
pardon our iniquities
on (this Sabbath day, and on) this Day of Atonement;
wipe away and remove all our transgressions and sins
from before Your eyes,
as it is said:
“I, I am the One who shall wipe out your transgressions
for My sake, and I shall not recall your sins.”
And it is said:
“I have wiped out your transgressions like a cloud,
and as a haze your sins;
come back to Me for I have redeemed you.”
And it is said:
For on this day you will be atoned and made pure;
of all your sins before the LORD you shall be purified.
(Our God and God of our ancestors, find favor in our rest.)
Make us holy through Your commandments
and grant us our share in Your Torah.
Satisfy us with Your goodness,
grant us joy in Your salvation
(in love and favor, O LORD our God,
grant us as our heritage Your holy Sabbath,
so that Israel, who sanctify Your name,
may find rest on it),
and purify our hearts to serve You in truth.
For You are the Forgiver of Israel
and the Pardoner of the tribes of Yeshurun in every generation,
and without You we have no king who pardons and forgives,
none but You.
Blessed are You, LORD,
King who pardons and forgives our iniquities
and those of all His people the house of Israel,
and makes our guilt pass away, every single year,
King of all the earth, who sanctifies (the Sabbath,)
Israel and the Day of Atonement.

רְצֵה יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִתְפִלָּתָם
וְהָשֵׁב אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶֽךָ
וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם בְּאַהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן
וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ.
וְתֶחֱזֶֽינָה עֵינֵֽינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן.


רְצֵה Find favor, LORD our God,
in Your people Israel and their prayer.
Restore the service to Your most holy House,
and accept in love and favor
the fire-offerings of Israel and their prayer.
May the service of Your people Israel always find favor with You.
And may our eyes witness Your return to Zion in compassion.
Blessed are You, LORD,
who restores His Presence to Zion.

###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, The Amida 30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/30)


מוֹדִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ לָךְ
שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
צוּר חַיֵּֽינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ, אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר.
נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ, עַל חַיֵּֽינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶֽךָ
וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּֽנוּ
וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת, עֶֽרֶב וָבֹֽקֶר וְצָהֳרָֽיִם.
הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ
וְהַמְרַחֵם, כִּי לֹא תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ
מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ.
וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.


מוֹדִים We give thanks to You,
for You are the LORD our God and God of our ancestors
for ever and all time.
You are the Rock of our lives,
Shield of our salvation from generation to generation.
We will thank You and declare Your praise for our lives,
which are entrusted into Your hand;
for our souls, which are placed in Your charge;
for Your miracles which are with us every day;
and for Your wonders and favors
at all times, evening, morning and midday.
You are good – for Your compassion never fails.
You are compassionate – for Your loving-kindnesses never cease.
We have always placed our hope in You.
For all these things may Your name be blessed and exalted,
our King, continually, for ever and all time.

וּכְתֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ.
וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת
הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵֽנוּ סֶֽלָה.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת.


וּכְתֹב And write for a good life, all the children of Your covenant.
Let all that lives thank You, Selah!
and praise Your name in truth,
God, our Savior and Help, Selah!
Blessed are You, LORD, whose name is “the Good”
and to whom thanks are due.

שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה
חֵן וָחֶֽסֶד וְרַחֲמִים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ.
בָּרְכֵֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ כֻּלָּֽנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ
כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ נָתַֽתָּ לָּֽנוּ, יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶֽסֶד
וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם.
וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל
בְּכָל עֵת וּבְכָל שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ.


שִׂים שָׁלוֹם Grant peace, goodness and blessing,
grace, loving-kindness and compassion to us
and all Israel Your people.
Bless us, our Father, all as one, with the light of Your face,
for by the light of Your face You have given us, LORD our God,
the Torah of life and love of kindness,
righteousness, blessing, compassion, life and peace.
May it be good in Your eyes to bless Your people Israel
at every time, in every hour, with Your peace.

בְּסֵֽפֶר חַיִּים, בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם, וּפַרְנָסָה טוֹבָה

be remembered and written before You
for a good life, and for peace.*

find favor before You, LORD, my Rock and Redeemer.

אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶֽיךָ תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ, וְאַל תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתֵֽנוּ.
שֶׁאֵין אֲנַֽחְנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וּקְשֵׁי עֹֽרֶף לוֹמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ
יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
צַדִּיקִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְלֹא חָטָֽאנוּ.
אֲבָל אֲנַֽחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ חָטָֽאנוּ.


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our fathers,
let our prayer come before You, and do not hide Yourself from our plea,
for we are not so arrogant or obstinate as to say before You,
LORD, our God and God of our fathers,
we are righteous and have not sinned,
for in truth, we and our fathers have sinned.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, The Amida 44

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/44](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/44)


אָשַֽׁמְנוּ, בָּגַֽדְנוּ, גָּזַֽלְנוּ, דִּבַּֽרְנוּ דֹֽפִי
הֶעֱוִֽינוּ, וְהִרְשַֽׁעְנוּ, זַֽדְנוּ, חָמַֽסְנוּ, טָפַֽלְנוּ שֶֽׁקֶר
יָעַֽצְנוּ רָע, כִּזַּֽבְנוּ, לַֽצְנוּ, מָרַֽדְנוּ, נִאַֽצְנוּ, סָרַֽרְנוּ
עָוִֽינוּ, פָּשַֽׁעְנוּ, צָרַֽרְנוּ, קִשִּֽׁינוּ עֹֽרֶף
רָשַֽׁעְנוּ, שִׁחַֽתְנוּ, תִּעַֽבְנוּ, תָּעִֽינוּ, תִּעְתָּֽעְנוּ.


אָשַֽׁמְנוּ We have sinned, we have acted treacherously,
we have robbed, we have spoken slander.
We have acted perversely, we have acted wickedly,
we have acted presumptuously, we have been violent,
we have framed lies.
We have given bad advice, we have deceived, we have scorned,
we have rebelled, we have provoked, we have turned away,
we have committed iniquity, we have transgressed,
we have persecuted, we have been obstinate.
We have acted wickedly, we have corrupted,
we have acted abominably, we have strayed, we have led others astray.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, The Amida 45

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/45](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/45)


סַֽרְנוּ מִמִּצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ הַטּוֹבִים, וְלֹא שָֽׁוָה לָֽנוּ.
וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל־הַבָּא עָלֵֽינוּ
כִּי־אֱמֶת עָשִֽׂיתָ, וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ:


סַֽרְנוּ We have turned away from Your commandments and good laws,
to no avail, for You are just in all that has befallen us,
for You have acted faithfully while we have done wickedly.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, The Amida 46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/46)


מַה נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יוֹשֵׁב מָרוֹם, וּמַה נְּסַפֵּר לְפָנֶֽיךָ שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים
הֲלֹא כָּל הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת וְהַנִּגְלוֹת אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ.


מַה נֹּאמַר What can we say before You, You who dwell on high?
What can we declare before You, You who abide in heaven?
Do You not know all, the hidden and revealed alike?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, The Amida 47

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/47](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/47)


אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ רָזֵי עוֹלָם וְתַעֲלוּמוֹת סִתְרֵי כָּל חָי.
אַתָּה חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן וּבוֹחֵן כְּלָיוֹת וָלֵב.
אֵין דָּבָר נֶעֱלָם מִמֶּֽךָּ וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ.
וּבְכֵן, יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ, יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
שֶׁתִּסְלַח לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ וְתִמְחַל לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל עֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ
וּתְכַפֵּר לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ.


אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ You know every secret since the world began,
and what is hidden deep inside every living thing.
You search each person’s inner chambers,
examining conscience and mind.
Nothing is shrouded from You,
and nothing is hidden before Your eyes.
And so, may it be Your will,
LORD our God and God of our ancestors,
that You forgive us all our sins, pardon all our iniquities,
and grant us atonement for all of our transgressions.

and for the sin we have sinned before You in hardness of heart.

עַל מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה וְעַל מִצְוַת לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה.
בֵּין שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ קוּם עֲשֵׂה וּבֵין שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ קוּם עֲשֵׂה.
אֶת הַגְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ וְאֶת שֶׁאֵינָם גְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ
אֶת הַגְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ, כְּבָר אֲמַרְנוּם לְפָנֶֽיךָ, וְהוֹדִֽינוּ לְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם
וְאֶת שֶׁאֵינָם גְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ, לְפָנֶֽיךָ הֵם גְּלוּיִים וִידוּעִים
כַּדָּבָר שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר
הַנִּסְתָּרֹת לַיהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, וְהַנִּגְלֹת לָֽנוּ וּלְבָנֵֽינוּ עַד־עוֹלָם
לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת:


עַל מִצְוַת For positive and negative commandments,
whether they can be remedied by an act or not,
for sins known to us and for those that are unknown –
for those that are known,
we have already declared them before You and confessed them to You;
and for those that are unknown, before You they are revealed and known,
as it is said,
“The secret things belong to the LORD our God,
but the things that are revealed are for us and our children for ever,
that we may fulfill all the words of this Torah.”

כִּי אַתָּה סָלְחָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל
וּמָחֳלָן לְשִׁבְטֵי יְשֻׁרוּן בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר
וּמִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה.


For You are the Forgiver of Israel
and the Pardoner of the tribes of Yeshurun in every generation,
and without You we have no king who pardons and forgives,
none but You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, The Amida 85

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/85](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/85)


אֱלֹהַי
עַד שֶׁלֹּא נוֹצַֽרְתִּי אֵינִי כְדַאי
וְעַכְשָׁיו שֶׁנּוֹצַֽרְתִּי, כְּאִלּוּ לֹא נוֹצַֽרְתִּי
עָפָר אֲנִי בְּחַיָּי, קַל וָחֹֽמֶר בְּמִיתָתִי.
הֲרֵי אֲנִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ כִּכְלִי מָלֵא בּוּשָׁה וּכְלִמָּה.
יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ, יהוה אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי, שֶׁלֹּא אֶחֱטָא עוֹד.
וּמַה שֶּׁחָטָֽאתִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ, מְחֹק בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים
אֲבָל לֹא עַל יְדֵי יִסּוּרִים וָחֳלָיִם רָעִים.


אֱלֹהַי My God,
before I was formed I was unworthy,
and now that I have been formed it is as if I had not been formed.
I am dust while alive,
how much more so when I am dead.
See, I am before You like a vessel filled with shame and disgrace.
May it be Your will, LORD my God and God of my fathers,
that I may sin no more,
and as for the sins I have committed before You,
erase them in Your great compassion,
but not by suffering or severe illness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, The Amida 86

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/86](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/86)


אֱלֹהַי
נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה
וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדֹּם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה.
פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ, וּבְמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ תִּרְדֹּף נַפְשִׁי.
וְכָל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה
מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם.


אֱלֹהַי My God,
guard my tongue from evil
and my lips from deceitful speech.
To those who curse me, let my soul be silent;
may my soul be to all like the dust.
Open my heart to Your Torah
and let my soul pursue Your commandments.
As for all who plan evil against me,
swiftly thwart their counsel and frustrate their plans.

עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן יְמִינֶֽךָ
עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶֽךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ.

act for the sake of Your holiness; act for the sake of Your Torah.

לְמַֽעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶֽיךָ, הוֹשִֽׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵֽנִי:
יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶֽיךָ, יהוה צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי:


That Your beloved ones may be delivered,
save with Your right hand and answer me.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart
find favor before You, LORD, my Rock and Redeemer.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, The Amida 90

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/90](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/90)


עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו
הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.


May He who makes peace in His high places,
make peace for us and all Israel – and say: Amen.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, The Amida 91

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/91](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_The%20Amida/r/91)


יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
שֶׁיִּבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ, וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
וְשָׁם נַעֲבָדְךָ בְּיִרְאָה כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמֹנִיּוֹת.
וְעָרְבָה לַיהוה מִנְחַת יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמֹנִיּוֹת:


יְהִי רָצוֹן May it be Your will, LORD our God and God of our ancestors,
that the Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days,
and grant us a share in Your Torah.
And there we will serve You with reverence,
as in the days of old and as in former years.
Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem
will be pleasing to the LORD as in the days of old and as in former years.

O LORD, open my lips,
so that my mouth may declare Your praise.

**PATRIARCHS**

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם, אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק, וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב
הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן
גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים, וְקֹנֵה הַכֹּל
וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵי אָבוֹת
וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַֽעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה.


בָּרוּךְ Blessed are You, LORD our God and God of our fathers,
God of Abraham, God of Isaac and God of Jacob;
the great, mighty and awesome God, God Most High,
who bestows acts of loving-kindness and creates all,
who remembers the loving-kindness of the fathers
and will bring a Redeemer to their children’s children
for the sake of His name, in love.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 6

מִסּוֹד חֲכָמִים וּנְבוֹנִים
וּמִלֶּֽמֶד דַּֽעַת מְבִינִים
אֶפְתְּחָה פִּי בִּתְפִלָּה וּבְתַחֲנוּנִים
לְחַלּוֹת וּלְחַנֵּן פְּנֵי מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ לַעֲוֹנִים.


מִסּוֹד Drawing from the counsel of wise and knowing men,
from the teachings born of insight among those who understand,
I open my mouth now in prayer and pleading,
to implore and to plead before the King
who pardons and forgives iniquities.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 7

אֵימֶֽיךָ נָשָֽׂאתִי חִין בְּעָרְכִי / בְּמַלְאֲכוּת עַמְּךָ בֶּֽרֶךְ בְּבָרְכִי
גּוֹחִי מִבֶּֽטֶן, הַגִּֽיהַּ חָשְׁכִּי / דַּבֵּר צָחוֹת, וּבַאֲמִתְּךָ הַדְרִיכִי.


אֵימֶֽיךָ I bear Your awe as I prepare my plea; / an emissary of Your people, on bended knee.
You who brought me forth from the womb, illuminate my darkness
that I might speak clearly; guide me in Your truth.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/8)


הוֹרֵֽנִי שְׁפֹךְ שִֽׂיחַ עָרֵב / וְלוֹנְנִי בְצִלְּךָ אוֹתִי לְקָרֵב
זַֽעַק יוּפַק בְּכִוּוּן קֶֽרֶב / חַלּוֹתִי פָנֶֽיךָ צִדְקָתְךָ תְּקָרֵב.


Teach me to pour out beautiful words; / bring me close that I might dwell in Your shadow.
Bring forth my cry, with heartfelt intention. / As I seek Your countenance, bring me close to Your righteousness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 9

טְהוֹר עֵינַֽיִם, מְאֹד נַעֲלָה / יַדְּעֵֽנִי בִין עֵֽרֶךְ תְּפִלָּה
כַּדָּת לְחַנֵּן, בְּלִי תִּפְלָה / לְהַמְצִיא שׁוֹלְחַי אֶֽרֶךְ וּתְעָלָה.


Pure of eyes, most exalted One, / teach me to understand how prayer should be arranged,
that I might entreat You rightly, without impropriety; / that I might bring healing and remedy to those who have sent me.

מִפְתַּח שְׂפָתַי תְּבָרֵר וּתְיַשֵּׁר / נִדְבוֹת פִּי רְצֵה וְהַכְשֵׁר
סֵֽדֶר הֲגִיגִי כְּשַׁי יִתָּשֵׁר / עֵֽתֶר פִּצְחִי כְּזִילַת חֶֽשֶׁר.


Make the words which leave my lips clear and true, / accept the tributes of my mouth and make them fitting.
May the order of my words be received as a gift, / my outpouring of prayer like cascading raindrops.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 11

פְּעָמַי הָכֵן, פְּצוֹתִי מִכֶּֽשֶׁל / צוּר תְּמֹךְ אֲשׁוּרַי מֵהִנָּשֵׁל
קוֹמְמֵֽנִי וְחַזְּקֵֽנִי מֵרִפְיוֹן וָחֵֽשֶׁל / רְצוֹת אֲמָרַי, וְלֹא אֶכָּשֵׁל.


Steady my steps for me and guard me from falling; / O Rock, support my paths and let me not stumble.
Raise me up and strengthen me in the face of weakness and faintness;
favor my words so I do not fall.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 13

שָׁמְרֵֽנִי כְאִישׁוֹן מִפֶּֽלֶץ וּבְעָתָה / שׁוּר שִׁפְלוּתִי, וּלְכָה לִישׁוּעָֽתָה
תָּחֹן דִּכְאוּתִי כִּלְחוֹזָךְ פַּֽצְתָּ / תְּרַחֵם עַל בֵּן אִמַּֽצְתָּ.


Guard me as the apple of Your eye from terror and dread; / see my lowly stature, and come now to save us.
Pity my crushed heart as You promised Your prophet; / show compassion for [Israel,] the child whom You affirmed.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 17

אִמַּֽצְתָּ עָשׂוֹר לְכִפּוּר תַּמָּה / בּוֹ לְצַחְצֵֽחַ צֵאוּי כִּתְמָה
גְּהֹץ צַחֲנָהּ, עִוּוּיָהּ לְהָתֵֽמָה / דִּינָהּ לְהָאִיר, לְתֶֽחִי לְחָתְמָה.


אִמַּֽצְתָּ You affirmed the tenth [of Tishrei] to make atonement for Your beloved, / for them to clean the filthy stains of their guilt.
Cleanse their sin and end their iniquity; / shine light upon their judgment, and seal them for life.

הָחְרְדָה מִתֵּֽקַע יוֹם תְּרוּעָה / וּדְבָרִים קָֽחָה, סַרְעַף לְקָרְעָה
זֶה אֵלִי, לְצֶֽדֶק הַכְרִֽיעָה / חַי חַי יוֹדְךָ בְּהָרִֽיעָה.


They tremble at the shofar blast of Rosh HaShana, / bringing with them words that tear the heart;
crying out “This is my God” to let the judgment fall to righteousness
the living, the living praise You with the shofar’s sounding.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 19

טַפֶּֽיהָ וִישִׁישֶֽׁיהָ בְּעִנּוּי עֲיֵפִים / יְצִיגָתָם שׁוּר בְּיָחֵף יְחֵפִים
כֻּלָּם צָגִים וְלֹֽבֶן מֻצְעָפִים / לְאַדְּרָךְ בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ כִּשְׂרָפִים עָפִים.


The young and old among them are exhausted with affliction; behold them standing before You barefoot.
They all stand before You, robed in white; / they come to glorify You in sanctity, like flying Seraphim.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 20

מָגֵן עִקָּרֵֽמוֹ בָּךְ חוֹסִים / נִשְׁעָנִים בְּתֻמָּם וּבְצִלְּךְ חָסִים
סְמוּכִים בִּבְרִית שְׁלֹֽשֶׁת יְחוּסִים / עוֹדְדֵם הֱיוֹת שׂוֹטְנֵֽימוֹ הָסִים.


Defender of their ancestors, they place their faith in You, / relying on You in their innocence, and finding shelter in Your shade.
They lean upon on Your covenant with their three honored ancestors;
support them, and silence their enemies.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 21

פְּנֵה בְּצִדְקַת אָת מֵעֵֽבֶר / צֹאנְךָ תַּֽחַת שֵֽׁבֶט, כְּהַעֲבֵר
קַדְּמֵם רַחֲמֶֽיךָ בְּלִי הִתְעַבֵּר / רַחוּם עַל פֶּֽשַׁע עוֹבֵר.


Turn to them, for the righteousness of [Abraham,] the one from across the river, / as You pass Your flock under Your staff.
Approach them with compassion, without awakening your wrath, O Merciful One who overlooks transgressions.

תְּמוּכֵי יְמִינְךָ, פְּנֵיהֶם נַהֵר / תַּעְתּֽוּעַ חֶטְאָם תְּכַפֵּר לְטַהֵר.

He sustains the living with loving-kindness,
and with great compassion revives the dead.
He supports the fallen,
heals the sick,
sets captives free,
and keeps His faith with those who sleep in the dust.
Who is like You, Master of might,
and who can compare to You,
O King who brings death and gives life,
and makes salvation grow?

עֲמוּסִים מִבֶּֽטֶן פְּצֵם מִשְּׁאוֹנִים / סְעָדֵם בַּל לָמֹד כִּסְאוֹנִים.


You removed Your hosts from [Egypt,] the crucible of sorrow, / sending angels to redeem them from harsh servitude.
Deliver those You have borne since birth from the tumult of destruction, / support them and do not deal with them measure for measure.

Your covenant is etched into their very flesh, / since Abraham, the rock from which they descend.
Look to the covenant and wash away their filth; / cleanse them thoroughly and let their light shine.

חֲנִיטָיו חַלֵּץ מֵאֵימָֽתָה וָפַֽחַד / זִבּוּחוֹ וְדִשּׁוּנוֹ לְפָנֶֽיךָ יִתְיַחַד.


Behold the sacrifice of the only son, Isaac, / as both father and son feared Your command.
Save their offspring from dread and fear; / may [Isaac’s] sacrifice and ashes be complete in Your presence.

And if their ways have become crooked that they might deceive You, recall Your compassion and never forsake Your covenant.
Adopt the advocate Abraham’s demand for justice, / and reinforce the protection You offer us a thousandfold.

Turn Your mind away from Your congregation’s iniquity; / hear their groans and accept their whispered pleas.

אֱנוֹשׁ How might man be acquitted, when even the hosts of heaven are not pure in Your eyes?
If the moist [the meritorious] can be burnt in fire, what chance have the dry stalks [the guilty]?

Darkness is revealed to You as clear as light; Your eye ranges over all.
Though Your home is hidden, all secrets are revealed before You.

הַדָּן יְחִידִי, וְהוּא בְאֶחָד וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ.
וְעַל גּוֹי וְעַל אָדָם יַֽחַד יִנְטֶה קָו, וְאֵין מִי יַרְשִֽׁיעַ.


He is the sole judge, the only One; who can sway Him?
Over nations and individuals alike He extends the line of judgment, and none can find fault with Him.

Let all creatures understand this, and be not misled by their impulses to sin before the Creator.
Those once coddled in the womb, will be covered in the tomb, and must account for their deeds before their Creator.

Man is made impure by his flesh, is vulnerable to impurity in his existence, and imparts impurity in his death.

Like waking from a dream, terrors that frighten him continuously;
nights he gets no sleep, days he finds no rest, until he slumbers in the grave.

What complaint might a living man lodge? It is enough that he is alive.
He is born to toil, and fortunate if he labors in the true Law.

עוֹד חוֹתָמוֹ מְעִידוֹ עַל פָּעֳלוֹ, וּמַה יִּגְנֹב דָּֽעַת.

אֵל נָא.
אַתָּה הוּא אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ.
גִּבּוֹר וְנַעֲרָץ דָּגוּל מֵרְבָבָה.
הוּא שָׂח וַיֶּֽהִי וְצִוָּה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ.
זִכְרוֹ לָנֶֽצַח חַי עוֹלָמִים.
טְהוֹר עֵינַֽיִם יוֹשֵׁב סֵֽתֶר.
כִּתְרוֹ יְשׁוּעָה לְבוּשׁוֹ צְדָקָה.
מַעֲטֵֽהוּ קִנְאָה נֶאְפָּד נְקָמָה.
סִתְרוֹ יֹֽשֶׁר עֲצָתוֹ אֱמוּנָה.
פְּעֻלָּתוֹ אֱמֶת צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר.
קָרוֹב לְקוֹרְאָיו בֶּאֱמֶת רָם וּמִתְנַשֵּׂא.
שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים תּוֹלֶה אֶֽרֶץ עַל בְּלִימָה.


God, please.
You are our God, in heaven and on earth.
Mighty and revered, encircled with myriads.
He spoke and it was, commanded and it came into being.
His memory is forever, His life is everlasting.
Pure of eye, He sits concealed.
His crown is salvation, His garment is righteousness.
His cloak is jealousy, His coat is vengeance.
His counsel is candor, His wisdom is faith.
His deeds are truth, He is righteous and upright.
He is close to those
who call upon Him in truth, He is sublime and lofty.
He resides in the heavens, and hangs the earth over emptiness.

אָנָּא סְלַח נָא / פֶּֽשַׁע וְעָוֹן שָׂא נָא
וְכֹחֲךָ יִגְדַּל נָא.
קָדוֹשׁ.


אָנָּא We beg of You, please forgive us,
please pardon willful sin and iniquity,
that Your strength might be exalted – O Holy One.

קָדוֹשׁ.

*ש״ץ:* מוֹרֶה חַטָּאִים סְלֹל לְהִתְהַלֵּךְ / מְלַמֵּד לְהַדְרִיכִי בְּדֶֽרֶךְ אֵלֵךְ
*קהל:* אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּֽלֶךְ:


*Leader:* מוֹרֶה You who instruct sinners and pave them a path to follow, You teach me and guide me that I might make my way.
*Cong:* I will exalt You, my God, the King.

*קהל:* בְּכָל־יוֹם אֲבָרְכֶֽךָּ:


*Leader:* I set aside times day and night to anoint You, / You who abides forever, there is none like You.
*Cong:* Every day I will bless You.

*קהל:* גָּדוֹל יהוה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד:


*Leader:* My heart trembles to serve You constantly; / I shall stand on guard to revere Your sanctity.
*Cong:* Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised.

מַלֵּא מִשְׁאֲלוֹתָם, וְיִשְׂמְחוּ חוֹסֶֽיךָ

*קהל:* הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶֽךָ:


*Leader:* With entreaty and fasting they go forth to serve You, / for they have been created for Your glory.
*Cong:* The glorious splendor of Your majesty.

*קהל:* חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יהוה:

*קהל:* יוֹדֽוּךָ יהוה כָּל־מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ:

*קהל:* כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ יֹאמֵֽרוּ:

###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 106

אָנָּא סְלַח נָא / פֶּֽשַׁע וְעָוֹן שָׂא נָא / וְכֹחֲךָ יִגְדַּל נָא. קָדוֹשׁ.


We beg of You, please forgive us, / please pardon willful sin and iniquity,
that Your strength might be exalted – O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 107

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/107](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/107)


*ש״ץ:* וִדּוּיָם יְנוֹחַח שַׁי עָדֶֽיךָ / וִישֻׁלַּם פָּרִים אֶֽרֶשׁ עֵדֶֽיךָ
*קהל:* פּוֹתֵֽחַ אֶת־יָדֶֽךָ:


*Leader:* Receive the gift of Your congregation’s confession as a pleasing offering, / and may the prayers of Your witnesses take the place of sacrificed bullocks.
*Cong:* You open Your hand.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 108

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/108](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/108)


*ש״ץ:* סֶֽלָה בְּרַחֲמָיו יָצִיץ מֵחֲרַכָּיו / סְלֹֽחַ יַרְבֶּה לְעַם מְבֹרָכָיו
*קהל:* צַדִּיק יהוה בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו:


*Leader:* May He, in His compassion, glimpse [His people] through His lattices, / and grant great forgiveness to His blessed nation.
*Cong:* The LORD is righteous in all His ways.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 109

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/109](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/109)


*ש״ץ:* חִין יִֽשַׁע מִגּוֹי מְקֹרָאָיו / חֹן יָחֹן קוֹרְאֵי מִקְרָאָיו
*קהל:* קָרוֹב יהוה לְכָל־קֹרְאָיו:


*Leader:* Heed the prayers of the nation You have named; / show favor to the people who read out Your scriptures faithfully.
*Cong:* The LORD is close to all who call on Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 110

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/110](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/110)


אָנָּא רַחוּם כַּפֵּר / עֲוֹן צָגִים, תְּהִלָּתְךָ לְסַפֵּר / וְיֻחַֽקּוּ לְחַיִּים בַּסֵּֽפֶר. קָדוֹשׁ.


We beg of You, O Compassionate One, grant atonement
for the iniquity of those assembled, that Your praise might be told,
and may they be inscribed for life in Your book – O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 111

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/111](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/111)


*ש״ץ:* זֶה אֵלִי, פֶּֽלֶא עוֹשֶׂה / זַעֲקֵֽנוּ יִֽרֶץ וְשׂוֹטְנֵֽינוּ יְעַשֶּׂה
*קהל:* רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָיו יַעֲשֶׂה:


*Leader:* This is my God, He performs wonders; / He shall accept our cries and crush our foes.
*Cong:* He fulfills the will of those who revere Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 112

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/112](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/112)


*ש״ץ:* קִוּוּי יִתֵּן לְלוֹ מַשְׁלִיךְ יְהָבָיו / קָדוֹשׁ פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ יְכַסֶּה בַּאֲהָבָיו
*קהל:* שׁוֹמֵר יהוה אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָיו:


*Leader:* He gives hope to those who cast their burdens upon Him; / may the Holy One cover our iniquities with His love.
*Cong:* The LORD guards all who love Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 113

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/113](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/113)


*ש״ץ:* קַבֵּל צְקוּנִי כִּבְמִכְלַל יֹֽפִי / קוֹלִי תַּאֲזִין וְתַצְלִיל דֹּֽפִי
*קהל:* תְּהִלַּת יהוה יְדַבֶּר פִּי:


*Leader:* Accept the prayers poured from my heart as the height of beauty; listen to my voice and cast all faults into the depths of the sea.
*Cong:* My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 114

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/114](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/114)


אָנָּא סְלַח נָא / פֶּֽשַׁע וְעָוֹן שָׂא נָא / וְכֹחֲךָ יִגְדַּל נָא. קָדוֹשׁ.


We beg of You, please forgive us, / please pardon willful sin and iniquity,
that Your strength might be exalted – O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 117

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/117](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/117)


מֶֽלֶךְ שׁוֹכֵן עַד / לְבַדְּךָ מְלֹךְ עֲדֵי עַד
הָאֵל קָדוֹשׁ.


מֶֽלֶךְ O King who dwells eternally,
You alone shall reign for all eternity –
O Holy God.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 118

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/118](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/118)


מֶֽלֶךְ מַאֲזִין שַׁוְעָה / לְעַמּוֹ מֵחִישׁ יְשׁוּעָה
נוֹרָא וְקָדוֹשׁ.


מֶֽלֶךְ O King who heeds His faithful’s call,
who hastens salvation for His people –
O Awesome, Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 121

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/121](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/121)


הַיּוֹם יִכָּתֵב בְּסֵֽפֶר הַזִּכְרוֹנוֹת, הַחַיִּים וְהַמָּֽוֶת.
אָנָּא כַנָּה, עֽוּרִי נָא, הִתְעוֹרְרִי נָא
עִמְדִי נָא, הִתְיַצְּבִי נָא, קֽוּמִי נָא, חַלִּי נָא
בְּעַד הַנֶּֽפֶשׁ חַנִּי נָא, פְּנֵי דָּר עֶלְיוֹן.


הַיּוֹם יִכָּתֵב Today, in the book of memories, life and death will be inscribed.
Please, you stem [of the vine of Israel] – awaken, please; wake up, please;
stand up, please; stand firm, please;
rise up, please; entreat, please;
beseech, please, for your soul,
with the One who dwells on high.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 125

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/125](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/125)


וּבְכֵן, אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים, מַה־נּוֹרָא מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ:


וּבְכֵן And so, you shall say of God: How awesome are Your works!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 127

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/127](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/127)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם וּגְדָל־כֹּֽחַ / מֵכִין הָרִים בְּכֹֽחַ
חֲכַם לֵבָב וְאַמִּיץ כֹּֽחַ / נֹתֵן לַיָּעֵף כֹּֽחַ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, גָּדוֹל אֲדוֹנֵֽינוּ וְרַב־כֹּֽחַ:


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים Say of God:
He is slow to anger and great of strength;
He founded the mountains with strength.
Wise of heart and powerfully strong, / He offers strength to the weary.
Therefore, exalt Him, our mighty Master of great strength.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 128

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/128](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/128)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
בּוֹנֶה בַשָּׁמַֽיִם מַעֲלוֹתָו / מַשְׁקֶה הָרִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָיו
זֵֽכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָיו / וְלוֹ נִתְכְּנוּ עֲלִלוֹתָיו
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, הַמְקָרֶה בַמַּֽיִם עֲלִיּוֹתָיו:


Say of God:
He builds His heights in the heavens,
He waters the mountains from His upper chambers,
He made a memorial of His wondrous works,
and by Him are all actions weighed.
Therefore, exalt Him, He who beams His upper chambers with waters.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 129

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/129](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/129)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
גֵּאֶה וְגָבֹֽהַּ בִּשְׁמֵי מַֽעְלָה / עֹֽטֶה אוֹר כַּשִּׂמְלָה
לוֹ הַגְּבוּרָה וְהַגְּדֻלָּה / וְהָעֹז וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָֽׁלָה:


Say of God:
Exalted and lofty in His heavenly heights,
He wears light as a garment.
To Him belongs all strength and grandeur, / might and dominion.
Therefore, exalt Him, He whose kingdom reigns over all.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 130

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/130](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/130)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
דָּגוּל מֵרִבְבוֹת קֹֽדֶשׁ / וְנֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ
דַּרְכּוֹ בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ / וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לוֹ בְּהַדְרַת קֹֽדֶשׁ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, הֲלִיכוֹת אֵלִי מַלְכִּי בַקֹּֽדֶשׁ:


Say of God:
Distinguished among holy myriads, / glorious in His holiness,
His ways are holy, / and all bow before Him in holy splendor.
Therefore, exalt Him, my God, my King who walks in holiness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 131

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/131](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/131)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
הוֹדוֹ כִּסָּה שָׁמַֽיִם / וְהָאָֽרֶץ רוֹקַע עַל הַמַּֽיִם
יַרְעֵם מִשָּׁמַֽיִם / לְקוֹל תִּתּוֹ הֲמוֹן מַֽיִם
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, הַנּוֹטֶה כַדֹּק שָׁמַֽיִם:


Say of God:
His splendor covers the heavens,
He spreads the earth over the water.
He thunders from the heavens,
sending down multitudes of resounding waters.
Therefore, exalt Him, He who spreads out the heavens like a veil.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 132

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/132](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/132)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
וְכָל בַּשָּׁלִשׁ עֲפַר הָאָֽרֶץ / יָדוֹ יָסְדָה אָֽרֶץ
וִימִינוֹ טִפְּחָה שְׁמֵי עֶֽרֶץ / וְהֶעֱמִידָם בְּלִי פֶֽרֶץ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל־חוּג הָאָֽרֶץ:


Say of God:
He measured out the dust of the earth; / His hand founded the earth.
His right hand extended the awesome heavens
that they might stand unbreached.
Therefore, exalt Him, He who sits enthroned
upon the vault of the earth.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 133

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/133](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/133)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
זֹֽהַר כִּסְאוֹ שְׁבִיבֵי אֵשׁ / מְשָׁרְתָיו לֹהֵט אֵשׁ
נֹֽגַהּ לָאֵשׁ וּמַבְרִיק הָאֵשׁ / לְפָנָיו נִמְשָׁכִים נַהֲרֵי אֵשׁ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, אֵשׁ אֹכְלָה אֵשׁ.


Say of God:
The brightness of His throne is as fiery sparks,
His servants blaze with fire.
Shining like fire and bursting forth in lightning,
rivers of fire flow before Him.
Therefore, exalt Him, the Fiery One who consumes fire.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 134

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/134](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/134)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
חַי עוֹלָמִים / צָר בְּיָהּ עוֹלָמִים
אִוָּה בֵּית עוֹלָמִים / מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתּוֹ עוֹלָמִים
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, עַתִּיק יוֹמִין.


Say of God:
He lives forever,
He created worlds with His holy name, He desired an eternal abode,
His temple where He might reside forever.
Therefore, exalt Him, Ancient of Days.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 135

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/135](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/135)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
טְהוֹר עֵינַֽיִם / סְבִיבוֹתָיו חַשְׁרַת מַֽיִם
עָבֵי שַֽׁחַק חֶשְׁכַת מַֽיִם / טוֹעֲנֵי מֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ, גַּבּוֹתָם מְלֵאוֹת עֵינַֽיִם
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, מִצְוַת יהוה בָּרָה מְאִירַת עֵינָֽיִם:


Say of God:
He whose eyes are pure,
He is surrounded by clouds of water,
full clouds of heaven, dark with precipitation,
the outriders who bear His chariot have eyes all around.
Therefore, exalt Him, the command of the Lord is pure,
enlightening the eyes.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 136

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/136](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/136)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
יוֹדֵֽעַ מַה בְּסִתְרֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ / לֹא יַחְשִׁיךְ מֶֽנּוּ חֹֽשֶׁךְ
קֵץ שָׂם לַחֹֽשֶׁךְ / הֹפֵךְ לַבֹּֽקֶר צַלְמָֽוֶת וְחֹֽשֶׁךְ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, יוֹצֵר אוֹר וּבוֹרֵא חֹֽשֶׁךְ:


Say of God:
He knows what lies in hidden obscurity;
the dark conceals nothing from Him.
He ordained an end to darkness,
turning the dark shadow of death into daylight.
Therefore, exalt Him, He who forms light and creates darkness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 137

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/137](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/137)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
כּוֹנֵן כִּסְאוֹ לַמִּשְׁפָּט / מְכוֹן כִּסְאוֹ צֶֽדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט
אֱלֹהֵי הַמִּשְׁפָּט / תֹּאחֵז יָדוֹ בְּמִשְׁפָּט
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, וַיִּגְבַּהּ יהוה צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט:


Say of God:
He has established His throne for justice,
the seat of His reign is righteousness and justice.
He is the God of justice,
brandishing justice in His hand like a sword.
Therefore, exalt Him, the LORD of hosts who shall rise in justice.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 138

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/138](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/138)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
לוֹ יָאֲתָה מְלוּכָה / שׁוֹכֵן עַד, וְאֶת דַּכָּא
מֵשִׁיב אֱנוֹשׁ עַד דַּכָּא / וְאוֹמֵר, שֽׁוּבוּ בְּרֽוּחַ נְמוּכָה
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, כִּי לַיהוה הַמְּלוּכָה:


Say of God:
Royalty befits Him;
He dwells in eternity, yet is with the downtrodden.
He returns man to the dust,
yet He asks that we humbly repent and return to Him.
Therefore, exalt Him, for the Lord’s is the kingdom.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 139

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/139](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/139)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
מֹשֵׁל בִּגְבוּרָתוֹ עוֹלָם / הַכֹּל צָפוּי וְלֹא נֶעְלָם
זֶה שְׁמוֹ לְעוֹלָם / חַסְדּוֹ מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד עוֹלָם
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, בָּרוּךְ יהוה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, מֵהָעוֹלָם וְעַד־הָעוֹלָם:


Say of God:
In His might He rules the world, / all is foreseen, nothing is hidden.
His name is everlasting
and His loving-kindness extends throughout eternity.
Therefore, exalt Him –
Blessed be the Lord, God of Israel, for all eternity.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 140

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/140](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/140)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
נוֹצֵר חֶֽסֶד לְאֶֽלֶף דּוֹר / לוֹחֵם קָמָיו מִדּוֹר לְדוֹר
מֵקִים סֻכַּת מְשִׁיחוֹ לִגְדֹּר / הָאוֹר חוֹנֶה עִמּוֹ בְּמָדוֹר
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, וְזֶה זִכְרִי לְדֹר דֹּר:


Say of God:
He extends loving-kindness to a thousand generations,
and battles those who rise against Him
from generation to generation.
He will raise the tabernacle of His anointed one,
repairing its breached walls;
light itself is encamped in His abode.
Therefore, exalt Him, –
This is My remembrance from generation to generation.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 141

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/141](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/141)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
סוֹבֵל עֶלְיוֹנִים וְתַחְתּוֹנִים / שֹׁמֵֽעַ אֶל־אֶבְיוֹנִים
מַאֲזִין שִֽׂיחַ חִנּוּנִים / מַקְשִׁיב שֶֽׁוַע רְנָנִים
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַאֲדֹנֵי הָאֲדֹנִים:


Say of God:
He accepts the lofty and the lowly ones,
He hears the call of the destitute, lends His ear to words of entreaty,
heeds the cry of prayers.
Therefore, exalt Him, the God of gods and Master of all masters.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 142

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/142](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/142)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה / נוֹקֵם לְצָרָיו וּבַֽעַל חֵמָה
מַכְרִית קָמִים בִּמְהוּמָה / נוֹהֵם עֲלֵיהֶם בִּנְהִימָה
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, יהוה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה:


Say of God:
He is a mighty and powerful warrior,
He takes revenge from His foes and is capable of righteous ire.
He lays low wanton rebels in great confusion,
roaring at them like the thundering seas.
Therefore, exalt Him, the Lord, Master of war.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 143

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/143](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/143)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
פּוֹעֵל וְעוֹשֶׂה הַכֹּל / בְּיָדוֹ לְגַדֵּל וּלְחַזֵּק לַכֹּל
אֵלָיו יְשַׂבְּרוּ עֵינֵי כֹל / עֵינָיו מְשׁוֹטְטוֹת בַּכֹּל
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כֹּל:


Say of God:
He forms and creates all things;
in His hands lies the power to glorify and strengthen all things.
To Him all eyes are raised in hope, / His eyes range over all.
Therefore, exalt Him, He who is supreme over all.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 144

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/144](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/144)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
צַדִּיק בְּכָל דְּרָכָיו / יָשָׁר מֵצִיץ מֵחֲרַכָּיו
חָפֵץ בְּעַם מַמְלִיכָיו / יִירְשׁוּ אֶֽרֶץ מְבֹרָכָיו
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, בָּרְכוּ יהוה מַלְאָכָיו:


Say of God:
He is righteous in all His ways,
the Upright One glimpses all through His lattices.
Desirous of the nation that enthrones Him,
those He has blessed shall inherit the earth.
Therefore, exalt Him – Bless the Lord, you His angels.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 145

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/145](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/145)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
קֹרֵא הַדֹּרוֹת מֵרֹאשׁ / מַגִּיד אַחֲרִית מֵרֹאשׁ
בָּחַר בְּאֹם דַּלַּת רֹאשׁ / עֻזּוֹ יוֹם יוֹם לִדְרֹשׁ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ:


Say of God:
He who planned all generations in advance,
foretells the end from the beginning.
He chose a humble nation / to beseech His valor daily.
Therefore, exalt Him, exalted as Head over all.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 146

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/146](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/146)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
רָם וְנִשָּׂא, שֹׁכֵן עַד / בִּטְחוּ בוֹ עֲדֵי עַד
כְּבוֹדוֹ בְּסוֹד קְדוֹשִׁים וִעַד / וּלְעַם קְדוֹשׁוֹ נוֹעַד
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, הַמַּבִּיט לָאָֽרֶץ וַתִּרְעָד:


Say of God:
High and lofty, He dwells in eternity,
place your trust in Him forever.
His glory He intended for His holy ones
and for the people bound to Him in sanctity.
Therefore, exalt Him, He who gazes at the earth and it trembles.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 147

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/147](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/147)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
שְׁבִילוֹ בְּמַֽיִם רַבִּים / שָׁמָיו מַרְעִיף רְבִיבִים
שְׁמוֹ מְיַחֲדִים שַֽׁחַר וַעֲרָבִים / בְּשַֽׁעַר בַּת רַבִּים
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, יהוה צְבָאוֹת יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים:


Say of God:
He cuts His path through rising waters,
causes His heavens to shower copious rains.
His name is proclaimed unique in prayers both morning and evening, inside the gates where multitudes gather.
Therefore, exalt Him, the Lord of hosts enthroned upon His Cherubim.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 148

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/148](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/148)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
תְּהִלָּתוֹ מָלְאָה הָאָֽרֶץ / מַעֲבִיר כִּלָּיוֹן וָחֶֽרֶץ
מֵשִׁיב חֲרוֹן אַף וָקֶֽרֶץ / שֶֽׁוַע מְחַנְּנָיו יִֽרֶץ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, יהוה אֲדֹנֵֽינוּ, מָה־אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ:


Say of God:
His glory fills the earth, / bringing upon it utter destruction.
He turns back anger and ruin,
accepting the pleas of those who pray to Him humbly.
Therefore, exalt Him, the LORD our Master –
glorious is Your name throughout the earth.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 150

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/150](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/150)


וּבְכֵן, גְּדוֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂי אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ.


Indeed, the works of our God are sublime.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 152

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/152](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/152)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
אֵין מִי בַשַּֽׁחַק יַעֲרֹךְ לוֹ / בִּבְנֵי אֵלִים יִדְמֶה לוֹ
גְּבֹהִים עִלָּה לְמוֹשָׁב לוֹ / דָּרֵי גֵיא כַּחֲגָבִים לְמוּלוֹ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, הַצּוּר תָּמִים פָּעֳלוֹ:


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ The work of our God:
None in heaven can compare to Him,
none among the angels can be likened to Him.
He raised the high heavens for His residence,
and those living on earth below are like insects before Him.
Therefore, exalt Him,
the Rock whose works are pure.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 153

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/153](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/153)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
הַמְשֵׁל וָפַֽחַד עִמּוֹ / וְהַרְבֵּה פְדוּת עִמּוֹ
זַֽעַק וְלַֽחַשׁ עַמּוֹ / חָשׁ וּמַאֲזִין מִמְּרוֹמוֹ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, יהוה צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ:


The work of our God:
Sovereignty and awe are His,
and in Him redemption abounds.
Cries and whispers make their way to Him;
He hastens to listen from His heights.
Therefore, exalt Him –
the LORD of hosts is His name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 154

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/154](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/154)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
טֶֽרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו / יֹבִֽילוּ שַׁי לְמוֹרָאָיו
כִּתֵּי גְּדוּדֵי צְבָאָיו / לֹא יָשֽׁוּרוּ כְּבוֹד מַרְאָיו
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, הִנֵּה עֵין יהוה אֶל־יְרֵאָיו:


The work of our God:
He provides sustenance to those who fear Him;
gifts shall be granted to those in awe of Him.
The legions of His angelic hosts
cannot look directly on His countenance.
Therefore, exalt Him –
Behold, the eye of the LORD is turned to all who fear Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 155

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/155](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/155)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
מַלְאָכָיו עוֹשֶׂה רוּחוֹת / נִקְדָּשׁ בְּשִׁירוֹת וְתֻשְׁבָּחוֹת
סוֹכֵת שְׁפִיכַת שִׂיחוֹת / עוֹנֶה וּמַעֲמִיד רְוָחוֹת
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת:


The work of our God:
He appoints His winds as emissaries,
He is sanctified in songs and praises.
He heeds the outpouring of heartfelt pleas,
answering with the swift provision of succor.
Therefore, exalt Him,
the God of all spirits.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 156

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/156](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/156)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
פּוֹדֶה מִשַּֽׁחַת עֲמוּסָיו / צוּר יוֹדֵֽעַ חוֹסָיו
קָדוֹשׁ מַפְלִיא נִסָּיו / רַחוּם לִמְרַצָּיו וּמַכְעִיסָיו
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, וְרַחֲמָיו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו:


The work of our God:
He redeems those He has borne from birth
from the pits of She’ol;
the eternal Rock acknowledges those who seek shelter with Him.
The Holy One works His miracles,
showing compassion equally
to those who please and displease Him.
Therefore, exalt Him,
He who shows compassion to all His creations.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 158

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/158](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/158)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱנוֹשׁ
תַּחְבּוּלוֹתָיו מְזִמָּה
שִׁבְתּוֹ בְּתוֹךְ מִרְמָה
רְפִידָתוֹ רִמָּה
קָבוּר בִּסְעִיף אֲדָמָה
וְאֵיךְ יִתְגָּאֶה, אָדָם לַהֶֽבֶל דָּמָה:


The deeds of man:
His plans are mere plots, / he lives in a world of deceit,
his berth is lined with maggots, / buried in a crevice in the ground.
Then how can man be exalted,
when he is like a vain breath?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 160

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/160](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/160)


אֲבָל מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
שׁוֹמֵֽעַ שַׁוְעוֹת / שׁוֹעֶה עֵֽרֶךְ שׁוּעוֹת
תּוֹרוֹתָיו מְשַׁעְשְׁעוֹת / תַּכְסִיסוֹ כּֽוֹבַע יְשׁוּעוֹת
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, הָאֵל לָֽנוּ אֵל לְמוֹשָׁעוֹת:


But the work of our God:
He hears the suppliant cry,
turns to those who raise their cry to Him,
His teachings are a source of true pleasure,
His tactics are a helmet of salvation.
Therefore, exalt Him,
the God who is our God of salvation.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 164

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/164](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/164)


וּבְכֵן, לְנוֹרָא עֲלֵיהֶם בְּאֵימָה יַעֲרִֽיצוּ.


וּבְכֵן And so, in awe, they shall revere the One
whose fear is upon them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 166

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/166](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/166)


אֲשֶׁר אֹֽמֶץ תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
בְּאֵילֵי שַֽׁחַק / בְּבִרְקֵי נֹֽגַהּ
בִּגְדוּדֵי גֹֽבַהּ / בִּדְמָמָה דַּקָּה וּקְדֻשָּׁתְךָ בְּפִיהֶם.


אֲשֶׁר אֹֽמֶץ Even though Your mighty praise is
among the angels of heaven, / the beings that flash divine light,
the hosts on high, / and the still, small voice –
for Your sanctity is in their mouths.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 167

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/167](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/167)


וְרָצִֽיתָ שֶֽׁבַח
מֵהוֹמֵי בְרֶֽגֶשׁ / וְעוֹרְכֵי שֶֽׁוַע
זוֹעֲקֵי תְחִנָּה / חוֹכֵי חֲנִינָה וְהִיא כְבוֹדֶֽךָ.


Yet You desire praise
from those who call out to You in roaring throngs, / who lay out their cries,
who shout their prayers, / and await Your grace –for this is Your glory.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 168

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/168](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/168)


אֲשֶׁר אֹֽמֶץ תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
בְּטַפְסְרֵי טֹֽהַר / בְּיִדֹּדוּן יִדֹּדוּן
בִּכְרוּבֵי כָבוֹד / בְּלִגְיוֹנֵי לַֽהַב וּקְדֻשָּׁתְךָ בְּפִיהֶם.


Even though Your mighty praise is
among the angels so pure, / the hastily fleeing angels,
the Cherubim who honor You, / and the heavenly legions with their swords –for Your sanctity is in their mouths.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 169

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/169](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/169)


וְרָצִֽיתָ שֶֽׁבַח
מִמְּעוּטֵי יָמִים / נְשׁוּיֵי טוֹבָה
שְׂבֵעֵי רֹֽגֶז / עֲגוּמֵי נֶֽפֶשׁ וְהִיא כְבוֹדֶֽךָ.


Yet You desire praise
from mere mortals, with their numbered days, / whom all good has abandoned,
filled with anxiety, / and deeply grieved in their souls –
for this is Your glory.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 170

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/170](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/170)


אֲשֶׁר אֹֽמֶץ תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
בִּפְלִיאֵי שֵׁמוֹת / בְּצִבְאוֹת עִירִין
בִּקְדוֹשֵׁי קֶֽדֶם / בְּרֶֽכֶב רִבֹּתַֽיִם וּקְדֻשָּׁתְךָ בְּפִיהֶם.


Even though Your mighty praise is
among those whose names are concealed, / the wakeful angelic hosts,
the ancient holy ones, / and the myriad riders of His chariot –
for Your sanctity is in their mouths.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 171

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/171](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/171)


וְרָצִֽיתָ שֶֽׁבַח
מִשּׁוֹקְדֵי דְלָתוֹת / שׁוֹפְכֵי שִֽׂיחַ
תּוֹבְעֵי סְלִיחָה / תְּאֵבֵי כַפָּרָה וְהִיא כְבוֹדֶֽךָ.


Yet You desire praise
from those who strive toward the [synagogue] doors, / who pour out their heartfelt pleas,
requesting Your forgiveness, / and desirous of atonement –
for this is Your glory.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 173

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/173](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/173)


וּבְכֵן, תְּנוּ עֹז לֵאלֹהִים, עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּאֲוָתוֹ:


וּבְכֵן And so, ascribe strength to God, over Israel is His majesty.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 175

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/175](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/175)


עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֱמוּנָתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּרְכָתוֹ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּאֲוָתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל דִּבְרָתוֹ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל הַדְרָתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעִידָתוֹ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל זְכִירָתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל חֶמְלָתוֹ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל טַהֲרָתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁרָתוֹ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּנָּתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֻמָּתוֹ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְכוּתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל נְעִימָתוֹ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל סְגֻלָּתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲדָתוֹ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל פְּעֻלָּתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל צִדְקָתוֹ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל רוֹמְמוּתוֹ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁכִינָתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּפְאַרְתּוֹ.


עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל Over Israel is His faith. Over Israel is His blessing.
Over Israel is His majesty. Over Israel is His word.
Over Israel is His glory. Over Israel is His assembly.
Over Israel is His remembrance. Over Israel is His compassion.
Over Israel is His purity. Over Israel is His candor.
Over Israel is His heritage. Over Israel is His nationhood.
Over Israel is His kingdom. Over Israel is His pleasing song.
Over Israel is His cherishing love. Over Israel, is His congregation.
Over Israel is His accomplishment. Over Israel is His righteousness.
Over Israel is His sanctity. Over Israel is His loftiness.
Over Israel is His Divine Presence. Over Israel is His splendor.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 178

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/178](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/178)


וּבְכֵן, נְאַדֶּרְךָ חַי עוֹלָמִים.


וּבְכֵן And so, we shall glorify You who lives forever.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 180

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/180](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/180)


הָאַדֶּֽרֶת וְהָאֱמוּנָה לְחַי עוֹלָמִים
הַבִּינָה וְהַבְּרָכָה לְחַי עוֹלָמִים
הַגַּאֲוָה וְהַגְּדֻלָּה לְחַי עוֹלָמִים
הַדֵּעָה וְהַדִּבּוּר לְחַי עוֹלָמִים
הַהוֹד וְהֶהָדָר לְחַי עוֹלָמִים

“Be sanctified, LORD, through all that You have made.”

כִּי מַקְדִּישֶֽׁיךָ בִּקְדֻשָּׁתְךָ קִדַּֽשְׁתָּ
נָאֶה לְקָדוֹשׁ פְּאֵר מִקְּדוֹשִׁים.


כִּי מַקְדִּישֶֽׁיךָ For with Your holiness You sanctify
all who affirm You holy;
it is fitting that the Holy One be glorified by holy ones.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 218

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/218](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/218)


בְּאֵין מֵלִיץ יֹֽשֶׁר
מוּל מַגִּיד פֶּֽשַׁע
תַּגִּיד לְיַעֲקֹב דָּבָר, חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט
וְצַדְּקֵֽנוּ בַּמִּשְׁפָּט, הַמֶּֽלֶךְ הַמִּשְׁפָּט.


בְּאֵין With no one to advocate for us against the accuser of sin,
speak words of law and of justice to Jacob;
and absolve us in the judgment, O King of judgment.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 219
