עוֹד יִזְכֹּר לָֽנוּ אַהֲבַת אֵיתָן, אֲדוֹנֵֽינוּ
וּבַבֵּן הַנֶּעֱקָד יַשְׁבִּית מְדַיְּנֵֽינוּ
וּבִזְכוּת הַתָּם יוֹצִיא הַיּוֹם לְצֶֽדֶק דִּינֵֽנוּ
כִּי־קָדוֹשׁ הַיּוֹם לַאֲדֹנֵֽינוּ:


עוֹד He, our LORD,
will yet remember for us the love of [Abraham] the steadfast one.
And for [Isaac] the son who was bound,
He will still the enmity against us.
And for the merit of [Jacob] the innocent man,
He will bring today our judgment out to the good,
for this day is holy to our LORD.

וּבְכֵן יִתְקַדַּשׁ שִׁמְךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִירֶֽךָ
וְעַל צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ וְעַל מַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ
וְעַל מְכוֹנְךָ וְהֵיכָלֶֽךָ.


וּבְכֵן יִתְקַדַּשׁ And so may Your name be sanctified, Lord our God,
through Israel Your nation and Jerusalem, Your city,
and Zion, the dwelling place of Your honor
and through the royal house of David Your anointed,
and Your Sanctuary and Your Temple.

**HOLINESS**


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 223

וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ
וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָֽאתָ
וְיִירָאֽוּךָ כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים
וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ כָּל הַבְּרוּאִים
וְיֵעָשׂוּ כֻלָּם אֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם
כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַֽעְנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ שֶׁהַשָּׁלְטָן לְפָנֶֽיךָ
עֹז בְּיָדְךָ וּגְבוּרָה בִּימִינֶֽךָ
וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָֽאתָ.


וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ And so place the fear of You, LORD our God,
over all that You have made,
and the terror of You over all You have created,
and all who were made will stand in awe of You,
and all of creation will worship You,
and they will be bound all together as one
to carry out Your will with an undivided heart;
for we know, LORD our God,
that all dominion is laid out before You,
strength is in Your palm, and might in Your right hand,
Your name spreading awe over all You have created.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 224

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/224](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/224)


וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יהוה לְעַמֶּֽךָ
תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶֽיךָ וְתִקְוָה טוֹבָה לְדוֹרְשֶֽׁיךָ
וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה לַמְיַחֲלִים לָךְ
שִׂמְחָה לְאַרְצֶֽךָ, וְשָׂשׂוֹן לְעִירֶֽךָ
וּצְמִיחַת קֶֽרֶן לְדָוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ, וַעֲרִיכַת נֵר לְבֶן יִשַׁי מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ.


וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד And so place honor, LORD, upon Your people,
praise on those who fear You
and hope into those who seek You,
the confidence to speak into all who long for You,
gladness to Your land and joy to Your city,
the flourishing of pride to David Your servant,
and a lamp laid out for his descendant,
Your anointed, soon, in our days.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 225

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/225](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/225)


וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ, וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ
וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִֽילוּ, וְעוֹלָֽתָה תִּקְפָּץ פִּֽיהָ
וְכָל הָרִשְׁעָה כֻּלָּהּ כְּעָשָׁן תִּכְלֶה
כִּי תַעֲבִיר מֶמְשֶֽׁלֶת זָדוֹן מִן הָאָֽרֶץ.


וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים And then righteous people will see and rejoice,
and the upright will exult, and the pious revel in joy,
and injustice will have nothing more to say,
and all wickedness will fade away like smoke
as You sweep the rule of arrogance from the earth.

וְתִמְלֹךְ אַתָּה יהוה לְבַדֶּֽךָ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ
בְּהַר צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ, וּבִירוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִיר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
יִמְלֹךְ יהוה לְעוֹלָם, אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר, הַלְלוּיָהּ:


וְתִמְלֹךְ אַתָּה And You, LORD,
will rule alone over those You have made,
in Mount Zion, the dwelling of Your glory,
and in Jerusalem, Your holy city,
as it is written in Your holy writings:
“The LORD shall reign for ever.
He is your God, Zion,
from generation to generation,
Halleluya!”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 227

קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה וְנוֹרָא שְׁמֶֽךָ, וְאֵין אֱלֽוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ
כַּכָּתוּב, וַיִּגְבַּהּ יהוה צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט
וְהָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ נִקְדַּשׁ בִּצְדָקָה:
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, הַמֶּֽלֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ.


קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה You are holy, Your name is awesome,
and there is no god but You, as it is written,
“The LORD of hosts shall be raised up through His judgment,
the holy God, made holy in righteousness.”
Blessed are You, LORD, the holy King.

**קדושת היום**


**HOLINESS OF THE DAY**


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 230

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/230](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/230)


אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים
אָהַֽבְתָּ אוֹתָֽנוּ וְרָצִֽיתָ בָּֽנוּ
וְרוֹמַמְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת
וְקִדַּשְׁתָּֽנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ
וְקֵרַבְתָּֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶֽךָ
וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵֽינוּ קָרָֽאתָ.


אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ You have chosen us from among all peoples.
You have loved and favored us.
You have raised us above all tongues.
You have made us holy
through Your commandments.
You have brought us near, our King, to Your service,
and have called us by Your great and holy name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 231

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/231](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/231)


וַתִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה אֶת
(יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה לִקְדֻשָּׁה וְלִמְנוּחָה, וְאֶת)
יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים הַזֶּה, לִמְחִילָה וְלִסְלִיחָה וּלְכַפָּרָה
וְלִמְחָל בּוֹ אֶת כָּל עֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ
(בְּאַהֲבָה) מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ, זֵֽכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָֽיִם.


וַתִּתֶּן לָֽנוּ And You, LORD our God, have given us in love
(this Sabbath day for holiness and rest, and)
this Day of Atonement
for pardon and forgiveness and atonement,
to pardon all our iniquities,
(with love,) a holy assembly
in memory of the exodus from Egypt.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 232

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/232](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/232)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
יַעֲלֶה וְיָבוֹא וְיַגִּֽיעַ, וְיֵרָאֶה וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע
וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר זִכְרוֹנֵֽנוּ וּפִקְדוֹנֵֽנוּ וְזִכְרוֹן אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
וְזִכְרוֹן מָשִֽׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ
וְזִכְרוֹן יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִיר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, לְפָנֶֽיךָ
לִפְלֵיטָה לְטוֹבָה, לְחֵן וּלְחֶֽסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים, לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם
בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים הַזֶּה.
זָכְרֵֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה, וּפָקְדֵֽנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה
וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים.
וּבִדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים
חוּס וְחָנֵּֽנוּ, וְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ, כִּי אֵלֶֽיךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ
כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה.


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our ancestors,
may there rise, come, reach, appear, be favored, heard,
regarded and remembered before You,
our recollection and remembrance,
as well as the remembrance of our ancestors,
and of the Messiah, son of David Your servant,
and of Jerusalem Your holy city,
and of all Your people the house of Israel –
for deliverance and well-being,
grace, loving-kindness and compassion,
life and peace, on this Day of Atonement.
On it remember us, LORD our God, for good;
recollect us for blessing, and deliver us for life.
In accord with Your promise of salvation and compassion,
spare us and be gracious to us; have compassion on us and deliver us,
for our eyes are turned to You
because You, God, are a gracious and compassionate King.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 235

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/235](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/235)


זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶֽיךָ יהוה וַחֲסָדֶֽיךָ, כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵֽמָּה׃
אַל־תִּזְכָּר־לָֽנוּ עֲוֹנֹת רִאשֹׁנִים
מַהֵר יְקַדְּמֽוּנוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ כִּי דַלּֽוֹנוּ מְאֹד:
זָכְרֵֽנוּ יהוה בִּרְצוֹן עַמֶּֽךָ, פָּקְדֵֽנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ.


זְכֹר Remember, LORD, Your compassion and loving-kindness,
for they are everlasting.
Do not hold against us the sins of those who came before us.
May Your mercies meet us swiftly, for we have been brought very low.
Remember us, LORD, in favoring Your people;
redeem us with Your salvation.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 236

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/236](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/236)


זְכֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִֽיתָ קֶּֽדֶם, גָּאַֽלְתָּ שֵֽׁבֶט נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ, הַר־צִיּוֹן זֶה שָׁכַֽנְתָּ בּוֹ׃


זְכֹר Remember Your congregation, the one that You acquired long ago,
the tribe of Your inheritance that You redeemed,
this Mount Zion that You have dwelt in.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 237

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/237](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/237)


זְכֹר יהוה חִבַּת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם, אַהֲבַת צִיּוֹן אַל תִּשְׁכַּח לָנֶֽצַח.
אַתָּה תָקוּם תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן, כִּי־עֵת לְחֶנְנָהּ, כִּי־בָא מוֹעֵד׃


זְכֹר Remember, LORD, the fondness of Jerusalem;
do not forever forget the love of Zion.
You shall rise up and have compassion for Zion,
for now it is right to be gracious, for the time has come.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 238

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/238](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/238)


זְכֹר יהוה לִבְנֵי אֱדוֹם אֵת יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
הָאוֹמְרִים עָֽרוּ עָֽרוּ, עַד הַיְסוֹד בָּהּ׃


זְכֹר Remember, LORD, what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell.
They said, “Tear it down, tear it down to its very foundations!”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 239

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/239](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/239)


זְכֹר לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ
אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לָהֶם בָּךְ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם
אַרְבֶּה אֶת־זַרְעֲכֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָֽיִם
וְכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָמַֽרְתִּי אֶתֵּן לְזַרְעֲכֶם, וְנָחֲלוּ לְעֹלָם׃


זְכֹר Remember Abraham, Isaac and Yisrael, Your servants,
to whom You swore by Your own Self, when You said to them,
“I shall make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky,
and I shall give all this land that I spoke of to your descendants,
and they shall inherit it forever.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 240

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/240](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/240)


זְכֹר לַעֲבָדֶֽיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב
אַל־תֵּֽפֶן אֶל־קְשִׁי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאֶל־רִשְׁעוֹ וְאֶל־חַטָּאתוֹ׃


זְכֹר Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob;
do not attend to the stubbornness of this people,
to their wickedness or sinfulness.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 242

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/242](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/242)


אַל־נָא תָשֵׁת עָלֵֽינוּ חַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר נוֹאַֽלְנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר חָטָֽאנוּ׃


אַל־נָא Please, do not hold against us the sin
that we committed so foolishly, that we have sinned.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/243](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/243)


חָטָֽאנוּ צוּרֵֽנוּ, סְלַח לָֽנוּ יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ.


We have sinned, our Rock; forgive us, our Creator.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 246

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/246](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/246)


קוֹל גָּדוֹל כְּהִשְׁמִֽיעַ לִרְחוּמִים / קַבְּלוּ מַלְכוּתִי מִמְּקוֹרֵי רְחָמִים
יִזְכֹּר הַיּוֹם לְסָבִיב מֻתְחָמִים / אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים.


קוֹל גָּדוֹל A great voice like that heard by His beloved [at Sinai],
calls upon those born of wombs to “Accept My majesty.”
Recall on this day [Your people] who surrounded the mountain,
O God, King, who sits on a throne of compassion.

חָטָֽאנוּ צוּרֵֽנוּ, סְלַח לָֽנוּ יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ.


We have sinned, our Rock; forgive us, our Creator.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 249

זְכֹר בְּרִית אַבְרָהָם וַעֲקֵדַת יִצְחָק, וְהָשֵׁב שְׁבוּת יַעֲקֹב
וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ.


Remember the covenant of Abraham and the Binding of Isaac,
and restore the fortunes of Jacob, and save us for Your name’s sake.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 251

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/251](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/251)


זְכָר לָֽנוּ בְּרִית אָבוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַֽרְתָּ:
וְזָכַרְתִּי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יַעֲקוֹב
וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יִצְחָק וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אַבְרָהָם אֶזְכֹּר
וְהָאָֽרֶץ אֶזְכֹּר׃


זְכָר Remember the covenant of our fathers, as You have said,
“I will remember My covenant with Jacob, and also My covenant with Isaac, and also My covenant with Abraham I will remember,
and the land I will remember.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 252

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/252](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/252)


זְכָר לָֽנוּ בְּרִית רִאשׁוֹנִים. כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַֽרְתָּ:
וְזָכַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּרִית רִאשֹׁנִים
אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵֽאתִי־אֹתָם מֵאֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַֽיִם לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם
לִהְיוֹת לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים, אֲנִי יהוה׃


Remember the covenant of the early ones, as You have said,
“I shall remember for them the covenant of the early ones,
whom I brought out of the land of Egypt
before the eyes of the nations,
in order to be their God: I am the LORD.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 253

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/253](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/253)


עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ כְּמָה שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּֽנוּ:
וְאַף גַּם־זֹאת בִּהְיוֹתָם בְּאֶֽרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם
לֹא־מְאַסְתִּים וְלֹא־גְעַלְתִּים לְכַלֹּתָם
לְהָפֵר בְּרִיתִי אִתָּם
כִּי אֲנִי יהוה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃


Deal kindly with us as You have promised,
“Even so, when they are in the land of their enemies
I shall not reject them
and shall not detest them to the point of destruction,
to the point of breaking My covenant with them,
for I am the LORD their God.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 254

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/254](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/254)


רַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְאַל תַּשְׁחִיתֵֽנוּ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב:
כִּי אֵל רַחוּם יהוה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ, לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַשְׁחִיתֶֽךָ
וְלֹא יִשְׁכַּח אֶת־בְּרִית אֲבוֹתֶֽיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָהֶם׃


Have compassion for us and do not destroy us, as it is written:
“For the LORD your God is a compassionate God;
He will not forsake you, He will not destroy you,
and He will not forget the covenant of your fathers,
that He pledged to them.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 255

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/255](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/255)


מוֹל אֶת לְבָבֵֽנוּ לְאַהֲבָה אֶת שְׁמֶֽךָ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב:
וּמָל יהוה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ אֶת־לְבָבְךָ וְאֶת־לְבַב זַרְעֶֽךָ
לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יהוה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ
לְמַֽעַן חַיֶּֽיךָ׃


Circumcise our hearts to love Your name, as it is written:
“And the LORD your God will circumcise your heart
and the heart of your descendants
to love the LORD your God with all your heart
and with all your soul,
so that you shall live.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 256

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/256](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/256)


הָשֵׁב שְׁבוּתֵֽנוּ וְרַחֲמֵֽנוּ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב:
וְשָׁב יהוה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ אֶת־שְׁבוּתְךָ וְרִחֲמֶֽךָ
וְשָׁב וְקִבֶּצְךָ מִכָּל־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר הֱפִיצְךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ שָֽׁמָּה׃


Restore our fortunes and have compassion for us, as it is written:
“And the LORD your God shall restore your fortunes
and have compassion for you,
and shall return and gather you in from all the nations
among whom the LORD your God has scattered you.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 257

קַבֵּץ נִדָּחֵֽינוּ כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב:
אִם־יִהְיֶה נִדַּחֲךָ בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמָֽיִם
מִשָּׁם יְקַבֶּצְךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ, וּמִשָּׁם יִקָּחֶֽךָ׃


Gather those of us who have been distanced, as is written,
“If your distanced ones are at the very ends of the heavens,
from there shall the LORD your God gather you;
from there shall He bring you.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 258

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/258](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/258)


הִמָּצֵא לָֽנוּ בְּבַקָּשָׁתֵֽנוּ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב:
וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם מִשָּׁם אֶת־יהוה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ, וּמָצָֽאתָ
כִּי תִדְרְשֶֽׁנּוּ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃


Let us find You when we seek You, as it is written:
“And if from there you seek the LORD your God,
you shall find Him,
when you seek Him out with all your heart
and with all your soul.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 259

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/259](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/259)


מְחֵה פְשָׁעֵֽינוּ לְמַעַנְךָ, כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַֽרְתָּ:
אָנֹכִי אָנֹכִי הוּא מֹחֶה פְשָׁעֶֽיךָ לְמַעֲנִי, וְחַטֹּאתֶֽיךָ לֹא אֶזְכֹּר׃


Wipe out our transgressions for Your sake, as You have said:
“I, I am the One who shall wipe out your transgressions for My sake,
and I shall not recall your sins.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 260

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/260](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/260)


מְחֵה פְשָׁעֵֽינוּ כָּעָב וְכֶעָנָן, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב:
מָחִֽיתִי כָעָב פְּשָׁעֶֽיךָ וְכֶעָנָן חַטֹּאותֶֽיךָ
שׁוּבָה אֵלַי כִּי גְאַלְתִּֽיךָ׃


Wipe out our transgressions as if they were a cloud,
as if they were a haze,
as is written,
“I have wiped out your transgressions like a cloud,
and as a haze your sins;
come back to Me for I have redeemed you.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 261

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/261](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/261)


הַלְבֵּן חֲטָאֵֽינוּ כַּשֶּֽׁלֶג וְכַצֶּֽמֶר, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב:
לְכוּ־נָא וְנִוָּכְחָה, יֹאמַר יהוה
אִם־יִהְיוּ חֲטָאֵיכֶם כַּשָּׁנִים, כַּשֶּֽׁלֶג יַלְבִּֽינוּ
אִם־יַאְדִּֽימוּ כַתּוֹלָע, כַּצֶּֽמֶר יִהְיוּ׃


Whiten our sins as snow and as wool, as is written,
“Come now, let us reason together, says the LORD:
If your sins are like scarlet, they shall be whitened like snow;
should they be as red as crimson, they shall become like wool.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 262

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/262](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/262)


זְרֹק עָלֵֽינוּ מַֽיִם טְהוֹרִים וְטַהֲרֵֽנוּ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב:
וְזָרַקְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַֽיִם טְהוֹרִים, וּטְהַרְתֶּם
מִכֹּל טֻמְאוֹתֵיכֶם וּמִכָּל־גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם אֲטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם׃


Throw over us pure waters and purify us, as is written,
“I shall throw pure waters over you and you shall be pure.
I shall purify you of all your impurities and of all your idolatry.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 263

כַּפֵּר חֲטָאֵֽינוּ בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה וְטַהֲרֵֽנוּ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב:
כִּי־בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם
מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם, לִפְנֵי יהוה תִּטְהָֽרוּ:


Atone our sins on this day and purify us, as it is written,
“For on this day you will be atoned and made pure;
of all your sins before the LORD you shall be purified.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 264

תְּבִיאֵֽנוּ אֶל הַר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ, וְשַׂמְּחֵֽנוּ בְּבֵית תְּפִלָּתֶֽךָ
כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב:
וַהֲבִיאוֹתִים אֶל־הַר קָדְשִׁי, וְשִׂמַּחְתִּים בְּבֵית תְּפִלָּתִי
עוֹלֹתֵיהֶם וְזִבְחֵיהֶם לְרָצוֹן עַל־מִזְבְּחִי
כִּי בֵיתִי בֵּית־תְּפִלָּה יִקָּרֵא לְכָל־הָעַמִּים:


Bring us to Your holy mountain,
and let us rejoice in Your House of prayer,
as is written,
“I shall bring them to My holy mountain,
and I shall make them rejoice in My House of prayer;
their offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted,
desired on My altar,
for My House will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 266

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/266](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/266)


שְׁמַע קוֹלֵֽנוּ, יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, חוּס וְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ
וְקַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן אֶת תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ.


שְׁמַע קוֹלֵֽנוּ Listen to our voice, LORD our God.
Spare us and have compassion on us,
and in compassion and favor accept our prayer.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 267

הֲשִׁיבֵֽנוּ יהוה אֵלֶֽיךָ וְנָשֽׁוּבָ, חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵֽינוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם׃


Turn us back, O LORD, to You, and we will return.
Renew our days as of old.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 268

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/268](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/268)


אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנוּ מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ, וְרֽוּחַ קָדְשְׁךָ אַל תִּקַּח מִמֶּֽנּוּ.


Do not cast us away from You, and do not take Your holy spirit from us.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 269

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/269](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/269)


אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנוּ לְעֵת זִקְנָה, כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחֵֽנוּ אַל תַּעַזְבֵֽנוּ.


Do not cast us away in our old age;
when our strength is gone do not desert us.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 271

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/271](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/271)


אַל תַּעַזְבֵֽנוּ יהוה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אַל תִּרְחַק מִמֶּֽנּוּ.
עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ אוֹת לְטוֹבָה, וְיִרְאוּ שׂוֹנְאֵֽינוּ וְיֵבֹֽשׁוּ
כִּי אַתָּה יהוה עֲזַרְתָּֽנוּ וְנִחַמְתָּֽנוּ.
אֲמָרֵֽינוּ הַאֲזִֽינָה יהוה, בִּֽינָה הֲגִיגֵֽנוּ.


Do not desert us, LORD; our God, do not be distant from us.
Give us a sign of good things,
and those who hate us shall see it and be ashamed,
for You, LORD, will help us and console us.
Hear our speech, LORD, consider our thoughts.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 272

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/272](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/272)


יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִֽינוּ וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבֵּֽנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ, יהוה צוּרֵֽנוּ וְגוֹאֲלֵֽנוּ.
כִּי לְךָ יהוה הוֹחָֽלְנוּ, אַתָּה תַעֲנֶה אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ.


May the words of our mouths and the meditations of our hearts
find favor before You, LORD, our Rock and Redeemer.
For it is You, LORD, that we have longed for;
You shall answer us, LORD our God.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 275

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/275](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/275)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
אַל תַּעַזְבֵֽנוּ, וְאַל תִּטְּשֵֽׁנוּ, וְאַל תַּכְלִימֵֽנוּ, וְאַל תָּפֵר בְּרִיתְךָ אִתָּֽנוּ
קָרְבֵֽנוּ לְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ, לַמְּדֵֽנוּ מִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ
הוֹרֵֽנוּ דְרָכֶֽיךָ, הַט לִבֵּֽנוּ לְיִרְאָה אֶת שְׁמֶֽךָ
וּמוֹל אֶת לְבָבֵֽנוּ לְאַהֲבָתֶֽךָ, וְנָשׁוּב אֵלֶֽיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְלֵב שָׁלֵם
וּלְמַֽעַן שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל תִּמְחֹל וְתִסְלַח לַעֲוֹנֵֽינוּ
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ יהוה, וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֹנִי כִּי רַב־הוּא:


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our ancestors,
do not abandon us and do not desert us,
do not shame us and do not abandon Your covenant with us;
bring us close to Your Torah, teach us Your commandments,
show us Your ways, and turn our hearts toward the awe of Your name.
Circumcise our hearts to love You,
so that we return to You in truth, wholeheartedly.
For the sake of Your great name, pardon and forgive our iniquities,
as it is written in Your holy Writings:
“For the sake of Your name, LORD,
forgive my iniquity, though it is great.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 276

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/276](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/276)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
סְלַח לָֽנוּ, מְחַל לָֽנוּ, כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ.


Our God and God of our ancestors,
forgive us, pardon us, grant us atonement.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 278

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/278](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/278)


כִּי אָֽנוּ עַמֶּֽךָ וְאַתָּה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אָֽנוּ בָנֶֽיךָ וְאַתָּה אָבִֽינוּ
אָֽנוּ עֲבָדֶֽיךָ וְאַתָּה אֲדוֹנֵֽינוּ אָֽנוּ קְהָלֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה חֶלְקֵֽנוּ
אָֽנוּ נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה גוֹרָלֵֽנוּ אָֽנוּ צֹאנֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה רוֹעֵֽנוּ
אָֽנוּ כַּרְמֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה נוֹטְרֵֽנוּ אָֽנוּ פְעֻלָּתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ
אָֽנוּ רַעְיָתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה דוֹדֵֽנוּ אָֽנוּ סְגֻלָּתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
אָֽנוּ עַמֶּֽךָ וְאַתָּה מַלְכֵּֽנוּ אָֽנוּ מַאֲמִירֶֽיךָ וְאַתָּה מַאֲמִירֵֽנוּ.


כִּי אָֽנוּ For we are Your people and You are our God;
we are Your children and You are our Father;
we are Your servants and You are our Master;
we are Your gathering and You are our Place;
we are Your legacy and You are our Land;
we are Your flock and You are our Shepherd;
we are Your vineyard and You are our Keeper;
we are Your work and You are our Maker;
we are Your bride and You are our Lover;
we are Your treasure and You are our God;
we are Your people and You are our King;
we give You our word and You give us Yours.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 280

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/280](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/280)


אָֽנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וְאַתָּה רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן
אָֽנוּ קְשֵׁי עֹֽרֶף וְאַתָּה אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם
אָֽנוּ מְלֵאֵי עָוֹן וְאַתָּה מָלֵא רַחֲמִים
אָֽנוּ יָמֵֽינוּ כְּצֵל עוֹבֵר וְאַתָּה־הוּא וּשְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ לֹא יִתָּֽמּוּ:


We are brazen and You are compassionate, gracious.
We are stubborn and You are long forbearing.
We are as full of iniquity as You are full of compassion.
Our days are like a fleeting shadow.
But You are here, and Your years will not end.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 281

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/281](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/281)


**וידוי**


**VIDUY**


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 283

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/283](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/283)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶֽיךָ תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ, וְאַל תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתֵֽנוּ.
שֶׁאֵין אֲנַֽחְנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וּקְשֵׁי עֹֽרֶף לוֹמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ
יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
צַדִּיקִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְלֹא חָטָֽאנוּ.
אֲבָל אֲנַֽחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ חָטָֽאנוּ.


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our fathers,
let our prayer come before You, and do not hide Yourself from our plea,
for we are not so arrogant or obstinate as to say before You,
LORD, our God and God of our fathers,
we are righteous and have not sinned,
for in truth, we and our fathers have sinned.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 285

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/285](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/285)


אָשַֽׁמְנוּ, בָּגַֽדְנוּ, גָּזַֽלְנוּ, דִּבַּֽרְנוּ דֹֽפִי
הֶעֱוִֽינוּ, וְהִרְשַֽׁעְנוּ, זַֽדְנוּ, חָמַֽסְנוּ, טָפַֽלְנוּ שֶֽׁקֶר
יָעַֽצְנוּ רָע, כִּזַּֽבְנוּ, לַֽצְנוּ, מָרַֽדְנוּ, נִאַֽצְנוּ, סָרַֽרְנוּ
עָוִֽינוּ, פָּשַֽׁעְנוּ, צָרַֽרְנוּ, קִשִּֽׁינוּ עֹֽרֶף
רָשַֽׁעְנוּ, שִׁחַֽתְנוּ, תִּעַֽבְנוּ, תָּעִֽינוּ, תִּעְתָּֽעְנוּ.


אָשַֽׁמְנוּ We have sinned, we have acted treacherously,
we have robbed, we have spoken slander.
We have acted perversely, we have acted wickedly,
we have acted presumptuously, we have been violent, we have framed lies.
We have given bad advice, we have deceived, we have scorned,
we have rebelled, we have provoked, we have turned away,
we have committed iniquity, we have transgressed,
we have persecuted, we have been obstinate.
We have acted wickedly, we have corrupted,
we have acted abominably, we have strayed, we have led others astray.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 287

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/287](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/287)


סַֽרְנוּ מִמִּצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ הַטּוֹבִים, וְלֹא שָֽׁוָה לָֽנוּ.
וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל־הַבָּא עָלֵֽינוּ
כִּי־אֱמֶת עָשִֽׂיתָ, וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ:


סַֽרְנוּ We have turned away from Your commandments and good laws,
to no avail, for You are just in all that has befallen us,
for You have acted faithfully while we have done wickedly.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 288

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/288](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/288)


הִרְשַֽׁעְנוּ וּפָשַֽׁעְנוּ, לָכֵן לֹא נוֹשָֽׁעְנוּ
וְתֵן בְּלִבֵּֽנוּ לַעֲזֹב דֶּֽרֶךְ רֶֽשַׁע, וְחִישׁ לָֽנוּ יֶֽשַׁע
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ
יַעֲזֹב רָשָׁע דַּרְכּוֹ, וְאִישׁ אָֽוֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָיו
וְיָשֹׁב אֶל־יהוה וִירַחֲמֵֽהוּ, וְאֶל־אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ כִּי־יַרְבֶּה לִסְלֽוֹחַ:


We have been wicked and we have transgressed,
and so we have not been saved.
Place it in our hearts to abandon the way of wickedness,
and hasten our salvation,
as it is written by Your prophet:
“Let each wicked person abandon his ways,
each man of iniquity his thoughts,
and let him come back to the LORD
and He will have compassion for him,
back to our God for He will forgive abundantly.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 290

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/290](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/290)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
סְלַח וּמְחַל לַעֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ
בְּיוֹם /*בשבת:* הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וּבְיוֹם/ הַכִּפּוּרִים הַזֶּה
וְהֵעָתֵר לָֽנוּ בִּתְפִלָּתֵֽנוּ
מְחֵה וְהַעֲבֵר פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ
וְכֹף אֶת יִצְרֵֽנוּ לְהִשְׁתַּעְבֶּד לָךְ
וְהַכְנַע עָרְפֵּֽנוּ לָשׁוּב אֵלֶֽיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת
וְחַדֵּשׁ כִּלְיוֹתֵֽינוּ לִשְׁמֹר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ
וּמוֹל אֶת לְבָבֵֽנוּ לְאַהֲבָה וּלְיִרְאָה אֶת שְׁמֶֽךָ
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
וּמָל יהוה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ אֶת־לְבָבְךָ וְאֶת־לְבַב זַרְעֶֽךָ
לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יהוה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ, לְמַֽעַן חַיֶּֽיךָ:
הַזְּדוֹנוֹת וְהַשְּׁגָגוֹת אַתָּה מַכִּיר
הָרָצוֹן וְהָאֹֽנֶס, הַגְּלוּיִים וְהַנִּסְתָּרִים
לְפָנֶֽיךָ הֵם גְּלוּיִים וִידוּעִים.
מָה אָֽנוּ, מֶה חַיֵּֽינוּ
מֶה חַסְדֵּֽנוּ, מַה צִּדְקוֹתֵֽינוּ
מַה יְּשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ, מַה כֹּחֵֽנוּ, מַה גְּבוּרָתֵֽנוּ
מַה נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ, יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
הֲלֹא כָל הַגִּבּוֹרִים כְּאַֽיִן לְפָנֶֽיךָ, וְאַנְשֵׁי הַשֵּׁם כְּלֹא הָיוּ
וַחֲכָמִים כִּבְלִי מַדָּע, וּנְבוֹנִים כִּבְלִי הַשְׂכֵּל
כִּי רֹב מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם תֹּֽהוּ, וִימֵי חַיֵּיהֶם הֶֽבֶל לְפָנֶֽיךָ
וּמוֹתַר הָאָדָם מִן־הַבְּהֵמָה אָֽיִן, כִּי הַכֹּל הָֽבֶל:


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God, and God of our ancestors,
forgive and pardon our iniquities
(*on Shabbat:* this Sabbath day, and on) this Day of Atonement;
be responsive to us as we pray,
wipe away and remove all our transgressions and sins
from before Your eyes,
subdue our urges, that they be submitted to You,
and temper our obstinacy, that we may return to You truly;
renew our conscience that it may guard all Your commands,
and circumcise our hearts that we may love and revere Your name,
as it is written in Your Torah:
“And the LORD your God will circumcise your heart
and the heart of your descendants
to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you shall live.”
The deliberate and the unwitting sins you recognize;
the willful and the compelled,
the open deeds and the hidden –
before You they are all revealed and known.
What are we? What are our lives?
What is our loving-kindness? What is our righteousness?
What is our salvation? What is our strength? What is our might?
What shall we say before You,
LORD our God and God of our ancestors?
Are not all the mighty like nothing before You,
the men of renown as if they had never been,
the wise as if they know nothing,
and the understanding as if they lack intelligence?
For their many works are in vain,
and the days of their lives like a fleeting breath before You.
The pre-eminence of man over the animals is nothing,
for all is but a fleeting breath.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 291

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/291](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/291)


מַה נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יוֹשֵׁב מָרוֹם, וּמַה נְּסַפֵּר לְפָנֶֽיךָ שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים
הֲלֹא כָּל הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת וְהַנִּגְלוֹת אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ.


What can we say before You, You who dwell on high?
What can we declare before You, You who abide in heaven?
Do You not know all, the hidden and revealed alike?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 294

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/294](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/294)


שִׁמְךָ מֵעוֹלָם עוֹבֵר עַל פֶּֽשַׁע
שַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ תַּאֲזִין, בְּעָמְדֵֽנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּתְפִלָּה


שִׁמְךָ Your name has always been the Forgiver of Sins.
Listen to our pleading as we stand before You in prayer.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 295

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/295](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/295)


תַּעֲבֹר עַל פֶּֽשַׁע לְעַם שָׁבֵי פֶֽשַׁע
תִּמְחֶה פְשָׁעֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ.


Overlook sin, for this people returning from sin,
and wipe our transgressions away before Your eyes.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 297

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/297](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/297)


אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ רָזֵי עוֹלָם וְתַעֲלוּמוֹת סִתְרֵי כָּל חָי.
אַתָּה חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן וּבוֹחֵן כְּלָיוֹת וָלֵב.
אֵין דָּבָר נֶעֱלָם מִמֶּֽךָּ וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ.
וּבְכֵן, יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ, יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
שֶׁתִּסְלַח לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ וְתִמְחַל לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל עֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ
וּתְכַפֵּר לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ.


אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ You know every secret since the world began,
and what is hidden deep inside every living thing.
You search each person’s inner chambers,
examining conscience and mind.
Nothing is shrouded from You,
and nothing is hidden before Your eyes.
And so, may it be Your will,
LORD our God and God of our ancestors,
that You forgive us all our sins, pardon all our iniquities,
and grant us atonement for all of our transgressions.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 299

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/299](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/299)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאֹֽנֶס וּבְרָצוֹן
וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאִמּוּץ הַלֵּב


עַל חֵטְא For the sin we have sinned before You under duress or freewill,
and for the sin we have sinned before You in hardness of heart.

###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 340

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/340](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/340)


עַל מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה וְעַל מִצְוַת לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה.
בֵּין שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ קוּם עֲשֵׂה וּבֵין שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ קוּם עֲשֵׂה.
אֶת הַגְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ וְאֶת שֶׁאֵינָם גְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ
אֶת הַגְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ, כְּבָר אֲמַרְנוּם לְפָנֶֽיךָ, וְהוֹדִֽינוּ לְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם
וְאֶת שֶׁאֵינָם גְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ, לְפָנֶֽיךָ הֵם גְּלוּיִים וִידוּעִים
כַּדָּבָר שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר
הַנִּסְתָּרֹת לַיהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, וְהַנִּגְלֹת לָֽנוּ וּלְבָנֵֽינוּ עַד־עוֹלָם
לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת:


עַל מִצְוַת For positive and negative commandments,
whether they can be remedied by an act or not,
for sins known to us and for those that are unknown –
for those that are known,
we have already declared them before You and confessed them to You;
and for those that are unknown, before You they are revealed and known,
as it is said,
“The secret things belong to the LORD our God,
but the things that are revealed are for us and our children for ever,
that we may fulfill all the words of this Torah.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 341

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/341](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/341)


וְדָוִד עַבְדְּךָ אָמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ
שְׁגִיאוֹת מִי־יָבִין, מִנִּסְתָּרוֹת נַקֵּֽנִי:
נַקֵּֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מִכָּל פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ, וְטַהֲרֵֽנוּ מִכָּל טֻמְאוֹתֵֽינוּ
וּזְרֹק עָלֵֽינוּ מַֽיִם טְהוֹרִים וְטַהֲרֵֽנוּ
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ
וְזָרַקְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַֽיִם טְהוֹרִים, וּטְהַרְתֶּם
מִכֹּל טֻמְאוֹתֵיכֶם וּמִכָּל־גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם אֲטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם:


וְדָוִד David Your servant said before You:
“Who can discern his own mistakes? Cleanse me of my hidden faults.”
Cleanse us, LORD our God,
of all our transgressions, and purify us of all our impurities,
and throw clear waters over us to purify us,
as was written by Your prophet:
“I shall throw clear waters over you and you shall be pure.
I shall purify you of all your impurities and of all your idolatry.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 342

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/342](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/342)


אַל תִּירָא יַעֲקֹב
שֽׁוּבוּ בָנִים שׁוֹבָבִים, שֽׁוּבָה יִשְׂרָאֵל.
הִנֵּה לֹא־יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל:
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ
שֽׁוּבָה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד יהוה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ, כִּי כָשַֽׁלְתָּ בַּעֲוֹנֶֽךָ:
וְנֶאֱמַר
קְחוּ עִמָּכֶם דְּבָרִים, וְשֽׁוּבוּ אֶל־יהוה
אִמְרוּ אֵלָיו, כָּל־תִּשָּׂא עָוֹן וְקַח־טוֹב, וּנְשַׁלְּמָה פָרִים שְׂפָתֵֽינוּ:


אַל תִּירָא Do not be afraid, Jacob.
Come back, wayward children, come back Israel.
See: the Guardian of Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps.
As is written by Your prophet,
“Come back, Israel, to the LORD your God,
for you have stumbled in your iniquity.” And it is said,
“Take up words to bring with you, and come back to the LORD.
Tell Him: Forgive all our iniquities and take what is good;
we shall offer up our words instead of bullocks.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 343

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/343](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/343)


וְאַתָּה רַחוּם מְקַבֵּל שָׁבִים
וְעַל הַתְּשׁוּבָה מֵרֹאשׁ הִבְטַחְתָּֽנוּ
וְעַל הַתְּשׁוּבָה עֵינֵֽינוּ מְיַחֲלוֹת לָךְ.


וְאַתָּה And You are compassionate, accepting those who return,
and You have promised us repentance from the very beginning,
and it is for repentance that our eyes search after You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 344

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/344](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/344)


וּמֵאַהֲבָתְךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, שֶׁאָהַֽבְתָּ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ
וּמֵחֶמְלָתְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ, שֶׁחָמַֽלְתָּ עַל בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ
נָתַֽתָּ לָֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת
(*בשבת:* יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה לִקְדֻשָּׁה וְלִמְנוּחָה, וְאֶת)
יוֹם צוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים הַזֶּה
לִמְחִילַת חֵטְא וְלִסְלִיחַת עָוֹן וּלְכַפָּרַת פָּֽשַׁע.


וּמֵאַהֲבָתְךָ And because of Your love, LORD our God,
with which You have loved Your people Israel,
and because of Your mercy, our King, with which You have had mercy on the children of Your covenant,
You have given us, LORD our God,
(*on Shabbat:* this Sabbath day for holiness and rest, and)
this fast day of Yom Kippur for our sins to be pardoned,
our iniquities forgiven and all our rebellions atoned.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 345

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/345](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/345)


יוֹם אֲשֶׁר אֲשָׁמֵֽנוּ יֻצְלַל וְיֻסְגַּר
הַיּוֹם תִּסְלַח לְכָל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר.
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
וְנִסְלַח לְכָל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם
כִּי לְכָל־הָעָם בִּשְׁגָגָה:


יוֹם אֲשֶׁר A day on which our sins shall be cast
into the deep and sealed away.
Today may You forgive the entire congregation of the
children of Israel, along with the strangers in their midst.
As it is written in Your Torah:
And all the congregation of Israel are forgiven,
along with the strangers living in their midst;
for they acted without knowing what they did.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 346

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/346](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/346)


יוֹם בָּגְדֵֽנוּ תִּשָּׂא וְתִסְלַח
הַיּוֹם שִׁמְךָ יֵאָמֵן, אֵל טוֹב וְסַלָּח.
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח, וְרַב־חֶֽסֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶֽיךָ:


A day on which You pardon and forgive our betrayal.
Today Your name shall be proven faithful,
O good and forgiving God.
As it is written in Your holy scriptures:
For You, my LORD, are good and forgiving,
abundantly kind to all who call on You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 347

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/347](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/347)


יוֹם גָּעַֽלְנוּ חֻקֶּֽיךָ, שַׁכַּח וַעֲזֹב
הַיּוֹם רַחֲמֵֽנוּ וְנָשׁוּב וְדֶֽרֶךְ רֶֽשַׁע נַעֲזֹב.
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ
יַעֲזֹב רָשָׁע דַּרְכּוֹ, וְאִישׁ אָֽוֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָיו
וְיָשֹׁב אֶל־יהוה וִירַחֲמֵֽהוּ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ כִּי־יַרְבֶּה לִסְלֽוֹחַ:


A day on which You forget and disregard our debasement
of Your commandments.
Today may You have compassion for us
and we will repent and abandon the ways of the wicked.
As was written by Your prophet:
Let the wicked abandon his ways,
and the man of iniquity his thoughts.
Let him return to the LORD,
who will have compassion for him;
to our God, for He is abundantly forgiving.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 348

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/348](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/348)


יוֹם דָּפְיֵֽנוּ אָנָּא שָׂא נָא
הַיּוֹם קְשֹׁב תַּחֲנוּנֵֽינוּ, וּבְתַחֲנוּן סְלַח נָא.
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
סְלַח־נָא לַעֲוֹן הָעָם הַזֶּה כְּגֹֽדֶל חַסְדֶּֽךָ
וְכַאֲשֶׁר נָשָֽׂאתָה לָעָם הַזֶּה מִמִּצְרַֽיִם וְעַד־הֵֽנָּה׃
וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר
וַיֹּֽאמֶר יהוה, סָלַֽחְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃


A day on which we beg You to forgive us our faults.
Today may You listen to our prayers
and please forgive us graciously.
As it is written in Your Torah:
Please, forgive this people’s iniquity
in the abundance of Your kindness,
as You have forgiven this people
from the time of Egypt until now,
and there it is said:
And the LORD said, I have forgiven as you asked.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 349

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/349](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/349)


בַּעֲבוּר כְּבוֹד שִׁמְךָ
הִמָּצֵא לָֽנוּ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ / סְלַח נָא לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ.


For the honor of Your name,
be responsive to us, You who pardons and forgives,
please forgive us for the sake of Your name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 350

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/350](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/350)


יוֹם חִנְּנָךְ עָנָו, בַּעֲדֵֽנוּ תִּזְכֹּר
הַיּוֹם סְלַח לַעֲוֹנֵֽנוּ, וְחֵטְא אַל תִּזְכֹּר.
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
אַל־תִּזְכָּר־לָֽנוּ עֲוֹנֹת רִאשֹׁנִים
מַהֵר יְקַדְּמֽוּנוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ, כִּי דַלּֽוֹנוּ מְאֹד:


A day on which You recall when [Moses] the humble one prayed to You on our behalf.
Today may You forgive our iniquities and not recall sin.
As it is written in Your holy scripture:
Do not hold against us the sins of those who came before us.
May Your mercies meet us swiftly,
for we have been brought very low.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 351

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/351](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/351)


יוֹם טָעוּתֵֽנוּ יְבֻקַּשׁ וָאָֽיִן
הַיּוֹם נְאֻם הָקֵם, יְבֻקַּשׁ עָוֹן וָאָֽיִן.
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ
בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וּבָעֵת הַהִיא, נְאֻם־יהוה
יְבֻקַּשׁ אֶת־עֲוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ
וְאֶת־חַטֹּאת יְהוּדָה, וְלֹא תִמָּצֶֽאינָה
כִּי אֶסְלַח לַאֲשֶׁר אַשְׁאִיר:


A day on which our mistakes are sought but are not to be found.
Today Your word shall be upheld, that iniquity will be sought yet be nowhere to be found.
As was written by Your prophet:
In those days, at that time, says the LORD,
they will search for Israel’s iniquity
and it will not be there,
they will seek the sins of Judah
and they will be nowhere to be found,
for I shall forgive those I leave behind.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 352

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/352](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/352)


יוֹם יִדְרְשׁוּן מְצָרֵף וּמְטַהֵר
הַיּוֹם מִכָּל חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ אוֹתָֽנוּ תְטַהֵר.
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
כִּי־בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם
מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם, לִפְנֵי יהוה תִּטְהָֽרוּ:


A day when all will seek the One who refines and purifies.
Today may You purify us of all our sins.
As it is written in Your Torah:
For on this day you will be atoned and made pure;
of all your sins before the LORD you shall be purified.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 353

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/353](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/353)


יוֹם כָּל תִּשָּׂא עָוֹן, בְּתַחֲנוּן אֲבַטֶּה
הַיּוֹם לְשַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ אֹֽזֶן הַטֵּה.
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
הַטֵּה אֱלֹהַי אָזְנְךָ וּשֲׁמָע
פְּקַח עֵינֶֽיךָ וּרְאֵה שֹׁמְמֹתֵֽינוּ
וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלֶֽיהָ
כִּי לֹא עַל־צִדְקֹתֵֽינוּ אֲנַֽחְנוּ מַפִּילִים תַּחֲנוּנֵֽינוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ
כִּי עַל־רַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים:
אֲדֹנָי שְׁמָֽעָה, אֲדֹנָי סְלָֽחָה
אֲדֹנָי הַקְשִֽׁיבָה וַעֲשֵׂה אַל־תְּאַחַר
לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהַי, כִּי־שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא עַל־עִירְךָ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ:


A day on which I express my plea that You forgive all iniquity.
Today may You lend Your ear to our cries.
As it is written in Your holy scriptures:
Give ear, my God, and hear;
open Your eyes and see our desolation,
and the city that bears Your name,
for it is not on the strength of our righteousness
that we throw down our pleadings before You,
but on the strength of Your great compassion.
LORD, hear me; LORD, forgive;
LORD, listen and act and do not delay –
for Your sake, my God;
for Your city and Your people bear Your name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 354

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/354](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/354)


בַּעֲבוּר כְּבוֹד שִׁמְךָ
הִמָּצֵא לָֽנוּ שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלָּה / שְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ.


For the honor of Your name,
be responsive to us, You who pardons and forgives,
please forgive us for the sake of Your name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 356

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/356](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/356)


מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ.


Who, God, is like You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 357

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/357](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/357)


אֲהַלֶּלְךָ בְּקוֹל רָם / מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ


I will praise You with a loud voice, / Shield of Abraham.
Who, God, is like You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 358

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/358](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/358)


בְּיָדְךָ מִמְתִים / מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ


If I die let it be by Your hand, / You who revives the dead.
Who, God, is like You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 359

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/359](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/359)


גָּדְלְךָ אֶדְרֹשׁ / הַמֶּֽלֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ


I will seek Your greatness, / O holy King.Who, God, is like You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 360

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/360](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/360)


דּוֹרֵשׁ אִמְרֵי דַֽעַת / חוֹנֵן הַדָּֽעַת מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ


You expound words of wisdom,
You who graciously grants knowledge.Who, God, is like You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 361

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/361](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/361)


הָאוֹמֵר שֽׁוּבָה / הָרוֹצֶה בִּתְשׁוּבָה מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ


You call on us to repent, / You who desires repentance.
Who, God, is like You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 362

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/362](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/362)


וּמוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ / הַמַּרְבֶּה לִסְלֹֽחַ מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ


You pardon and forgive, / You who repeatedly forgives.
Who, God, is like You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 363

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/363](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/363)


קוֹל רִנָּה וְתוֹדוֹת / הַטּוֹב לְךָ לְהוֹדוֹת מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ


The sound of song and thanksgiving,
O Good One, to You gives thanks.Who, God, is like You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 364

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/364](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/364)


רָם בָּרֵךְ קְהַל הֲמוֹנַי / יְבָרֶכְךָ יהוה מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ


Exalted One, bless our gathered assemblies:
“May the LORD bless you.”Who, God, is like You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 365

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/365](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/365)


שְׁכִינָתְךָ שָׁלוֹם / עוֹשֵׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ


Your Presence is peace, / You who makes peace.
Who, God, is like You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 366

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/366](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/366)


תָּבֹא בְרָכָה אֲלֵיכֶם / וְנֹאמַר תְּפִלָּה עֲלֵיכֶם מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ


May blessings come upon you/ for we shall offer a prayer for you.
Who, God, is like You?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 368

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/368](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/368)


תַּעֲבֹר עַל פֶּֽשַׁע / לְעַם שָׁבֵי פֶֽשַׁע
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ
מִי־אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ
נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וְעֹבֵר עַל־פֶּֽשַׁע לִשְׁאֵרִית נַחֲלָתוֹ
לֹא־הֶחֱזִיק לָעַד אַפּוֹ כִּי־חָפֵץ חֶֽסֶד הוּא:
יָשׁוּב יְרַחֲמֵֽנוּ
יִכְבֹּשׁ עֲוֹנֹתֵֽינוּ
וְתַשְׁלִיךְ בִּמְצֻלוֹת יָם כָּל־חַטֹּאתָם:
וְכָל חַטֹּאת עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל תַּשְׁלִיךְ
בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִזָּכְרוּ וְלֹא יִפָּקְדוּ
וְלֹא יַעֲלוּ עַל לֵב לְעוֹלָם.
תִּתֵּן אֱמֶת לְיַעֲקֹב
חֶֽסֶד לְאַבְרָהָם
אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ מִֽימֵי קֶֽדֶם:


Overlook sin / for this people returning from sin.
As was written by Your prophet:
Who, God, is like You,
who forgives iniquity
and overlooks the transgression of the remnant of Your heritage.
He does not remain angry forever, for He desires loving-kindness.
He shall relent and show us compassion,
He shall suppress our iniquities,
casting all of our sins
into the depths of the sea.
And all the sins of Your nation,
the house of Israel,
cast them down where they shall not be remembered
nor recalled nor come to mind ever again.
Grant truth to Jacob,
loving-kindness to Abraham,
as You promised our ancestors
in ancient times.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 370

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/370](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/370)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
מְחַל לַעֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ בְּיוֹם (הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וּבְיוֹם) הַכִּפּוּרִים הַזֶּה
מְחֵה וְהַעֲבֵר פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ
כָּאָמוּר
אָנֹכִי אָנֹכִי הוּא מֹחֶה פְשָׁעֶֽיךָ לְמַעֲנִי
וְחַטֹּאתֶֽיךָ לֹא אֶזְכֹּר׃
וְנֶאֱמַר
מָחִֽיתִי כָעָב פְּשָׁעֶֽיךָ וְכֶעָנָן חַטֹּאותֶֽיךָ
שׁוּבָה אֵלַי כִּי גְאַלְתִּֽיךָ׃
וְנֶאֱמַר
כִּי־בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם
מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם, לִפְנֵי יהוה תִּטְהָֽרוּ:
(אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵֽנוּ)
קַדְּשֵֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ
שַׂבְּעֵֽנוּ מִטּוּבֶֽךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵֽנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ
(וְהַנְחִילֵֽנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
וְיָנֽוּחוּ בוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶֽךָ)
וְטַהֵר לִבֵּֽנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת
כִּי אַתָּה סָלְחָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל
וּמָחֳלָן לְשִׁבְטֵי יְשֻׁרוּן בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר
וּמִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה
מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ לַעֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ
וְלַעֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל
וּמַעֲבִיר אַשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ בְּכָל שָׁנָה וְשָׁנָה
מֶֽלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ, מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ) יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים.


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ Our God and God of our ancestors,
pardon our iniquities
on (this Sabbath day, and on) this Day of Atonement;
wipe away and remove all our transgressions and sins
from before Your eyes,
as it is said:
“I, I am the One who shall wipe out your transgressions
for My sake, and I shall not recall your sins.”
And it is said:
“I have wiped out your transgressions like a cloud,
and as a haze your sins;
come back to Me for I have redeemed you.”
And it is said:
For on this day you will be atoned and made pure;
of all your sins before the LORD you shall be purified.
(Our God and God of our ancestors, find favor in our rest.)
Make us holy through Your commandments
and grant us our share in Your Torah.
Satisfy us with Your goodness,
grant us joy in Your salvation
(in love and favor, O LORD our God,
grant us as our heritage Your holy Sabbath,
so that Israel, who sanctify Your name,
may find rest on it),
and purify our hearts to serve You in truth.
For You are the Forgiver of Israel
and the Pardoner of the tribes of Yeshurun in every generation,
and without You we have no king who pardons and forgives,
none but You.
Blessed are You, LORD,
King who pardons and forgives our iniquities
and those of all His people the house of Israel,
and makes our guilt pass away, every single year,
King of all the earth, who sanctifies (the Sabbath,)
Israel and the Day of Atonement.

###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 372

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/372](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/372)


רְצֵה יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִתְפִלָּתָם
וְהָשֵׁב אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶֽךָ
וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם בְּאַהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן
וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ.
וְתֶחֱזֶֽינָה עֵינֵֽינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן.


רְצֵה Find favor, LORD our God,
in Your people Israel and their prayer.
Restore the service to Your most holy House,
and accept in love and favor
the fire-offerings of Israel and their prayer.
May the service of Your people Israel
always find favor with You.
And may our eyes witness Your return to Zion
in compassion.
Blessed are You, LORD,
who restores His Presence to Zion.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 373

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/373](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/373)


**הודאה**


**THANKSGIVING**


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 375

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/375](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/375)


מוֹדִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ לָךְ
שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.
צוּר חַיֵּֽינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ
אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר.
נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ
עַל חַיֵּֽינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶֽךָ
וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ
וְעַל נִסֶּֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּֽנוּ
וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶֽיךָ
שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת, עֶֽרֶב וָבֹֽקֶר וְצָהֳרָֽיִם.
הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וְהַמְרַחֵם, כִּי לֹא תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ
מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ.


מוֹדִים We give thanks to You,
for You are the LORD our God
and God of our ancestors
for ever and all time.
You are the Rock of our lives,
Shield of our salvation
from generation to generation.
We will thank You and
declare Your praise for our lives,
which are entrusted into Your hand;
for our souls,
which are placed in Your charge;
for Your miracles
which are with us every day;
and for Your wonders and favors
at all times, evening, morning and midday.
You are good –
for Your compassion never fails.
You are compassionate –
for Your loving-kindnesses never cease. We have always placed our hope in You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 377

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/377](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/377)


מוֹדִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ לָךְ
שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
אֱלֹהֵי כָל בָּשָׂר
יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ, יוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית.
בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת
לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ
עַל שֶׁהֶחֱיִיתָֽנוּ וְקִיַּמְתָּֽנוּ.
כֵּן תְּחַיֵּֽנוּ וּתְקַיְּמֵֽנוּ
וְתֶאֱסֹף גָּלֻיּוֹתֵֽינוּ
לְחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ
לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֶּֽיךָ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶֽךָ וּלְעָבְדְּךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם
עַל שֶׁאֲנַֽחְנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ.
בָּרוּךְ אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת.


מוֹדִים We give thanks to You,
for You are the LORD our God
and God of our ancestors,
God of all flesh,
who formed us
and formed the universe.
Blessings and thanks
are due to Your great
and holy name for giving us life and sustaining us.
May You continue
to give us life and sustain us;
and may You gather our exiles to Your holy courts,
to keep Your decrees,
do Your will and serve You with a perfect heart,
for it is for us
to give You thanks.
Blessed be God to whom thanks­giving is due.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 378

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/378](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/378)


וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד.


For all these things may Your name be blessed and exalted,
our King, continually, for ever and all time.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 380

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/380](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/380)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ
זְכֹר רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וּכְבֹשׁ כַּעַסְךָ
וְכַלֵּה דֶֽבֶר, וְחֶֽרֶב, וְרָעָב, וּשְׁבִי, וּמַשְׁחִית
וְעָוֹן וּמַגֵּפָה, וּפֶֽגַע רַע וְכָל מַחֲלָה, וְכָל תַּקָּלָה
וְכָל קְטָטָה וְכָל מִינֵי פֻּרְעָנֻיּוֹת, וְכָל גְּזֵרָה רָעָה וְשִׂנְאַת חִנָּם
מֵעָלֵֽינוּ וּמֵעַל כָּל בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ.


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ Our Father, our King,
remember Your compassion and overcome Your anger,
and efface pestilence, sword,
famine, captivity and destruction,
iniquity and plague, and bad mishap and all illness, and any harm,
and any feud, and all kinds of afflictions,
and all harsh decrees and baseless hatred,
from us and from all the people of Your covenant.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 382

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/382](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Shaharit/r/382)


וּכְתֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ.


וּכְתֹב And write, for a good life,
all the children of Your covenant.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Leader's Repetition for Shaharit 384

וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת

**FULL KADDISH**


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Shaharit, Avinu Malkenu 52

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/52](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Shaharit,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/52)


*ש״ץ:* יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא (*קהל:* אָמֵן)
בְּעָלְמָא דִּי בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ, וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ
בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְּכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל
בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן. (*קהל:* אָמֵן)


*Leader:* יִתְגַּדַּל Magnified and sanctified
may His great name be,
in the world He created by His will.
May He establish His kingdom
in your lifetime and in your days,
and in the lifetime of all the house of Israel,
swiftly and soon – and say: Amen.

*All:* May His great name be blessed for ever and all time.

וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל
שְׁמֵהּ דְּקֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא (*קהל:* בְּרִיךְ הוּא)
לְעֵֽלָּא לְעֵֽלָּא מִכָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא, תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחֱמָתָא
דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן. (*קהל:* אָמֵן)


*Leader:* Blessed and praised, glorified and exalted,
raised and honored, uplifted and lauded be
the name of the Holy One, blessed be He,
above and beyond any blessing,
song, praise and consolation
