He causes the dew to fall.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/30)


מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶֽסֶד, מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים
סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים, וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים, וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים
וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר.
מִי כָמֽוֹךָ, בַּֽעַל גְּבוּרוֹת, וּמִי דּֽוֹמֶה לָּךְ
מֶֽלֶךְ, מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִֽיחַ יְשׁוּעָה.


He sustains the living with loving-kindness,
and with great compassion revives the dead.
He supports the fallen, heals the sick, sets captives free,
and keeps His faith with those who sleep in the dust.
Who is like You, Master of might,
and who can compare to You,
O King who brings death and gives life,
and makes salvation grow?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/33)


יוֹם מִיָּמִים הוּחָס / יוֹם כִּפּוּר הַמְיֻחָס
יוֹדְעָיו חֲמֹל וְחַס / יוֹקְשָׁיו לְפוֹעֶֽרֶת הַס.


יוֹם מִיָּמִים The most eminent of days,
the distinguished Day of Atonement – to those who observe it knowingly, may You show pity and compassion
Silence those who would ensnare us, sending them into the mouth of hell.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/34)


וּבוֹ בְּתַחְבּוּלוֹת יוּעָֽצוּ / וִדּוּי בְּתַֽחַן יָאִֽיצוּ
וְשׁוֹכְנֵי עָפָר יָקִֽיצוּ / וּמֵרֹאשׁ הָרִים יָלִֽיצוּ.


To confound the accusing angel they adopt the strategy
of bringing forward the confession in their prayers.
May our ancestors rise from the earth
to plead on our behalf from the mountaintops.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/35)


מִפְעֲלוֹת עוֹקֵד וְעָקוּד / מֵאָז בְּיָדָם פָּקוּד
מוֹפֵת הַכָּמוּס לְפִקּוּד / מוֹקֵשׁ לְהַבְעִית בְּסִקּוּד.


The deeds of [Abraham] the one who bound and [Isaac] the bound one
have since been entrusted to Your people,
concealed for eternal remembrance as an example,
to scare off the Adversary as one shoos an animal.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/36)


כְּהַבְטָחַת סְבִיכַת אַֽיִל / כָּפְרוֹ הַנָּצוּר לְחַֽיִל
כֵּן תַּעֲצִים חַֽיִל / כּוֹרְעֶֽיךָ בְּעֶֽצֶם וָלַֽיִל.


Like the promise of the ram entangled in the brush,
as ransom for Isaac, safeguarded for Your valorous nation,
thus please increase the strength
of those who bow before You day and night.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/37)


פַּחְדּוֹ יָחִיל שׂוֹטְמִים / פִּיּוֹתָם הֱיוֹת אֲטוּמִים
פְּרָחָיו בְּמִשְׁעֲנוֹתָם חֲטוּמִים / פַּלְּטֵם מֵרֶֽכֶל פִּטּוּמִים.


May the Dread [of Isaac] cause our slanderers to tremble
until their mouths are stopped up and sealed.
May [Isaac’s] offspring be protected as they rely on You,
and be rescued from the idle gossip of their enemies.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/38)


וְאִם אֵין מַעֲשִׂים / וְזֶֽבַח מִבְּלִי מֵשִׂים
וְזָכְרָה לְנִבְזִים וּמְאוּסִים / וּמִגִּזְעָם הָפֵר כְּעָסִים.


If we are devoid of good deeds
and without offerings to place on the altar,
recall Your scorned, downtrodden people,
and remove Your anger from their offspring.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/39)


רָם קֹשְׁטְ מַעְבָּדֶֽיךָ / רָאֹה תִרְאֶה עוֹבְדֶֽיךָ
רֵעִים בָּאֵי עָדֶֽיךָ / רַחוּם זְכֹר לַעֲבָדֶֽיךָ.


Exalted One, Your works are true;
behold the people who worship You.
They approach You so faithfully –
O Compassionate One, remember Your servants.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/40)


יְבֻקַּשׁ עָוֹן וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ / יָֽמָּה בִמְצוּלוֹת תְּנֶֽנּוּ
יֶֽלֶד בְּשַׁעֲשׁוּעָיו תַּעֲנֶֽנּוּ / יֹֽשֶׁר מֵלִיץ יְחֻנֶּֽנּוּ.


When sin is sought let it not be found,
cast it into the depths of the sea.
Child of Your delight, answer his plea;
the uprightness of his advocate shall bring him pardon.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/41)


מִבְּרַק חֶֽרֶב הַשָּׁנוּן / מַלֵּט מַאֲרִיכֵי רִנּוּן
מַלֵּא מִשְׁאֲלוֹתָם בְּתַחֲנוּן / מֶֽלֶךְ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן.


From the flash of the sharpened sword
rescue those who sing Your praise at length.
Fulfill their requests of their pleas,
O compassionate and gracious King.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/43)


כֹּֽפֶר פִּדְיוֹן נֶֽפֶשׁ / פְּדֵה מִטְּבִיעַת רֶֽפֶשׁ
מְיַחֲלֶֽיךָ בְּעִנּוּי וְכֹֽפֶשׁ / הַחֲיֵם בְּטַלְלֵי נֹֽפֶשׁ.


The price for redemption of the soul
please pay, that they sink not into the mire.
Those who abase and afflict themselves as they pray to You,
revive them with Your life-giving dew.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/46)


עוֹד בּוֹ נִשְׁמָתוֹ / יְקַו תְּשׁוּבַת יְצִיר אַדְמָתוֹ
לְהַחֲיוֹתוֹ, לְהֵיטִיב אַחֲרִיתוֹ.


עוֹד בּוֹ As long as man’s spirit is yet in him,
[God] will hope for the repentance of those formed from His earth;
to bring him life, to bring goodness to his future.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/48)


אֱנוֹשׁ אֵיךְ יִצְדַּק פְּנֵי יוֹצְרוֹ / וְהַכֹּל גָּלוּי לוֹ, תַּעֲלוּמוֹ וְסִתְרוֹ
בְּזֹאת יְכֻפַּר עֲוֹנוֹ וְיִגְהֶה מְזוֹרוֹ / אִם יָשׁוּב טֶֽרֶם יִכְבֶּה נֵרוֹ.


אֱנוֹשׁ אֵיךְ יִצְדַּק How can a person justify himself before his Creator
when all is revealed before Him, secrets and mysteries?
Yet his sin may be atoned and his wound healed
if he repents before his candle is extinguished.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 49

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/49](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/49)


גַּם חֹֽשֶׁךְ לֹא יַחְשִׁיךְ מִמֶּֽנּוּ / אִם יַסְתִּיר פָּנִים, הוּא יְשׁוּרֶֽנּוּ
דָּפְיוֹ וְרִשְׁעוֹ עַל פָּנָיו יַעֲנֶֽנּוּ / יִתְרוֹן לוֹ, אִם בְּחַיָּיו יוֹדֶֽנּוּ.


Even darkness can hide nothing from Him,
though man may hide his face, God still sees him.
His blemishes and wickedness shall testify against him,
yet if he confess them in his lifetime this shall be to his advantage.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 50

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/50](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/50)


הֵן שָׁמַֽיִם לֹא זַכּוּ בְּעֵינָיו / וְאַף כִּי נִתְעָב בַּאֲשָׁמָיו וּבַעֲוֹנָיו
וְזֵד לָֽמָּה לֹא יָבִין בְּרַעְיוֹנָיו / הֲלֹא יוֹמוֹ וְאֵידוֹ נֹֽכַח פָּנָיו.


The very hosts of heaven are not pure in His eyes;
all the more so man, who through guilt and iniquity has made himself despised.
So why does the evildoer not fathom in his thoughts
that the hour of his calamity impends?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 51

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/51)


זְהָבוֹ וּסְגֻלַּת עָשְׁרוֹ לֹא יוֹעִילֶֽנּוּ /
לָתֵת כָּפְרוֹ בְּיוֹם עֶבְרָה, לְהוֹעִילֶֽנּוּ
חֶֽסֶד וּצְדָקָה, אִם רוֹדֵף בְּעוֹדֶֽנּוּ /
לְפָנָיו יַהֲלֹךְ וּכְבוֹד בּוֹרְאוֹ יַאַסְפֶֽנּוּ.


No profit shall stem from the treasures man has amassed nor all his gold;
they shall not ransom him on the day of God’s wrath.
If he pursues charity and kindness throughout his life,
then his righteousness shall precede him and the glory of his Creator shall follow him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 52

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/52](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/52)


טוֹב לַגֶּֽבֶר לִשָּׂא עֹל תּוֹרָה /
לְקַיֵּם חֻקֶּֽיהָ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְיִרְאָה וּבְטָהֳרָה
יְמֵי חַיָּיו תַּנְחֶֽנּוּ מְסִלָּה יְשָׁרָה /
תִּנְצְרֶֽנּוּ בִּקְבוּרָה וְלִתְחִי תְּשִׂיחֶֽנּוּ לְעֶזְרָה.


It is good for a man to bear the Torah’s yoke,
in love, awe, and purity to fulfill all its commandments.
For it shall guide him on a straight, paved path through his life,
safeguard him in his grave and assist him in the afterlife.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 53

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/53](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/53)


שַׁדַּי הִנְנוּ בְיָדְךָ כְּיוֹצֵר חֹֽמֶר /
רְצוֹנְךָ לְהַחֲיוֹת וְלֹא לְהָמִית וּלְגַמֵּר
תְּיַשֵּׁר לְבָבֵֽנוּ בְּיִרְאָתְךָ לְהַחֲטִיב וּלְהַאֲמֵר /
וְקַיְּמֵֽנוּ לְחַיִּים, וְנוֹדְךָ לְעוֹלָם וּנְזַמֵּר.


O Almighty, we are before You like clay in the potter’s hands;
You will us to live, and not to die and meet our end.
Straighten our hearts in awe of You that we might declare Your Oneness and dedicate ourselves to You.
Sustain us, grant us life, and we shall forever thank You and sing Your praise.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 55

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/55](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/55)


מִי כָמֽוֹךָ אַב הָרַחֲמִים
זוֹכֵר יְצוּרָיו לְחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים.


מִי כָמֽוֹךָ Who is like You, compassionate Father,
who remembers His creatures in compassion, for life?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 56

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/56](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/56)


וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת מֵתִים.
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יהוה, מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים.


Faithful are You to revive the dead.
Blessed are You, LORD, who revives the dead.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 59

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/59](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/59)


צְפֵה בְּבַת תְּמוּתָה / צוֹם הֶעָשׂוֹר עֲמוּתָה
צֹאן בְּהֵעָנְשָׁהּ מִיתָה / צַדְּקָהּ מִמֶּֽכֶר צְמִיתָה.


צְפֵה בְּבַת תְּמוּתָה Behold Your mortal children,
observing this Fast of the Tenth.
Should Your flock be condemned to die for their sins,
justify them that they might be saved from eternal bondage.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 60

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/60](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/60)


וּבְבֹא שׂוֹטֵן לִנְקֹב / וְלַחֲשֹׂף שַׂרְעַף עָקֹב
וּבַל יֵרָשֶׁה לִקֹּב / וֶֽכַח תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב.


When the Accuser comes forth with his list,
laying bare hidden thoughts and perversions,
do not grant him any authority to curse
or rebuke the offspring of Jacob.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 61

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/61](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/61)


מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּשׂוּמֶֽךָ / מֵאָז חֲקַקְתּוֹ בְּרִשּׁוּמֶֽךָ
מוֹלְדוֹתָיו הַכְּלוּלִים בִּשְׁמֶֽךָ / מַלְּטֵם לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ.


When You established the site of Your eternal home,
from then You engraved the image of Jacob upon Your throne.
May his offspring, whose name contains Yours,
be saved for the sake of Your name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 62

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/62](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/62)


הִזָּכֵר יְשִׁיבַת אֹֽהַל / הַמַּאֲבֵק לְשַׂר גַּֽחַל
הַצִּֽילָה שְׁאוֹנוֹ מִבַּֽהַל / הַצָּגִים לְהַרְטוֹת מַֽחַל.


Recall Jacob, who dwelled innocently in Your tents,
who struggled with the angel of fiery coals.
Save his hordes of descendants from sudden terror,
bandage their wounds with forgiveness as they gather before You.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 63

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/63](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/63)


עִנּוּי נֶֽפֶשׁ שׁוּר / עָוֹן בְּלִי תָשׁוּר
עוֹרְכֵי שֶֽׁוַע בְּיִשּׁוּר / עֲנֵם בֶּאֱמֶת וְאִשּׁוּר.


See how they afflict their souls;
their iniquity please do not behold.
Those who cry out before You candidly,
answer them with truth and acceptance.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 64

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/64](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/64)


סְלַח לְשָׁבֵי פֶֽשַׁע / סְלִיחָה תַּכְרִֽיעַ רֶֽשַׁע
סִדּוּר תְּשׁוּבָה תִּֽשַׁע / שֵֽׂבֶר פְּדוּת לְיֶֽשַׁע.


Forgive those who turn away from transgression;
may Your forgiveness outbalance evil.
Heed the repentance they offer You in their well-ordered pleas,
grant them the redemption and salvation they hope for.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 65

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/65](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/65)


וְאִם הֵֽמָּה כְּאָדָם / וּמוֹעֲדָה וּמָֽטָה יָדָם
וְאַתָּה נוֹצֵר הָאָדָם / וִתָּרוֹן תְּנָה לְעוֹדְדָם.


If they transgress Your covenant as did Adam,
and should their hands falter or fail them,
then may You who are man’s Creator,
grant forgiveness and give them strength.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 66

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/66](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/66)


רְעָבָם וּצְמָאָם חֲזֵה / רָעָתָם בְּלִי תֶחֱזֶה
רֶֽגֶשׁ רַחֲשָׁם מִלִּבְזֶה / רוֹנְנִים, סְלַח נָא לַעֲוֹן הָעָם הַזֶּה.


Behold their hunger and thirst,
look not upon their evil actions.
Do not scorn their words and strong emotions
as they sing, “Please forgive the iniquity of this nation.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 68

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/68](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/68)


יִמְלֹךְ יהוה לְעוֹלָם
אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר
הַלְלוּיָהּ:


The LORD shall reign for ever.
He is your God, Zion, from generation to generation,
Halleluya!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 69

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/69](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/69)


וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל:
אֵל נָא.


You are the Holy One, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
God, please.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 72

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/72](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/72)


נֵחָשֵׁב כְּצָג בָּאִיתוֹן / דְּחוֹת בְּפִלְלִי עֲקַלָּתוֹן
וְנַקְדִּישְׁךָ בְּשַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן / קָדוֹשׁ.


נֵחָשֵׁב May we be considered like [the high priest]
standing at the Temple entrance,
may our prayers push aside [the Accuser,] that crooked serpent,
and may we sanctify You on this Sabbath of utter rest, / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 73

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/73](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/73)


הַיּוֹם בְּפָתְחֲךָ סְפָרִים / חֹן אֹם שִׁמְךָ מְפָאֲרִים
וְנַקְדִּישְׁךָ בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים / קָדוֹשׁ.


On this day as You open the books of life and death,
grant grace to Your nation, those who glorify Your name,
and may we sanctify You on this Day of Atonement, / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 74

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/74](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/74)


מַשְׂטִין בְּכֶֽבֶל אֱסֹר / וְתִקְוַת אֲסִירַי בְּשֹׂר
וְנַקְדִּישְׁךָ בְּצוֹם הֶעָשׂוֹר / קָדוֹשׁ.


Bind the Accuser in chains,
and herald new hope to the captives of my nation,
and may we sanctify You on this Fast of the Tenth, / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 76

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/76](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/76)


אֶשָּׂא דֵעִי לְמֵרָחוֹק / שְׁעוֹן בְּאָת מֵרָחוֹק / בְּפָעֳלוֹ צָרִי דְחֹק.


אֶשָּׂא דֵעִי I shall lift my thoughts to my glorious past
and rely upon [Abraham] who came from afar,
that the merits of his deeds might push my oppressor aside.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 77

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/77](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/77)


אֲסַפְּרָה אֶל חֹק / מִסֻּכּוֹ בְּלִי לִרְחֹק / חַיִּים לִי לָחֹק.


I shall pray in accordance with the laws of the Torah, / that God not stray from His permanent abode, / to inscribe me for life.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 78

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/78](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/78)


לְשֹׁד כְּחֶֽתֶף יִמְחֹק / לוֹחֲמִי לְבַל יִשְׂחֹק / וְיִמָּלֵא פִי שְׂחוֹק.


May the Accuser be swiftly erased, / that my oppressor might not ridicule me, / and may my mouth fill with laughter.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 79

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/79](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/79)


נֵחָשֵׁב כְּצָג בָּאִיתוֹן / דְּחוֹת בְּפִלְלִי עֲקַלָּתוֹן
וְנַקְדִּישְׁךָ בְּשַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן / קָדוֹשׁ.


May we be considered like [the high priest] standing at the Temple entrance, / may our prayers push aside [the Accuser,] that crooked serpent,
and may we sanctify You on this Sabbath of utter rest, / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 80

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/80](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/80)


עוֹרְכֵי שֶֽׁוַע לָרֹב / חִין עֶרְכָּם יַעֲרֹב / פְּנֵי אֱלֹהֵי מִקָּרוֹב.


Those who offer their abundant cries, / may the prayers they prepare be pleasing to You, / and let them come close to God’s presence.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 81

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/81](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/81)


עֲתִירָתִי אָז תִּקְרֹב / עֲבֵרָתִי בַּל תֶּאֱרֹב / אֵלַי לְבַל קְרֹב.


May my plea then draw near, / let my sins not lie in wait for me
and do not allow them to attack me.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 82

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/82](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/82)


זוֹמֵם אִם יִזְרֹב / עֲדַת אֵל לַחֲרֹב / אֶשָּׁעֵן בְּמַצְדִּיק וְקָרוֹב.


Should my enemies plot to burn / and to destroy God’s congregation,
I shall rely upon the One who justifies me and is always close.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 83

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/83](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/83)


הַיּוֹם בְּפָתְחֲךָ סְפָרִים / חֹן אֹם שִׁמְךָ מְפָאֲרִים
וְנַקְדִּישְׁךָ בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים / קָדוֹשׁ.


On this day as You open the books of life and death, / grant grace to Your nation, those who glorify Your name, / and may we sanctify You on this Day of Atonement, / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 84

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/84](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/84)


רֶֽשַׁע אִם הִכְרִיעִי / זְכָר לִי רוֹעִי / צִדְקוֹ עַתָּה לְרוֹעֲעִי.


Should my evil deeds seem to decide my fate,
recall [Moses] my shepherd,
that his good deeds might draw me close to You as a friend.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 85

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/85](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/85)


רְעֵה צֹאן מַרְעִי / בְּמִרְעֶה טוֹב לְהַרְעִי / וּבְאוֹר חַיִּים לְזָרְעִי.


Tend Your faithful flock, / guide me through a bountiful pasture,
and plant the light of life within me.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 86

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/86](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/86)


בַּעֲוֹן אֹֽרַח רִבְעִי / וּבְקַו נְטִיַּת מְרֵעִי / נָא אַל יְאָרְעִי.


For the iniquity of my way of life / as the measure of my sins abounds,
please, may no evil befall me.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 87

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/87](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/87)


מַשְׂטִין בְּכֶֽבֶל אֱסֹר / וְתִקְוַת אֲסִירַי בְּשֹׂר
וְנַקְדִּישְׁךָ בְּצוֹם הֶעָשׂוֹר / קָדוֹשׁ.


Bind the Accuser in chains, / and herald new hope to the captives of my nation, / and may we sanctify You on this Fast of the Tenth, / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 88

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/88](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/88)


יַסְכִּֽיתוּ שֽׁוּבוּ לְבִצָּרוֹן / גָּשִׁים פְּנֵי אָרוֹן / לְהַעֲצִים אֲרֶֽשֶׁת רֹן.


May they learn of His return to His fortress, / those who approach the holy Ark / to forcefully sound their prayerful song.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 89

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/89](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/89)


יְחַלּוּ רִאשׁוֹן וְאַחֲרוֹן / מַשְׁבִּית אַף וְחָרוֹן / בְּזֹאת יָבֹא אַהֲרֹן.


They shall await the One who is first and last, / He who causes His anger and ire to pass, / so that Aaron may come forth.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 90

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/90](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/90)


רוֹעֲשִׁים קְרֹא בְגָרוֹן / פִּלּוּס אֲטוּמֵי חֶבְרוֹן /
מְצֹא מְחִילַת וִתָּרוֹן.


For those who lustily cry out their throaty pleas,
weigh the merits of the ancestors buried in Hebron,
that they might find forgiveness and pardon.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 91

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/91](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/91)


נֵחָשֵׁב כְּצָג בָּאִיתוֹן / דְּחוֹת בְּפִלְלִי עֲקַלָּתוֹן
וְנַקְדִּישְׁךָ בְּשַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן / קָדוֹשׁ.


May we be considered like [the high priest] standing at the Temple entrance, / may our prayers push aside [the Accuser,] that crooked serpent,
and may we sanctify You on this Sabbath of utter rest, / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 92

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/92](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/92)


בְּשִׁבְתּוֹ בְּכֵס רִיב / יְרִיבַי לְעֵינַי יָרִיב / יָהּ נִצָּב לָרִיב.


As He sits on the throne of judgment, / may He take up my cause against my enemy in my presence, / for in my struggles He stands by me.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 93

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/93](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/93)


בּוֹזְזַי חָרֹב יַחֲרִיב / כְּמוֹ קַדְמוֹנִים הֶחֱרִיב / וְנַאֲקִי לְפָנָיו יַקְרִיב.


May He destroy those who would plunder and pillage me,
just as He laid waste to those who came previously,
and hear my groans and accept my pleas.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 94

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/94](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/94)


יֻצַּג אִתִּי בְּרִיב / מְלִיצַי שַׁי לְהַקְרִיב / וְשִׂיחִי לְגֹחִי יַעֲרִיב.


May He stand by me in judgment,
and may the merits of my ancestors speak on my behalf,
that my prayers might be pleasing to my Creator.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 95

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/95](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/95)


הַיּוֹם בְּפָתְחֲךָ סְפָרִים / חֹן אֹם שִׁמְךָ מְפָאֲרִים
וְנַקְדִּישְׁךָ בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים / קָדוֹשׁ.


On this day as You open the books of life and death, / grant grace to Your nation, those who glorify Your name, / and may we sanctify You on this Day of Atonement, / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 96

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/96](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/96)


קוֹל אָרִים כַּשּׁוֹפָר / בְּמַתַּן אִמְרֵי שְׁפָר / לִפְנֵי חֲזָקִים שִׁפָּר.


I shall raise my voice like the shofar,
which resounded as the pleasing words of the Torah were given
before the One who beautified the mighty heavens.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 97

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/97](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/97)


קֶֽצֶב שְׂעִירִים וּפָר / בְּנִיב שְׂפָתַֽיִם יְסֻפָּר / וּבְכֵן שׂוֹטֵן יֻחֲפָר.


The abundance of goats and cattle, once offerings,
shall be replaced by the prayers my mouth is uttering,
that the Accuser might be shamed.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 98

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/98](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/98)


לִפְלוּסִים כְּכוֹכְבֵי מִסְפָּר / וְשָׁחִים עַד עָפָר /
בִּצְעָם וְעִוּוּיָם יְכֻפָּר.


For the people measured as the unnumbered stars,
who have sunk down to the dust in exile,
may they find atonement for the iniquity of nefarious gains.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 99

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/99](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/99)


מַשְׂטִין בְּכֶֽבֶל אֱסֹר / וְתִקְוַת אֲסִירַי בְּשֹׂר
וְנַקְדִּישְׁךָ בְּצוֹם הֶעָשׂוֹר / קָדוֹשׁ.


Bind the Accuser in chains, / and herald new hope to the captives of my nation, / and may we sanctify You on this Fast of the Tenth, / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 100

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/100](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/100)


יֻשְׁלְגוּ אָדְמֵי שָׁנִים / שֶׁל כָּל יְמוֹת הַשָּׁנִים /
חֲדָשִׁים וְגַם יְשָׁנִים.


May the crimson threads of iniquity turn white as snow, / all those sins committed in the year before, / the new as well as the old.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 101

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/101](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/101)


יֻלְבְּנוּ כִּתְמֵי שׁוֹשַׁנִּים / וְיוּשְׁבוּ לְתַעֲרָם שְׁנוּנִים /
בְּפִלּוּל אֲשֶׁר מְשַׁנְּנִים.


May the blemishes of Israel, Your lily, be cleansed;
may the polished swords be returned to their sheaths,
through the prayers we recite over and over again.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 102

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/102](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/102)


רַחֲצוּ וְהִזַּכּוּ מֵעִשּׁוּנִים / לְאִוֶּֽלֶת מִהְיוֹת שׁוֹנִים /
וְעַל מִבְטָחֵֽימוֹ שְׁעוּנִים.


Cleanse us and purify us from our smoldering sins,
that we might not repeat our folly again,
and let us be supported by our hope in Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 103

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/103](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/103)


נֵחָשֵׁב כְּצָג בָּאִיתוֹן / דְּחוֹת בְּפִלְלִי עֲקַלָּתוֹן
וְנַקְדִּישְׁךָ בְּשַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן / קָדוֹשׁ


May we be considered like [the high priest] standing at the Temple entrance, / may our prayers push aside [the Accuser,] that crooked serpent,
and may we sanctify You on this Sabbath of utter rest, / O Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 106

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/106](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/106)


אֶת לַחֲשִׁי עֲנֵה נָא / זַעֲקִי רְצֵה נָא / הָאֵל קָדוֹשׁ.


אֶת לַחֲשִׁי Please answer my whispered plea,
please accept my cry, / O Holy God.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 107

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/107](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/107)


אָדוֹן לְקוֹל עַמֶּֽךָ / זְכֹר רַחֲמֶֽיךָ / נוֹרָא וְקָדוֹשׁ.


O Master, at the voice of Your nation,
remember Your compassion, / O Awesome and Holy One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 110

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/110](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/110)


וּבְכֵן, אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים, מַה־נּוֹרָא מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ:


And so, you shall say of God: How awesome are Your works!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 112

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/112](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/112)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ בְּעוֹלָמוֹ / מֵחִישׁ פְּדוּת עַמּוֹ
לְקַיֵּם אֶת דְּבַר נָאֳמוֹ / כִּי סְלִיחָה עִמּוֹ
הוֹדוּ לַיהוה קִרְאוּ בִשְׁמוֹ::


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים Say of God:
God, King of the world, / who hastens the redemption of His nation,
that they might fulfill His divine word,
for forgiveness lies with Him alone.
Thank the LORD, call on His name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 113

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/113](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/113)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
בָּרוּךְ וּמְהֻלָּל בְּרֹב גָּדְלוֹ / מֵחִישׁ סְלִיחָה לִקְהָלוֹ
לְהַרְאוֹת לַכֹּל גָּדְלוֹ / מָדַד מַֽיִם בְּשָׁעֳלוֹ
שִֽׁירוּ לוֹ זַמְּרוּ־לוֹ:


Say of God:
He is blessed and praised in His abundant grandeur;
He hastens forgiveness for His congregation,
to make His greatness known to all,
for He measured the waters in His palm.
Sing to Him, make music to Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 114

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/114](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/114)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
גּוֹאֵל עַם קְדוֹשׁוֹ / בִּסְלִיחָה לְהַקְדִּישׁוֹ
לְכוֹנֵן בֵּית מִקְדָּשׁוֹ / לָכֵן זֶֽרַע אַבְרָהָם קְדוֹשׁוֹ
הִתְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ:


Say of God:
He redeems His holy nation, / sanctifying them with His forgiveness,
to found His holy Temple
for they are the seed of Abraham, His holy one.
Glory in His holy name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 115

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/115](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/115)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
דָּגוּל וּמְהֻלָּל בִּרְקִֽיעַ עֻזּוֹ / סוֹלֵֽחַ לְעַם זוּ בְּזוֹ
בִּדְבַר עֻזּוֹ וּמָעֻזּוֹ / לָכֵן אַתֶּם עַם עֲדַת מָעֻזּוֹ
דִּרְשׁוּ יהוה וְעֻזּוֹ:


Say of God:
Exalted and praised in His mighty heavens,
He forgives this [His chosen] nation on this [day],
by the word of His power and His stronghold,
for You are His nation, the congregation of His fortress.
Search out the LORD and His strength.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 116

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/116](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/116)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
הַכֹּל בְּמַאֲמָר עָשָׂה / וְהוּא פָעַל וְעָשָׂה
סוֹלֵֽחַ לְאֹם עֲמוּסָה / לָכֵן עַם בּוֹ חָסָה
זִכְרוּ נִפְלְאֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה:


Say of God:
He created the entire world with His word;
indeed, He wrought and made it all.
He forgives the nation He has borne since birth;
therefore, they seek refuge in Him.
Remember the wonders He has done.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 117

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/117](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/117)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
וּמֵקִים דְּבַר עַבְדּוֹ / עַל אֶֽרֶץ וְשָׁמַֽיִם הוֹדוֹ
סוֹלֵֽחַ לְעַם מְיַחֲדוֹ / אֲשֶׁר נִקְרְאוּ בִּדְבַר סוֹדוֹ
זֶֽרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹ:


Say of God:
He confirms the word of His servant;
over earth and heaven is His splendor.
He forgives the nation that proclaims His unity,
those called in His mystic scriptures:
descendants of Yisrael His servant.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 118

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/118](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/118)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
זֶה רֹקַע הָאָֽרֶץ / הַיּוֹשֵׁב עַל חוּג הָאָֽרֶץ
סוֹלֵֽחַ לְגוֹי אֶחָד בָּאָֽרֶץ / לָכֵן אִמְרוּ לְיוֹסֵד אָֽרֶץ
הוּא יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ:


Say of God:
He stretched the land over the sea;
He sits above the circle of the earth.
He forgives that unique nation,
so say to the Founder of the earth,
He is the LORD our God over all the earth.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 119

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/119](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/119)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
חַי בִּמְעוֹנָתוֹ / חַנּוּן וְחוֹנֵן עֲדָתוֹ
יָשׁוּב בְּרַחֲמִים לְבֵיתוֹ / לָכֵן בָּאֵי בִבְרִיתוֹ
זִכְרוּ לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ:


Say of God:
He resides in [Zion] His abode;
He is full of compassion and deals kindly with His congregation.
He shall return compassionately to His home,
and so, those who entered His covenant shall
remember His covenant for ever.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 120

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/120](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/120)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
טַפֵּי נַחֲלָתוֹ / טְלָאֵי יְרֻשָּׁתוֹ
יְקַיֵּם עָלֵֽימוֹ אִמְרָתוֹ / כְּחָקוּק בְּתוֹרָתוֹ
אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־אַבְרָהָם, וּשְׁבוּעָתוֹ:


Say of God:
You are His children, His heritage;
You are His flock, His inheritance.
May He fulfill His word through us / as inscribed in His Torah,
according to the covenant He made with Abraham,
and His vow [to Isaac].


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 121

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/121](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/121)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
יוֹעֵץ מֵישָׁרִים לְחֹק / יְרֵאָיו לְחַיִּים לָחֹק
סוֹלֵֽחַ חֵטְא הַנֵּחוֹק / כְּנִשְׁמַע לָרוֹעֶה מֵרָחוֹק
וַיַּעֲמִידֶֽהָ לְיַעֲקֹב לְחֹק:


Say of God:
He guides the honest with His laws;
those who fear Him are inscribed in the book of life.
He forgives all recorded sins,
as was heard by [Moses] the shepherd from afar,
He confirmed it to Jacob as a statute.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 122

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/122](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/122)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים
תַּקִּיף אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם / דְּבָרוֹ נִצָּב לְעוֹלָם
וְהוּא מִכֹּל נֶעֱלָם / וְאָֽנוּ מְהַלְלִים שְׁמוֹ לְעוֹלָם
בָּרוּךְ יהוה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָעוֹלָם וְעַד־הָעֹלָם:


Say of God:
All-Powerful One, the eternal God –
His word will stand firm for all eternity,
and He cannot be known, / and we praise His name to eternity.Blessed is the LORD, God of Israel, from This World to eternity.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 124

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/124](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/124)


וּבְכֵן, גְּדוֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂי אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ.


Indeed, the works of our God are sublime.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 126

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/126](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/126)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
אַדִּיר בְּוִעוּדוֹ / בְּרוּם וּבְתַֽחַת הוֹדוֹ
גִּלָּה אוֹר לְעוֹבְדוֹ / דְּבָרוֹ מֵקִים לְעַבְדּוֹ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, אֵין עוֹד מִלְּבַדּוֹ:


The work of our God:
Majestic in His assembly;
His glory shining above and below;
He revealed light to the one who served Him,
He will keep His word to His servant.
Therefore, exalt Him, the One with none other besides Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 127

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/127](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/127)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
הַמַּכִּיר עוֹלְמֵי עַד / וְסוֹפֵר וּמוֹנֶה עֲדֵי עַד
זִיו מוֹשָׁבוֹ נוֹעַד / חֶֽלֶד צוֹפֶה בְּמִסְעָד
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, הַמַּבִּיט לָאָֽרֶץ וַתִּרְעָד:


The work of our God:
He knows all worlds, / counts and numbers all times.
The radiance of His throne comes forth
and He watches over the earth to uphold it.
Therefore, exalt Him, He who gazes at the earth and it trembles.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 128

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/128](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/128)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
טוֹעֵן הֲדוֹמוֹ / יוֹדֵֽעַ עוֹלָמוֹ
כְּלָלוֹ בְּנָאֳמוֹ / לָעַד לַהֲקִימוֹ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, יהוה צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ:


The work of our God:
He carries His footstool; / He knows His world well.
He made all of it together as He spoke,
and established it forever.
Therefore, exalt Him – the LORD of hosts is His name.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 129

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/129](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/129)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
מוֹשֵׁל בְּמִפְעָלוֹ / נוֹרָא עַל זְבוּלוֹ
סִלּוּדוֹ כְּגָדְלוֹ / עֻזּוֹ בְּרֹב חֵילוֹ
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, שְׂרָפִים עֹמְדִים מִמַּֽעַל לוֹ:


The work of our God:
He rules over all that He has made, / awesome over His Temple.
As great as He is, so is He to be praised.
His might is felt in His army.
Therefore, exalt Him – Seraphim stand before Him.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 130

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/130](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/130)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
פְּאֵרוֹ בִּשְׁמֵי מְעוֹנַי / צוֹפֶה וּמַבִּיט לְעֵינַי
קִלּוּס שְׁמוֹ בַּהֲמוֹנַי / רוֹדֶה בְּקֶֽרֶב מוֹנַי
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, גְּדֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂי יהוה:


The work of our God:
His splendor fills the heaven of His dwelling.
I see Him watching and noticing all.
He is exalted in the multitudes of my people.
He holds sway over those who oppress me.
Therefore, exalt Him – great are the works of the LORD.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 132

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/132](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/132)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱנוֹשׁ
תַּחְבּוּלוֹתָיו מְזִמָּה / שִׁבְתּוֹ בְּתוֹךְ מִרְמָה
רְפִידָתוֹ רִמָּה / קָבוּר בִּסְעִיף אֲדָמָה
וְאֵיךְ יִתְגָּאֶה, אָדָם לַהֶֽבֶל דָּמָה:


The deeds of man:
His plans are mere plots, / he lives in a world of deceit,
his berth is lined with maggots, / buried in a crevice in the ground.
Then how can man be exalted,
when he is like a vain breath?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 134

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/134](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/134)


אֲבָל מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
שַׁדַּי רוֹקַע אֶֽרֶץ עַל בְּלִימָה / שׁוֹכְנֶֽיהָ בְּלִי הֱיוֹת לְשַׁמָּה
תִּכֵּן עַל מַֽיִם אֲדָמָה / תֹּֽקֶף שְׁמוֹ לְרוֹמְמָה
לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה, עֹטֶה־אוֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָה:


But the work of our God:
The Almighty spreads the earth over nothingness,
never letting her inhabitants be desolate,
setting land firm above waters,
that the might of His name be ennobled.
Therefore, exalt Him, He who is clothed in majesty and splendor.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 138

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/138](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/138)


וּבְכֵן, לְנוֹרָא עֲלֵיהֶם בְּאֵימָה יַעֲרִֽיצוּ.


And so, in awe, they shall revere
the One whose fear is upon them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 140

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/140](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/140)


אֲשֶׁר אֵימָתֶֽךָ
בְּאֶרְאֶלֵּי אֹֽמֶן / בְּאַבִּירֵי אֹֽמֶץ
בִּבְלוּלֵי קֶֽרַח / בִּבְדוּדֵי קֶֽדַח וּמוֹרָאֲךָ עֲלֵיהֶם.


אֲשֶׁר אֵימָתֶֽךָ Even though Your dread is
upon the faithful angels, / the mighty heavenly hosts,
created of ice, / mixed with fire –
and Your awe is upon them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 141

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/141](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/141)


וְאָבִֽיתָ תְהִלָּה
מִגְּלוּמֵי גוּשׁ / מִגָּרֵי גַיְא
מִדְּלוּלֵי פֹֽעַל / מִדַּלֵּי מַֽעַשׂ וְהִיא תְהִלָּתֶֽךָ.


Yet You desire praise
from those formed from earth, / denizens of the valleys below,
whose actions are meager / and good deeds few in number –
and this is Your praise!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 142

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/142](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/142)


אֲשֶׁר אֵימָתֶֽךָ
בַּהֲמוֹן מַלְאָכִים / בְּהִלּוּךְ מַחֲנוֹת
בְּוַֽעַד אֲלָפִים / בְּוֶֽכַח רְבָבוֹת וּמוֹרָאֲךָ עֲלֵיהֶם.


Even though Your dread is
upon the hordes of angels / in their roaming camps,
assemblies of thousands, / gatherings of appointed myriads –
and Your awe is upon them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 143

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/143](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/143)


וְאָבִֽיתָ תְהִלָּה
מִזִּיו שׁוֹנֶה / מִזֹּֽהַר כָּבֶה
מֵחֲסֵרֵי שֵֽׂכֶל / מֵחוֹרְשֵׁי רֶֽשַׁע וְהִיא תְהִלָּתֶֽךָ.


Yet You desire praise
from beings of mutable splendor, / whose brilliance dims,
who lack intelligence / and plot evil –
and this is Your praise!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 144

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/144](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/144)


אֲשֶׁר אֵימָתֶֽךָ
בְּטִפּֽוּחַ עֲרָבוֹת / בְּטִכּוּס שְׁחָקִים
בְּיִשְׁרַת עֲרָפֶל / בִּירִיעַת מְעוֹנָה וּמוֹרָאֲךָ עֲלֵיהֶם.


Even though Your dread is
in spreading out the heavens, / arranging the skies,
ordering the dark clouds, / laying out Your abode –
and Your awe is upon them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 145

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/145](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/145)


וְאָבִֽיתָ תְהִלָּה
מִכְּתוּמֵי שֶֽׁמֶץ / מִכְּמוּסֵי כֶֽתֶם
מִלְּכוּדֵי פַח / מִלְּעוּנֵי מַר וְהִיא תְהִלָּתֶֽךָ.


Yet You desire praise
from those blemished by sin, / whose stain is concealed,
who are ensnared by the evil inclination, / bitter as poison –
and this is Your praise!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 146

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/146](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/146)


אֲשֶׁר אֵימָתֶֽךָ
בְּמַסְלוּלֵי זְבוּל / בִּמְרוֹמֵי שְׁפַר
בִּנְטִיַּת דֹּק / בִּנְחִיַּת עָבִים וּמוֹרָאֲךָ עֲלֵיהֶם.


Even though Your dread is
in the pathways of heaven, / in the glorious heights,
in spreading the skies like a veil / and guiding the clouds –
and Your awe is upon them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 147

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/147](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/147)


וְאָבִֽיתָ תְהִלָּה
מִסְּרוּחֵי מַֽעַשׂ / מִשְּׂבֵעֵי רֹֽגֶז
מֵעֲדוּרֵי אֱמֶת / מֵעֲמוּסֵי בָֽטֶן וְהִיא תְהִלָּתֶֽךָ.


Yet You desire praise
from those who reek of evil deeds, / saturated with anger,
devoid of truth, / yet borne [by God] from the womb –
and this is Your praise!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 148

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/148](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/148)


אֲשֶׁר אֵימָתֶֽךָ
בְּפוֹתְחֵי קָדוֹשׁ / בְּפוֹצְחֵי בָרוּךְ
בִּצְדוּדֵי אַרְבַּע / בִּצְנוּפֵי שֵׁשׁ שֵׁשׁ וּמוֹרָאֲךָ עֲלֵיהֶם.


Even though Your dread is
in those [angels] who open their mouths to say “Holy,”
who proclaim “Blessed One,”
whose faces are turned in all four directions,
and are swathed in six wings –and Your awe is upon them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 149

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/149](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/149)


וְאָבִֽיתָ תְהִלָּה
מִקְּרוּאֵי עַֽיִן / מִקּוֹרְאֵי בְחִנּוּף
מֵרְחֵקֵי אֱמֶת / מֵרֵיקֵי צֶֽדֶק וְהִיא תְהִלָּתֶֽךָ.


Yet You desire praise
from those referred to as nothingness,
who call upon Him while tainted with sin,
distant, as they are, from truth, / and devoid of all righteousness –
and this is Your praise!


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 150

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/150](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/150)


אֲשֶׁר אֵימָתֶֽךָ
בִּשְׁבִיבֵי אֵשׁ / בִּשְׁבִילֵי מַֽיִם
בִּתְלוּלֵי רוֹם / בְּתַלְתַּלֵּי גֹֽבַהּ וּמוֹרָאֲךָ עֲלֵיהֶם.


Even though Your dread is
in the sparks of fire / and the great paths of water,
the steep heights / and spiraling heavens –
and Your awe is upon them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 151

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/151](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/151)


וְאָבִֽיתָ תְהִלָּה מִבָּשָׂר וָדָם / מֵהֶֽבֶל וָתֹֽהוּ
מֵחָצִיר יָבֵשׁ / מִצֵּל עוֹבֵר / וּמִצִּיץ נוֹבֵל
מַשְׁלִימֵי נֶֽפֶשׁ / מַפְרִיחֵי רֽוּחַ / וּמְעִיפֵי חַיָּה
וַחֲנִיטֵי נְשָׁמָה / וּמוֹצִיאֵי יְחִידָה
וְנִשְׁמָעִים בַּדִּין / וּמֵתִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט
וְחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים / וְנוֹתְנִים לְךָ פְּאֵר חַי עוֹלָמִים
וְתִפְאַרְתְּךָ עֲלֵיהֶם.


Yet You desire praise
from creatures of flesh and blood, / vanity and confusion;
from withered chaff, / a passing shadow,
and a faded flower; / from those whose lifeblood passes away,
whose spirit departs, / whose life flies from them,
whose spirit wanes, / whose unique essence is removed,
who are heard in judgment, / who die by Your verdict,
who live through Your compassion, / and who give You honor,
the One who lives for ever –for Your glory is upon them.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 155

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/155](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/155)


לְיוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת / לְרוֹכֵב עֲרָבוֹת / קָדוֹשׁ וּבָרוּךְ.


To the One enthroned upon praises, / who rides upon the clouds, O Holy and Blessed One.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 157

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/157](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/157)


אַמִּיצֵי שְׁחָקִים מִמַּֽעַל / וְכָל צְבָא מַֽעַל אוֹמְרִים קָדוֹשׁ
אֱמוּנֵי אַהֲבָה / וְצִמְחֵי רְבָבָה אוֹמְרִים בָּרוּךְ
בְּכִתֵּי מַלְאָכִים / שְׁמוֹ מַמְלִיכִים אוֹמְרִים קָדוֹשׁ
בְּנֵי בְחוּרֵי בְרִית / לְזוֹכֵר הַבְּרִית קָדוֹשׁ וּבָרוּךְ.


אַמִּיצֵי שְׁחָקִים Mighty angels of heaven above, / and all the heavenly hosts
say, “O Holy One.”
Your faithful beloved / and flowering myriads say, “O Blessed One.”
Groups of angels / who crown His name say, “O Holy One.”
The chosen people of the covenant / say to the One who recalls His covenant:
“O Holy and Blessed One.”

To the One enthroned upon praises, / who rides upon the clouds,
O Holy and Blessed One.

גִּבּוֹרֵי כֹֽחַ / לְאַמִּיץ וְשַׂגִּיא כֹֽחַ אוֹמְרִים קָדוֹשׁ
גְּדוֹלֵי צְדָקָה / לַנִּקְדָּשׁ בִּצְדָקָה אוֹמְרִים בָּרוּךְ
דְּמוּת אַרְבַּע פָּנִים / לְכָל צַד פּוֹנִים אוֹמְרִים קָדוֹשׁ
דִּגְלֵי נְצוּרָה / לְעִמָּם בְּצָרָה קָדוֹשׁ וּבָרוּךְ.


Those strong in power, / to the One who is mighty and supremely powerful
say, “O Holy One.”
Those great in righteousness, / to the One who is sanctified in righteousness
say, “O Blessed One.”
Those [angels] of four facets, / turning in all directions say, “O Holy One.”
The bannered and protected ones / say to the One who is with them in their times of trouble: “O Holy and Blessed One.”

To the One enthroned upon praises, / who rides upon the clouds,
O Holy and Blessed One.

הֲמוֹן צְבָא הֲמֻלָּה / לְשׁוֹכֵן מַֽעְלָה אוֹמְרִים קָדוֹשׁ
הוֹלְכֵי דֶֽרֶךְ תָּמִים / לְהַצּוּר תָּמִים אוֹמְרִים בָּרוּךְ
וְרָצִים וְשָׁבִים / טַֽעַם צוּר מַקְשִׁיבִים אוֹמְרִים קָדוֹשׁ
וְקֹוֵי יְשׁוּעוֹת / וְחוֹכֵי סְלִיחוֹת קָדוֹשׁ וּבָרוּךְ.


The great hordes of heaven, / to the One who dwells on high say, “O Holy One.”
Those who follow God’s path innocently, / to the perfect Rock say, “O Blessed One.”
Angels in their comings and goings, / heeding the commandments of the Rock,
say, “O Holy One.”
Those who hope for salvation / and await His forgiveness: “O Holy and Blessed One.”

זֶֽרַע מַטַּע אֱמֶת / לְאֵל אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת אוֹמְרִים בָּרוּךְ
חַשְׁמַלִּים עַזִּים / לְעוֹשֵׂה חֲזִיזִים אוֹמְרִים קָדוֹשׁ
חוֹנִים וְנוֹשְׂאִים / לְמַעֲלֵה נְשִׂיאִים קָדוֹשׁ וּבָרוּךְ.


In plentiful song, / the pure ones of heaven say, “O Holy One.”
The offspring of the faithful ancestor, / to the true Lord God say, “O Blessed One.”
Intensely sparkling angels, / to the One who sends forth lightning bolts
say, “O Holy One.”
The desert travelers / say to the One who raises up the clouds:
“O Holy and Blessed One.”

טֹֽבוּ אֹהָלָיו / יוֹנְקָיו וְעוֹלְלָיו אוֹמְרִים בָּרוּךְ
יִדֹּדוּן הוֹלְכִים / כּוֹרְעִים וּבוֹרְכִים אוֹמְרִים קָדוֹשׁ.
יוֹשְׁבֵי אֹֽהֶל וּמִשְׁכָּן / לִבְתוֹכָם שָׁכָן קָדוֹשׁ וּבָרוּךְ.


The angels on high, / to the Loftiest One say, “O Holy One.”
[Israel] in its goodly tents, / its infants and babes say, “O Blessed One.”
Angels hastening, / bowing and kneeling say, “O Holy One.”
Dwellers of Your Tent and Sanctuary
say to the One who dwells in their midst: “O Holy and Blessed One.”

כֶּֽתֶר נוֹתְנִים / בְּנֵי אֵיתָנִים אוֹמְרִים בָּרוּךְ
לַהֲקַת שְׁבִיבִים / וְאֵשׁ לְהָבִים אוֹמְרִים קָדוֹשׁ
לְמַעֲנוֹ גּוֹי אֶחָד / לְשֵׁם אֵל הַמְיֻחָד קָדוֹשׁ וּבָרוּךְ.


Angels en masse,
together with Ḥayyot and Ophanim, say, “O Holy One.”
Subjects who crown their King,
descendants of mighty ancestors say, “O Blessed One.”
Clusters of fiery angels / in their flaming sparks say, “O Holy One.”
The unique nation He created for His sake,
declares the uniqueness of God’s name: “O Holy and Blessed One.”

Swathed angels fluttering, / on outspread wings flying say, “O Holy One.”

to the One who is righteous in His awesome deeds say, “O Holy One.”
The nobles of Your nation / exalt Your name: “O Holy and Blessed One.”

Seraphim standing before You,
bowing and giving thanks say, “O Holy One.”
Those who recoil in fear
before the One who is awesome in His works say, “O Blessed One.”

as with precious stones say, “O Holy One.”
Your chanting congregations
say in whispers and full voices: “O Holy and Blessed One.”

say, “O Holy One.”

say, “O Holy One.”

say, “O Blessed One.”
Those with feet like calves’ hooves / and rolling wheels say, “O Holy One.”
Those desired by their Creator / say to the Lofty One who fashioned them:
“O Holy and Blessed One.”

Those who dwell in the shadow of the Almighty,
whose years are not numbered say, “O Holy One.”
The observers of Your laws, / commandments, and statutes say, “O Blessed One.”
The powerful angels / scurrying in the heights say, “O Holy One.”
The innocent in their ways / and in the work of their hands:
“O Holy and Blessed One.”

אֵֽלּוּ לְאֵֽלּוּ שׁוֹאֲלִים
אֵֽלּוּ לְאֵֽלּוּ מְמַלְּלִים
אָֽנָה שׁוֹכֵן מְעֻלִּים
לְהַעֲרִיצוֹ, לְהַקְדִּישׁוֹ בִּפְאֵר מְסַלְסְלִים.


אֵֽלּוּ They inquire of one another,
they speak with one another:
Where is the Lord who lives on high,
that we might exalt and sanctify Him
with splendid words of praise?


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 186

וּבְכֵן לְךָ תַעֲלֶה קְדֻשָּׁה, כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ.


וּבְכֵן לְךָ And so, sanctity will rise up to You;
for You, our God, are King.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 188

וּנְתַנֶּה תֹּֽקֶף קְדֻשַּׁת הַיּוֹם / כִּי הוּא נוֹרָא וְאָיֹם
וּבוֹ תִּנַּשֵּׂא מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ / וְיִכּוֹן בְּחֶֽסֶד כִּסְאֶֽךָ / וְתֵשֵׁב עָלָיו בֶּאֱמֶת.
אֱמֶת, כִּי אַתָּה הוּא דַיָּן וּמוֹכִֽיחַ, וְיוֹדֵֽעַ וָעֵד
וְכוֹתֵב וְחוֹתֵם וְסוֹפֵר וּמוֹנֶה
וְתִזְכֹּר כָּל הַנִּשְׁכָּחוֹת / וְתִפְתַּח אֶת סֵֽפֶר הַזִּכְרוֹנוֹת
וּמֵאֵלָיו יִקָּרֵא / וְחוֹתַם יַד כָּל אָדָם בּוֹ.


וּנְתַנֶּה תֹּֽקֶף Let us voice the power of this day’s sanctity –
it is awesome, terrible;
on this day Your kingship is raised,
Your throne is founded upon love,
and You, with truth, sit upon it.
In truth, it is You: Judge and Accuser, Knowing One and Witness,
writing and sealing, counting, numbering,
remembering all forgotten things,
You open the book of memories –
it is read of itself, / and every man’s name is signed there.

וּמַלְאָכִים יֵחָפֵזוּן / וְחִיל וּרְעָדָה יֹאחֵזוּן

visiting all the heavenly host for judgment –”
for they are not cleared in Your eyes in judgment.
And all who have come into this world pass before You like sheep.

בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה On Rosh HaShana it is written / and on Yom Kippur it is sealed: / how many will pass away and how many will be born; / who will live and who will die; / who in his due time and who before; / who by water and who by fire; / who by sword and who by beast; / who of hunger and who of thirst; / who by earthquake and who by plague; / who by strangling and who by stoning; / who will rest and who will wander; / who will be calm and who will be harassed; / who will be at ease and who will suffer; / who will become poor and who will grow rich; / who cast down and who raised high.

“The LORD shall reign for ever.
He is your God, Zion, from generation to generation, Halleluya!”

לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נַגִּיד גָּדְלֶֽךָ, וּלְנֵֽצַח נְצָחִים קְדֻשָּׁתְךָ נַקְדִּישׁ
וְשִׁבְחֲךָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מִפִּֽינוּ לֹא יָמוּשׁ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ אָֽתָּה.


From generation to generation we will declare Your greatness,
and we will proclaim Your holiness for evermore.
Your praise, our God, shall not leave our mouth forever,
for You, God, are a great and holy King.

וְיֹאמְרוּ לְךָ חוֹסֶֽיךָ בְּצַדֶּֽקְךָ עֲמוּסֶֽיךָ
תֻּקְדַּשׁ אָדוֹן עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ


חֲמֹל Have mercy on those You have made,
take joy in those You made,
and those who shelter in You will say,
as You absolve the ones You bear,
“Be sanctified, Lord, through all that You have made.”

נָאֶה לְקָדוֹשׁ פְּאֵר מִקְּדוֹשִׁים.


כִּי מַקְדִּישֶֽׁיךָ For with Your holiness You sanctify
all who affirm You holy;
it is fitting that the Holy One be glorified by holy ones.

וּבְכֵן יִתְקַדַּשׁ שִׁמְךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ
עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ
וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִירֶֽךָ
וְעַל צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ
וְעַל מַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ
וְעַל מְכוֹנְךָ וְהֵיכָלֶֽךָ.


וּבְכֵן יִתְקַדַּשׁ And so may Your name be sanctified, Lord our God,
through Israel Your nation
and Jerusalem, Your city,
and Zion, the dwelling place of Your honor
and through the royal house of David Your anointed,
and Your Sanctuary and Your Temple.

וּבַבֵּן הַנֶּעֱקָד יַשְׁבִּית מְדַיְּנֵֽינוּ
וּבִזְכוּת הַתָּם יוֹצִיא הַיּוֹם לְצֶֽדֶק דִּינֵֽנוּ
כִּי־קָדוֹשׁ הַיּוֹם לַאֲדֹנֵֽינוּ:


He, our Lord,
will yet remember for us the love of [Abraham] the steadfast one.
And for [Isaac] the son who was bound,
He will still the enmity against us,
and for the merit of [Jacob] the innocent man,
He will bring today our judgment out to the good,
for this day is holy to our Lord.

The One who opens the gates to those who come knocking penitently.
And all believe that His hand is ever open.

הַצּוֹפֶה רָשָׁע, וְחָפֵץ לְהַצְדִּיקוֹ
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר.


The One who espies the evildoer and wishes to justify him.
And all believe that He is righteous and upright.

הַקָּצָר בְּזַֽעַם, וּמַאֲרִיךְ אָף
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא קָשֶׁה לִכְעֹס.


The One who is slow to anger and defers wrath.
And all believe that His ire is hard to arouse.

הָרַחוּם, וּמַקְדִּים רַחֲמִים לְרֹֽגֶז
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא רַךְ לִרְצוֹת.


The compassionate One who lets pity precede rage.
And all believe that He is easily appeased.

הַשָּׁוֶה, וּמַשְׁוֶה קָטֹן וְגָדוֹל
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא שׁוֹפֵט צֶֽדֶק.


The constant One who considers great and small equally.
And all believe that He is a righteous Judge.

הַתָּם, וּמִתַּמֵּם עִם תְּמִימִים
וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים שֶׁהוּא תָּמִים פָּעֳלוֹ.


The perfect One who deals in integrity with the innocent.
And all believe that His works are perfect and complete.

תֻּשְׂגַּב לְבַדֶּֽךָ, וְתִמְלֹךְ עַל כֹּל בְּיִחוּד
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ
וְהָיָה יהוה לְמֶֽלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יהוה אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד׃


תֻּשְׂגַּב לְבַדֶּֽךָ You will be elevated, peerless,
and will rule over all that is, alone,
as is written by Your prophet,
“Then the Lord shall be King over all the earth;
on that day the Lord shall be One and His name One.”


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 255

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/255](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/255)


וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ עַל כָּל מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ
וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָֽאתָ
וְיִירָאֽוּךָ כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים, וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ כָּל הַבְּרוּאִים
וְיֵעָשׂוּ כֻלָּם אֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם
כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַֽעְנוּ יהוה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ שֶׁהַשָּׁלְטָן לְפָנֶֽיךָ
עֹז בְּיָדְךָ וּגְבוּרָה בִּימִינֶֽךָ
וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָֽאתָ.


וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ And so place the fear of You, LORD our God,
over all that You have made,
and the terror of You over all You have created,
and all who were made will stand in awe of You,
and all of creation will worship You,
and they will be bound all together as one
to carry out Your will with an undivided heart;
for we know, LORD our God,
that all dominion is laid out before You,
strength is in Your palm,
and might in Your right hand,
Your name spreading awe over all You have created.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 256

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/256](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/256)


וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יהוה לְעַמֶּֽךָ
תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶֽיךָ וְתִקְוָה טוֹבָה לְדוֹרְשֶֽׁיךָ
וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה לַמְיַחֲלִים לָךְ, שִׂמְחָה לְאַרְצֶֽךָ, וְשָׂשׂוֹן לְעִירֶֽךָ
וּצְמִיחַת קֶֽרֶן לְדָוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ, וַעֲרִיכַת נֵר לְבֶן יִשַׁי מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ.


וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד And so place honor, LORD, upon Your people,
praise on those who fear You and hope into those who seek You,
the confidence to speak into all who long for You,
gladness to Your land, and joy to Your city,
the flourishing of pride to David Your servant,
and a lamp laid out for his descendant, Your anointed,
soon, in our days.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 257

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/257](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/257)


וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ, וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ
וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִֽילוּ, וְעוֹלָֽתָה תִּקְפָּץ פִּֽיהָ
וְכָל הָרִשְׁעָה כֻּלָּהּ כְּעָשָׁן תִּכְלֶה
כִּי תַעֲבִיר מֶמְשֶֽׁלֶת זָדוֹן מִן הָאָֽרֶץ.


וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים And then righteous people will see and rejoice,
and the upright will exult, and the pious revel in joy,
and injustice will have nothing more to say,
and all wickedness will fade away like smoke
as You sweep the rule of arrogance from the earth.


###### The Koren Yom Kippur Mahzor; Ashkenaz, Musaf, Leader's Repetition for Musaf 259

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/259](https://torahapp.org/share/book/The%20Koren%20Yom%20Kippur%20Mahzor%3B%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf,_Leader%27s%20Repetition%20for%20Musaf/r/259)


וְיֶאֱתָֽיוּ כֹל לְעָבְדֶֽךָ / וִיבָרְכוּ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ
וְיַגִּֽידוּ בָאִיִּים צִדְקֶֽךָ / וְיִדְרְשֽׁוּךָ עַמִּים לֹא יְדָעֽוּךָ
וִיהַלְלֽוּךָ כָּל אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ / וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יהוה
וְיִזְנְחוּ אֶת עֲצַבֵּיהֶם / וְיַחְפְּרוּ עִם פְּסִילֵיהֶם
וְיַטּוּ שְׁכֶם אֶחָד לְעָבְדֶֽךָ / וְיִירָאֽוּךָ עִם שֶֽׁמֶשׁ מְבַקְשֵׁי פָנֶֽיךָ
וְיַכִּֽירוּ כֹּֽחַ מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ / וְיִלְמְדוּ תוֹעִים בִּינָה
וִימַלְּלוּ אֶת גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ / וִינַשְּׂאֽוּךָ, מִתְנַשֵּׂא לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ
וִיסַלְּדוּ בְחִילָה פָּנֶֽיךָ / וִיעַטְּרֽוּךָ נֵֽזֶר תִּפְאָרָה
וְיִפְצְחוּ הָרִים רִנָּה / וְיִצְהֲלוּ אִיִּים בְּמָלְכֶֽךָ
וִיקַבְּלוּ עֹל מַלְכוּתְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם / וִירוֹמְמֽוּךָ בִּקְהַל עָם
וְיִשְׁמְעוּ רְחוֹקִים וְיָבֽוֹאוּ / וְיִתְּנוּ לְךָ כֶּֽתֶר מְלוּכָה.


וְיֶאֱתָֽיוּ And all shall come forth to worship You
and they shall bless Your honorable name.
And they shall tell of Your righteousness in the islands,
and nations that have not known You shall seek You out.
And all the ends of the earth shall praise You
and shall always say, “May the Lord forever be exalted.”
And they shall spurn their idols
and be ashamed of their graven images.
And they shall turn their shoulder as one to worship You,
and those who seek Your presence
shall see You with the rising sun forever.
And they shall recognize Your majestic power,
and the errant ones shall learn to understand.
And they shall speak of Your might
and they shall exalt You who are exalted above all rulers.
And they shall leap back in fear in Your presence,
and they shall crown You with a diadem of glory.
And the mountains themselves shall break out in song,
and the islands shall joyfully shout as You are crowned.
And they shall accept the yoke of Your reign over them,
and You shall be exalted among assembled multitudes.
And they shall hear from far and wide and come
to offer You the royal crown.
